en_grezzo: "It is a mechanically driven saw. You can use it like an axe."
it: Una sega a motore. Si usa come un'ascia.

jp: \t\t複数の刃を備えた鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t複数の刃を備えた鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scythe with multiple blades.
en_grezzo: "It is a scythe with multiple blades."

jp: \t\t骨でできた鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t骨でできた鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scythe made of bones.
en_grezzo: "It is a scythe made of bones."

jp: \t\t先端が左右に張り出している鈍器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t先端が左右に張り出している鈍器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a blunt weapon with the protruding ends on both sides.
en_grezzo: "It is a blunt weapon with the protruding ends on both sides."
it: Un'arma contundente con le punte sporgenti ai lati.

jp: \t\t鉄球タイプの鈍器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鉄球タイプの鈍器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a blunt weapon with a wrecking ball.
en_grezzo: "It is a blunt weapon with a wrecking ball."
it: Un'arma contundente con una palla di ferro.

jp: \t\t先端に輪っかのついた杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t先端に輪っかのついた杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a staff with a loop on the end.
en_grezzo: "It is a staff with a loop on the end."
it: Un bastone con un anello in cima.

jp: \t\t分割して素早く振り回せる棒だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t分割して素早く振り回せる棒だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a staff that can be splitted and wielded quickly.
en_grezzo: "It is a staff that can be splitted and wielded quickly."
it: Un bastone che si divide e si gira in fretta.

jp: \t\t刃のついている弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t刃のついている弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a bow with a blade.
en_grezzo: "It is a bow with a blade."

jp: \t\t矢に着火する機構を備えたクロスボウだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t矢に着火する機構を備えたクロスボウだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a crossbow with a mechanism to ignite the arrow.
en_grezzo: "It is a crossbow with a mechanism to ignite the arrow."
it: Una balestra con un meccanismo che accende le frecce.

jp: \t\t二つで一つの小型銃器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t二つで一つの小型銃器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Due armi da fuoco piccole che fanno una cosa sola.

jp: \t\tなぜかその辺に落ちている、手ごろな大きさの枝。火を起こすことができる。\n#～君にもできるサバイバル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tなぜかその辺に落ちている、手ごろな大きさの枝。火を起こすことができる。\n#～君にもできるサバイバル～\n"
en: A reasonably sized branch that for some reason has fallen around. It can start a fire. \n# ~Survival that Anyone Can Do~
en_grezzo: "A reasonably sized branch that for some reason has fallen around. It can start a fire. \n# ~Survival that Anyone Can Do~"
it: Un ramo di misura giusta, che chissà come sta lì per terra. Serve ad accendere il fuoco. \n# ~La Sopravvivenza Alla Portata di Tutti~

jp: \t\t火を起こすのに使うことができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t火を起こすのに使うことができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Serve ad accendere il fuoco. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\tイムウエルのノースティリス全域に自生する草。繁殖力が高く、街中にも生えていた時期もあったらしい。葉は甘い汁が出るため甘味料に、太く長い根は食用に適する。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tイムウエルのノースティリス全域に自生する草。繁殖力が高く、街中にも生えていた時期もあったらしい。葉は甘い汁が出るため甘味料に、太く長い根は食用に適する。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Weed that are native to all regions of Aimwell. It is highly prolific, and at one time it was said to grow in the city. The leaves produce a sweet juice that is used as a sweetener, and the thick, long roots are edible.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Weed that are native to all regions of Aimwell. It is highly prolific, and at one time it was said to grow in the city. The leaves produce a sweet juice that is used as a sweetener, and the thick, long roots are edible.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un'erba che cresce spontanea in tutta la Tyris del Nord di Aimwell. Si riproduce in fretta, e pare che a un certo punto spuntasse perfino in mezzo alle città. Dalle foglie esce un succo dolce che si usa come dolcificante, e la radice, grossa e lunga, è buona da mangiare.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tイムウエルのノースティリス全域に自生する草。一見するとフェーンにそっくりだが、葉にトゲがあり根は細くて刺激臭を放つ。葉はトゲをとると意外と美味しく、根は薬の材料になる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tイムウエルのノースティリス全域に自生する草。一見するとフェーンにそっくりだが、葉にトゲがあり根は細くて刺激臭を放つ。葉はトゲをとると意外と美味しく、根は薬の材料になる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Weed that are native to all regions of Aimwell. It looks just like fern at first glance, but the leaves have spines and the roots are thin and emit a pungent odor. The leaves are surprisingly tasty when the spines are removed, and the roots are used in medicine.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Weed that are native to all regions of Aimwell. It looks just like fern at first glance, but the leaves have spines and the roots are thin and emit a pungent odor. The leaves are surprisingly tasty when the spines are removed, and the roots are used in medicine.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un'erba che cresce spontanea in tutta la Tyris del Nord di Aimwell. A prima vista somiglia in tutto alla fane, ma ha le foglie spinose e la radice sottile, dall'odore pungente. Tolte le spine, le foglie sono buone più di quanto si creda, e la radice serve a preparare medicine.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tエーテル抗体を凝固させたもの。保存性は増しているが、変質して効果が低下している。世間一般的には抗体として認知されていない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tエーテル抗体を凝固させたもの。保存性は増しているが、変質して効果が低下している。世間一般的には抗体として認知されていない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Coagulated ether antibodies. It has increased shelf life, but is less effective due to alteration. Not recognized as an antibody by the public.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Coagulated ether antibodies. It has increased shelf life, but is less effective due to alteration. Not recognized as an antibody by the public.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: La cura della corruzione, fatta rapprendere in un solido. Si conserva più a lungo, ma alterandosi ha perso efficacia. In generale non la si considera nemmeno una cura della corruzione.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tエーテル病を治すことができる貴重な食品だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tエーテル病を治すことができる貴重な食品だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a precious food used to cure ether disease.
en_grezzo: "It is a precious food used to cure ether disease."
it: Un cibo prezioso che guarisce la malattia dell'etere.

jp: \t\t手ぶれを抑えたり射撃手や砲架が受ける反動を受け流したりするための固定器具。精密な射撃を可能にする他、反動を気にせず思いっきりぶっ放すことも可能に。オートマチックで地面に突き刺さった後は、一定時間経過すると解除される。その間は逃げることもできないので注意。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t手ぶれを抑えたり射撃手や砲架が受ける反動を受け流したりするための固定器具。精密な射撃を可能にする他、反動を気にせず思いっきりぶっ放すことも可能に。オートマチックで地面に突き刺さった後は、一定時間経過すると解除される。その間は逃げることもできないので注意。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A stabilizing device used to suppress hand shaking and to absorb the recoil received by the shooter and the gun mount. In addition to enabling precise shooting, it also makes it possible to fire with all one's might without worrying about the recoil. Once the automatic weapon is stuck in the ground, it is released after a certain period of time. Note that you cannot escape during this time. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A stabilizing device used to suppress hand shaking and to absorb the recoil received by the shooter and the gun mount. In addition to enabling precise shooting, it also makes it possible to fire with all one's might without worrying about the recoil. Once the automatic weapon is stuck in the ground, it is released after a certain period of time. Note that you cannot escape during this time. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un fermo che tiene ferma la mano e scarica il rinculo che prendono il tiratore e l'affusto. Rende possibile il tiro di precisione, e permette anche di sparare a più non posso senza badare al rinculo. Si pianta a terra da sé, e dopo un certo tempo si sgancia. Attenzione: nel frattempo non si può scappare. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t射撃攻撃力を強化する道具だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t射撃攻撃力を強化する道具だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool to enhance the shooting attack power.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool to enhance the shooting attack power."
it: Potenzia l'attacco a distanza. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t読むことで家以外の移設ができる申請書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことで家以外の移設ができる申請書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) Readable deed used to move a building, except your home.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) Readable deed used to move a building, except your home."
it: Un atto: letto, sposta un edificio che non sia la casa.

jp: \t\t燃焼時に火を噴くタルだ。投げてぶつけると火炎爆発を起こす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜爆弾＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t燃焼時に火を噴くタルだ。投げてぶつけると火炎爆発を起こす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜爆弾＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Threwable barrel that spews flame when burning.
en_grezzo: "Threwable barrel that spews flame when burning."
it: Un barile che bruciando sputa fuoco. Lanciato, esplode in fiamme.

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復できる飲み物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復できる飲み物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a beverage that restores satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is a beverage that restores satiety."

jp: \t\t欲望を煽るように怪しく輝く欠片。そこそこ綺麗なので宝石の代用にされたりもする。使用者にトラップを操る魔力を与え、代償として命を蝕む…というウワサもあるが誰も信じていない。遥か昔に人間を滅ぼそうとして敗れた魔神が、赤い破片となって飛び散ったという伝承があり、そこからこの名がつけられた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t欲望を煽るように怪しく輝く欠片。そこそこ綺麗なので宝石の代用にされたりもする。使用者にトラップを操る魔力を与え、代償として命を蝕む…というウワサもあるが誰も信じていない。遥か昔に人間を滅ぼそうとして敗れた魔神が、赤い破片となって飛び散ったという伝承があり、そこからこの名がつけられた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Fragments that shine suspiciously to incite desire. Because it is so beautiful, it is sometimes used as a substitute for jewelry. There are rumors that it gives the user the magical power to manipulate traps, and in return, it eats away at one's life... but no one believes it. There is a legend that a long time ago, a demonic god attempting to destroy humanity was defeated and scattered into red fragments, hence the name. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Fragments that shine suspiciously to incite desire. Because it is so beautiful, it is sometimes used as a substitute for jewelry. There are rumors that it gives the user the magical power to manipulate traps, and in return, it eats away at one's life... but no one believes it. There is a legend that a long time ago, a demonic god attempting to destroy humanity was defeated and scattered into red fragments, hence the name. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un frammento che brilla in modo torbido, come per attizzare il desiderio. È abbastanza bello da servire al posto di una gemma. Gira anche la voce che dia a chi lo usa la forza magica di manovrare le trappole, e che in cambio gli roda la vita... ma non ci crede nessuno. C'è una leggenda per cui, tanto tempo fa, un dio demoniaco che voleva distruggere gli uomini fu sconfitto e si sparse in schegge rosse: di lì gli viene il nome. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t魔力を含んだ欠片だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔力を含んだ欠片だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un frammento che contiene magia. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t味の無くなったガム。空腹を誤魔化すのに使えなくもないが、美味しくないし硬い。捨てたほうがマシだがポイ捨てはやめよう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t味の無くなったガム。空腹を誤魔化すのに使えなくもないが、美味しくないし硬い。捨てたほうがマシだがポイ捨てはやめよう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Flavorless gum. It can be used to distract hunger, but it doesn't taste good and it is hard. It's better to throw it away, but please refrain from littering.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Flavorless gum. It can be used to distract hunger, but it doesn't taste good and it is hard. It's better to throw it away, but please refrain from littering.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una gomma che ha perso ogni sapore. A ingannare la fame serve ancora, ma è dura e non sa di niente. Meglio buttarla, però non per terra.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度をほんのわずかに回復することができる食物。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度をほんのわずかに回復することができる食物。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that barely restores satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is food that barely restores satiety."
it: Un cibo che sazia appena appena.

jp: \t\tガムベースと呼ばれる樹脂に甘味料や香料を加えたもの。風味や口当たりを楽しめる。栄養はないし腹も膨れないが、噛み続けることで空腹を誤魔化すくらいはできる。ごろつきの中には、クチャクチャ噛むことでガムを一種の威嚇行動に用いる個体も存在する。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tガムベースと呼ばれる樹脂に甘味料や香料を加えたもの。風味や口当たりを楽しめる。栄養はないし腹も膨れないが、噛み続けることで空腹を誤魔化すくらいはできる。ごろつきの中には、クチャクチャ噛むことでガムを一種の威嚇行動に用いる個体も存在する。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A resin called gum base to which sweeteners and flavorings are added. It gives a pleasant taste and texture. It is not nutritious and does not fill you up, but it can at least distract you from hunger if you keep chewing it. Some gorillas use gum as a kind of intimidating behavior by chewing it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A resin called gum base to which sweeteners and flavorings are added. It gives a pleasant taste and texture. It is not nutritious and does not fill you up, but it can at least distract you from hunger if you keep chewing it. Some gorillas use gum as a kind of intimidating behavior by chewing it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una resina detta base per gomme, con l'aggiunta di dolcificanti e aromi. Dà gusto e piacere alla bocca. Non nutre e non riempie la pancia, ma masticandola a lungo la fame si inganna. Certi teppisti la masticano rumorosamente e ne fanno una specie di minaccia.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度をわずかに回復することができる食物。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度をわずかに回復することができる食物。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can slightly restore satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can slightly restore satiety."

jp: \t\t二度焼きされた磁器でできた人形。貴族の女子たちに人気。特殊な術式を用いて魔力を込めると、動き出すようになるというウワサがある。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t二度焼きされた磁器でできた人形。貴族の女子たちに人気。特殊な術式を用いて魔力を込めると、動き出すようになるというウワサがある。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Dolls made of twice-fired porcelain. Popular among noble girls. Rumor has it that if a special formula is used to put magic power into the doll, it will start to move. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Dolls made of twice-fired porcelain. Popular among noble girls. Rumor has it that if a special formula is used to put magic power into the doll, it will start to move. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Bambole fatte di porcellana cotta due volte. Piacciono molto alle ragazze di nobile famiglia. Corre voce che, infondendovi il potere magico con una formula speciale, si mettano a muoversi. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t磁器製の人形だ。使うと仲間にできる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t磁器製の人形だ。使うと仲間にできる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a porcelain doll. If infused with mana, you can make it an ally.
en_grezzo: "It is a porcelain doll. If infused with mana, you can make it an ally."
it: Una bambola di porcellana: usandola diventa una compagna.

jp: \t\t綺麗な装飾が施された見事な陶器。特に芸術的な品は高値で取引され、食器ではなくインテリアとして用いられたりする。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t綺麗な装飾が施された見事な陶器。特に芸術的な品は高値で取引され、食器ではなくインテリアとして用いられたりする。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Exquisite ceramics with beautiful decorations. Artistic pieces in particular fetch high prices and are often used not as tableware but as interior decorations. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Exquisite ceramics with beautiful decorations. Artistic pieces in particular fetch high prices and are often used not as tableware but as interior decorations. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Ceramiche magnifiche, ornate con grande finezza. I pezzi più artistici si vendono a caro prezzo, e spesso non si usano come stoviglie ma come arredo. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t見事な陶器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t見事な陶器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "It is a report with misc. information. Can be read more than once."

jp: \t\t水中の魚に対して使う餌。一応食べることもできるが、生臭いしマズい。魚にとっては栄養抜群らしく、鱗が綺麗になったり身が引き締まったりする。品質を上げることができるので、飼っている魚に与えるといいだろう。魚のモンスターには特に効果がないようで、その差はどこからくるのか謎。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t水中の魚に対して使う餌。一応食べることもできるが、生臭いしマズい。魚にとっては栄養抜群らしく、鱗が綺麗になったり身が引き締まったりする。品質を上げることができるので、飼っている魚に与えるといいだろう。魚のモンスターには特に効果がないようで、その差はどこからくるのか謎。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Bait used for fish in the water. It can be eaten, but it smells unpleasant and tastes bad. It seems to be very nutritious for fish, and it makes their scales beautiful and their flesh tighter. You should feed it to your fish as it can improve their quality. It does not seem to have any particular effect on fish monsters, and it is a mystery where the difference comes from.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Bait used for fish in the water. It can be eaten, but it smells unpleasant and tastes bad. It seems to be very nutritious for fish, and it makes their scales beautiful and their flesh tighter. You should feed it to your fish as it can improve their quality. It does not seem to have any particular effect on fish monsters, and it is a mystery where the difference comes from.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Esca da gettare ai pesci in acqua. Mangiarla si può, ma sa di pesce marcio ed è cattiva. Per i pesci invece è nutrientissima: le squame si fanno belle e le carni sode. Siccome ne migliora la qualità, conviene darla ai pesci che si allevano. Sui pesci mostruosi pare non avere alcun effetto, e da dove venga la differenza resta un mistero.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t食物の一種。置いてある魚に使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n

en: (Single-use) tool type food for feeding fishes placed on the ground.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool type food for feeding fishes placed on the ground."
it: Un cibo da dare ai pesci posati per terra (usa e getta).

it: Un oggetto che si può bere.

jp: \t\t所持者の体型を維持する器具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n

en_grezzo: "It is a device that keeps the holder in shape."

jp: \t\t使用者の思念に応じてサイズが変わる伝説の耳かき。妖精だろうが巨人だろうがこれ一本で済むが、適当なことを考えていると制御不能に陥る。使いこなせば全みみくそを一度にまとめて摘出することも可能な逸品なので、ただ修行あるのみ。端に付いているフワフワしたものは人造ケサランパサランであり、使った後はゆっくり休ませないと死ぬ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用者の思念に応じてサイズが変わる伝説の耳かき。妖精だろうが巨人だろうがこれ一本で済むが、適当なことを考えていると制御不能に陥る。使いこなせば全みみくそを一度にまとめて摘出することも可能な逸品なので、ただ修行あるのみ。端に付いているフワフワしたものは人造ケサランパサランであり、使った後はゆっくり休ませないと死ぬ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Legendary ear picks that change size according to the user's thoughts. Whether you are a fairy or a giant, you only need one of these, but you will lose control of it if you are thinking about the wrong thing. If you master the use of this masterpiece, you can remove all the earwax at once, so you just have to train yourself. The fluffy thing attached to the end is artificial kesalanpatharan, which will die if it is not allowed to rest slowly after use. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Legendary ear picks that change size according to the user's thoughts. Whether you are a fairy or a giant, you only need one of these, but you will lose control of it if you are thinking about the wrong thing. If you master the use of this masterpiece, you can remove all the earwax at once, so you just have to train yourself. The fluffy thing attached to the end is artificial kesalanpatharan, which will die if it is not allowed to rest slowly after use. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il leggendario nettaorecchie che cambia misura secondo il pensiero di chi lo usa. Che tu sia una fata o un gigante ne basta uno, ma se pensi a vanvera ti sfugge di mano. Con la pratica si arriva a cavare tutto il cerume in un colpo solo: è un pezzo pregiato, e non resta che allenarsi. Il batuffolo in punta è un kesaranpasaran artificiale, e dopo l'uso, se non lo si lascia riposare con calma, muore. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t耳掃除用の道具だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t耳掃除用の道具だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "It is a star-sphere-hammer that was attached to the tail of a dinosaur."
it: Una mazza ferrata che stava in coda a un dinosauro.

jp: \t\t古代の文献をもとに再現された料理。サンドイッチの親戚だが肉に重きを置いているフシがある。でかすぎて重い上に食べづらく、本当にこのサイズが標準だったのか疑問を持つ学者も多い。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古代の文献をもとに再現された料理。サンドイッチの親戚だが肉に重きを置いているフシがある。でかすぎて重い上に食べづらく、本当にこのサイズが標準だったのか疑問を持つ学者も多い。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A dish recreated from ancient writings. It is a relative of the sandwich, but it seems to place more emphasis on the meat. It is too large, heavy, and difficult to eat, and many scholars question whether this size was really the standard.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A dish recreated from ancient writings. It is a relative of the sandwich, but it seems to place more emphasis on the meat. It is too large, heavy, and difficult to eat, and many scholars question whether this size was really the standard.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un piatto ricostruito a partire da testi antichi. È parente del panino imbottito, ma sembra puntare tutto sulla carne. È enorme, pesante e scomodo da mangiare, e molti studiosi dubitano che questa fosse davvero la misura normale.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety."

jp: \t\tもちを具材とした甘味。硬く乾燥してしまった鏡もちを処理するために小豆汁に入れたのが始まり。しかし、もちではなく団子や栗を入れるのが正しいとする説や、ぜんざいと呼ばれる類似品も発見され、学会でも論争になっている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tもちを具材とした甘味。硬く乾燥してしまった鏡もちを処理するために小豆汁に入れたのが始まり。しかし、もちではなく団子や栗を入れるのが正しいとする説や、ぜんざいと呼ばれる類似品も発見され、学会でも論争になっている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A sweet dish using rice cake as the ingredient. Kagamimochi, which had turned hard and dry, was put in azuki bean soup to treat it. However, there is a theory that dumplings or chestnuts should be added instead of mochi, and a similar product called zenzai has also been discovered, causing controversy in academic circles.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A sweet dish using rice cake as the ingredient. Kagamimochi, which had turned hard and dry, was put in azuki bean soup to treat it. However, there is a theory that dumplings or chestnuts should be added instead of mochi, and a similar product called zenzai has also been discovered, causing controversy in academic circles.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un dolce che ha il mochi per ingrediente. Nacque per smaltire i kagami mochi ormai duri e secchi, buttandoli in un brodo di fagioli azuki. C'è però chi sostiene che al posto del mochi vadano messi gnocchetti o castagne, ed è saltato fuori anche un piatto somigliante chiamato zenzai: negli ambienti accademici se ne discute ancora.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。のどに詰まることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。のどに詰まることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety. CHOKE WARNING.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety. CHOKE WARNING."
it: Un cibo che sazia. Certe volte va di traverso.

jp: \t\tもちを具材としたスープ料理。硬く乾燥してしまった鏡もちを処理するために汁物にしたのが始まり。当初はもち汁などと呼ばれていたが、後に古代の文献で似たような品が発見され、今ではその名を受け継いでいる。ただし資料によって細部に違いがあるため、どこまで同じものなのかは専門家にもわからない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tもちを具材としたスープ料理。硬く乾燥してしまった鏡もちを処理するために汁物にしたのが始まり。当初はもち汁などと呼ばれていたが、後に古代の文献で似たような品が発見され、今ではその名を受け継いでいる。ただし資料によって細部に違いがあるため、どこまで同じものなのかは専門家にもわからない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A sweet dish using rice cake as the ingredient. Kagamimochi, which had turned hard and dry, was put in azuki bean soup to treat it. At first, it was called something like mochi soup, but later a similar item was found in ancient documents, and it has now taken on that name. However, since there are differences in details in different documents, even experts cannot tell to what extent they are the same.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A sweet dish using rice cake as the ingredient. Kagamimochi, which had turned hard and dry, was put in azuki bean soup to treat it. At first, it was called something like mochi soup, but later a similar item was found in ancient documents, and it has now taken on that name. However, since there are differences in details in different documents, even experts cannot tell to what extent they are the same.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una zuppa che ha il mochi per ingrediente. Nacque per smaltire i kagami mochi ormai duri e secchi, mettendoli in un brodo. All'inizio la chiamavano brodo di mochi; poi in certi testi antichi si trovò un piatto somigliante, e da allora ne porta il nome. I dettagli però cambiano da un documento all'altro, e nemmeno gli esperti sanno fin dove i due piatti coincidano.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tクリスマス用のでかいケーキ。12月になると雑貨店が売り始めるが、売れ残ることも。でかいので皆でお腹いっぱい食べられる。もちろん独り占めすることもできるが、虚しい。12月なら信仰の技術を成長させ幸運も呼ぶ。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tクリスマス用のでかいケーキ。12月になると雑貨店が売り始めるが、売れ残ることも。でかいので皆でお腹いっぱい食べられる。もちろん独り占めすることもできるが、虚しい。12月なら信仰の技術を成長させ幸運も呼ぶ。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: A large Christmas cake, sold at grocery stores in December, but sometimes left unsold. It's so big that everyone can eat a whole lot of it. Of course, you can have it all to yourself, but that's wasteful; in December, you can develop the art of faith and bring good luck by eating it. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "A large Christmas cake, sold at grocery stores in December, but sometimes left unsold. It's so big that everyone can eat a whole lot of it. Of course, you can have it all to yourself, but that's wasteful; in December, you can develop the art of faith and bring good luck by eating it. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un dolce enorme per il Natale. A dicembre le mercerie cominciano a venderlo, ma qualcuno resta invenduto. È grande, e ci si sazia tutti insieme. Certo, uno può anche tenerselo per sé, ma che tristezza. A dicembre fa crescere l'abilità Fede e porta anche fortuna. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t食べるのではなく、使うことで仲間全員で食事ができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食べるのではなく、使うことで仲間全員で食事ができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that creates a cake for your allies to eat.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that creates a cake for your allies to eat."
it: Non si mangia: usandolo, mangiano tutti i compagni (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t中身が透けない紙の袋。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜袋＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t中身が透けない紙の袋。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜袋＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) paper bag that are not visible through.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) paper bag that are not visible through."
it: Un sacchetto di carta: dentro non si vede. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t魚介類が痛まぬよう、塩水に漬けてから天日で干すことにより携帯性と日持ちを増したもの。焼くととても香ばしい。なぜか幸運の女神には喜ばれないらしい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魚介類が痛まぬよう、塩水に漬けてから天日で干すことにより携帯性と日持ちを増したもの。焼くととても香ばしい。なぜか幸運の女神には喜ばれないらしい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: To prevent damaging the seafood, it is cured in salt water and then dried under the sun to increase portability and shelf life. It is very savory when grilled. For some reason, it is said that the Goddess of Fortune is not pleased with it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "To prevent damaging the seafood, it is cured in salt water and then dried under the sun to increase portability and shelf life. It is very savory when grilled. For some reason, it is said that the Goddess of Fortune is not pleased with it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Pesce messo in salamoia e poi seccato al sole perché non si guasti: così si trasporta meglio e dura di più. Arrostito profuma moltissimo. Chissà perché, alla dea della fortuna non fa piacere.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a dried out fish that can restore satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is a dried out fish that can restore satiety."

jp: \t\t野菜が痛まぬよう、天日で干すことにより携帯性と日持ちを増したもの。水分が抜けたことにより甘味やうまみや凝縮されている。なぜか収穫の神には喜ばれないらしい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t野菜が痛まぬよう、天日で干すことにより携帯性と日持ちを増したもの。水分が抜けたことにより甘味やうまみや凝縮されている。なぜか収穫の神には喜ばれないらしい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: To prevent damaging the vegetables, it is cured in salt water and then dried under the sun to increase portability and shelf life. This resulted in sweetness and flavor being concentrated. For some reason, it is said that the God(dess?) of Harvest is not pleased with it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "To prevent damaging the vegetables, it is cured in salt water and then dried under the sun to increase portability and shelf life. This resulted in sweetness and flavor being concentrated. For some reason, it is said that the God(dess?) of Harvest is not pleased with it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Verdura seccata al sole perché non si guasti: così si trasporta meglio e dura di più. Persa l'acqua, il dolce e il sapore si concentrano. Chissà perché, al dio del raccolto non fa piacere.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a dried out vegetable that can restore satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is a dried out vegetable that can restore satiety."

jp: \t\t果実が痛まぬよう砂糖に漬けたり天日で干すことで水分を飛ばし、携帯性と日持ちを増したもの。生のままだと食べづらい皮も食べやすくなる。独特の甘味が苦手な人もいる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t果実が痛まぬよう砂糖に漬けたり天日で干すことで水分を飛ばし、携帯性と日持ちを増したもの。生のままだと食べづらい皮も食べやすくなる。独特の甘味が苦手な人もいる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: To prevent damaging the fruits, it is cured in sugar and then dried under the sun to increase portability and shelf life. The skin, which is difficult to eat raw, becomes easier to eat. There are people who do not like the unique sweet taste.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "To prevent damaging the fruits, it is cured in sugar and then dried under the sun to increase portability and shelf life. The skin, which is difficult to eat raw, becomes easier to eat. There are people who do not like the unique sweet taste.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Frutta candita nello zucchero o seccata al sole perché non si guasti: persa l'acqua, si trasporta meglio e dura di più. Anche la buccia, che cruda è scomoda da mangiare, diventa facile. C'è chi non sopporta quel dolce così particolare.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
