en_grezzo: "It is a dried out fruit that can restore satiety."

jp: \t\t投擲用の甲虫だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t投擲用の甲虫だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a beetles made for throwing.
en_grezzo: "It is a beetles made for throwing."

jp: \t\tオパートスの姿の振り子。どこかの職人がオパートスから剥がれた岩を加工して作っているらしい。鉱石類と反応し、ぐるぐる回ったり高笑いしたりする。埋まっている鉱石を掘り出す際に見逃しが減るのでは、と鉱夫の間で話題になっている。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tオパートスの姿の振り子。どこかの職人がオパートスから剥がれた岩を加工して作っているらしい。鉱石類と反応し、ぐるぐる回ったり高笑いしたりする。埋まっている鉱石を掘り出す際に見逃しが減るのでは、と鉱夫の間で話題になっている。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n"
en: A pendulum in the shape of Opatos. It seems to be made by some craftsman working on a rock stripped from Opatos himself. It reacts with ores and spins around and laughs. There is talk among miners that it may reduce the chance of missing buried ores when digging them out. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~
en_grezzo: "A pendulum in the shape of Opatos. It seems to be made by some craftsman working on a rock stripped from Opatos himself. It reacts with ores and spins around and laughs. There is talk among miners that it may reduce the chance of missing buried ores when digging them out. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~"
it: Un pendolo a forma di Opatos. Pare che un certo artigiano lo ricavi dalla roccia staccata da Opatos stesso. Reagisce ai minerali: gira su sé stesso e ride forte. Fra i minatori si dice che, a scavare, faccia sfuggire di meno il metallo sepolto. \n# ~Scegliere Bene gli Attrezzi da Artigiano~

jp: \t\t大地の神を模したペンデュラムだ。所持していると自動で使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大地の神を模したペンデュラムだ。所持していると自動で使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) tool pendulum that looks like the God of Earth.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) tool pendulum that looks like the God of Earth."
it: Un pendolo del dio della terra. Si usa da sé se lo porti.

jp: \t\tクミロミが自分を模して作った巨大なぬいぐるみ。先代エヘカトルに数えきれないほど贈られたが、全て下界に捨てられていた。その正体はエヘカトルに近寄る者を殺すための呪具。誰も見ていない時に動き出して周囲の生物を襲う。畑に置いておくと害獣を殺すので便利。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tクミロミが自分を模して作った巨大なぬいぐるみ。先代エヘカトルに数えきれないほど贈られたが、全て下界に捨てられていた。その正体はエヘカトルに近寄る者を殺すための呪具。誰も見ていない時に動き出して周囲の生物を襲う。畑に置いておくと害獣を殺すので便利。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A giant stuffed doll made by Kumiromi in his own image. It was previously given to Ehekatl countless times, but all of them were discarded in the human world. Its true functionality is that it is a cursed tool to kill anyone who comes close to Ehekatl. It moves when no one is looking and attacks surrounding creatures. It is useful to leave it in the field to kill vermin. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A giant stuffed doll made by Kumiromi in his own image. It was previously given to Ehekatl countless times, but all of them were discarded in the human world. Its true functionality is that it is a cursed tool to kill anyone who comes close to Ehekatl. It moves when no one is looking and attacks surrounding creatures. It is useful to leave it in the field to kill vermin. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un enorme peluche che Kumiromi ha fatto a propria immagine. Ne regalò alla precedente Ehekatl un numero incalcolabile, e lei li buttò tutti quaggiù. In verità è un oggetto maledetto, fatto per uccidere chi si avvicina a Ehekatl: si muove quando nessuno guarda e assale le creature intorno. Lasciato nel campo fa comodo, perché ammazza gli animali nocivi. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t収穫の神のぬいぐるみだ。畑に置いておくと効果がある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t収穫の神のぬいぐるみだ。畑に置いておくと効果がある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a stuffed doll of God of the Harvest. Useful when placed in farm.
en_grezzo: "It is a stuffed doll of God of the Harvest. Useful when placed in farm."
it: Un peluche del dio del raccolto. Fa effetto se sta nel campo.

jp: \t\t風の女神の写真集だ。足元にあると気になる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t風の女神の写真集だ。足元にあると気になる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a set of photograph of the Wind Goddess, very eye-catching.
en_grezzo: "It is a set of photograph of the Wind Goddess, very eye-catching."
it: Un album di foto della dea del vento. A terra, distrae.

jp: \t\tガチョウを抱えたヤカテクトの人形。神公式の工場で製造されているらしい。金貨を入れると翼を動かしながら喋る。入れた金貨はヤカテクトに運用され、トワリならぬヒャクワリ…およそ１００日で１割の利子がつく。高利と引き換えに１００日目まで出し入れはできないし、以降は追加預金しないと利子が増えないという制約がある。そして取り出す際は金貨が尻から出る。もちろんガチョウの。\n#～必見！貯蓄型資産運用のすべて～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tガチョウを抱えたヤカテクトの人形。神公式の工場で製造されているらしい。金貨を入れると翼を動かしながら喋る。入れた金貨はヤカテクトに運用され、トワリならぬヒャクワリ…およそ１００日で１割の利子がつく。高利と引き換えに１００日目まで出し入れはできないし、以降は追加預金しないと利子が増えないという制約がある。そして取り出す際は金貨が尻から出る。もちろんガチョウの。\n#～必見！貯蓄型資産運用のすべて～\n"
en: Plushie of Yacatect holding a goose. It is said to be manufactured at the God's official factory. When gold coins are inserted, it speaks and moves its wings. The gold coins are invested by Yacatect, and generate interest at a rate of 10% per 100 days. In exchange for the high interest rate, the coins cannot be taken out until the 100th day, and after that, the interest will not increase unless additional deposits are made. And when you take it out, a gold coin comes out of its butt. The goose's butt, of course. \n# ~Must Watch! Everything About Savings and Asset Management~
en_grezzo: "Plushie of Yacatect holding a goose. It is said to be manufactured at the God's official factory. When gold coins are inserted, it speaks and moves its wings. The gold coins are invested by Yacatect, and generate interest at a rate of 10% per 100 days. In exchange for the high interest rate, the coins cannot be taken out until the 100th day, and after that, the interest will not increase unless additional deposits are made. And when you take it out, a gold coin comes out of its butt. The goose's butt, of course. \n# ~Must Watch! Everything About Savings and Asset Management~"
it: Un pupazzo di Yacatect che tiene in braccio un'oca. Pare che lo facciano in una fabbrica ufficiale degli dei. Se ci metti dentro monete d'oro, muove le ali e parla. Le monete le fa fruttare Yacatect: non al decimo giorno, ma al centesimo... un decimo di interesse ogni cento giorni circa. In cambio del tasso alto non si può né mettere né togliere fino al centesimo giorno, e dopo gli interessi non crescono se non si versa altro. E quando le tiri fuori, le monete escono dal sedere. Dell'oca, s'intende. \n# ~Da Vedere! Tutto sul Risparmio e sugli Investimenti~

jp: \t\t富の女神を模した箱だ。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t富の女神を模した箱だ。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) toy modeled after Goddess of Wealth. May be used periodically.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) toy modeled after Goddess of Wealth. May be used periodically."
it: Riproduce la dea della ricchezza. Si può usare ogni tanto.

jp: \t\tイツパロトルの姿を模した厳かなインテリア。猛る炎の魔神としての側面を強調した作品。敬虔すぎる信者が土下座で頼み込んでイツパロトルの炎を採取し、狂ったように量産したという。魔力を帯びた原初の炎を灯しており、調理の下ごしらえに応用すると呪いも祝福も焼き尽くす。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tイツパロトルの姿を模した厳かなインテリア。猛る炎の魔神としての側面を強調した作品。敬虔すぎる信者が土下座で頼み込んでイツパロトルの炎を採取し、狂ったように量産したという。魔力を帯びた原初の炎を灯しており、調理の下ごしらえに応用すると呪いも祝福も焼き尽くす。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The austere decor that imitates the figure of Itzpalt. It is said that an overly devout believer asked on his knees to collect Itzpalt's flame and mass-produced it like crazy. It is lit by a primordial flame that is charged with magical power, and when applied to the preparation of food, it burns away both curses and blessings. \n# ~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The austere decor that imitates the figure of Itzpalt. It is said that an overly devout believer asked on his knees to collect Itzpalt's flame and mass-produced it like crazy. It is lit by a primordial flame that is charged with magical power, and when applied to the preparation of food, it burns away both curses and blessings. \n# ~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un arredo solenne che riproduce la figura di Itzpalt, e ne accentua il lato di demone del fuoco furioso. Si racconta che un fedele troppo devoto implorò in ginocchio di poter raccogliere la fiamma di Itzpalt, e poi ne fece produzione di massa come un forsennato. Dentro arde la fiamma primordiale carica di magia: applicata alla preparazione dei cibi, brucia via tanto le maledizioni quanto le benedizioni. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t元素の神を模した胸像だ。所持していると自動で使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t元素の神を模した胸像だ。所持していると自動で使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) Bust Statue of the God of Element.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) Bust Statue of the God of Element."
it: Un busto del dio degli elementi. Si usa da sé se lo porti.

jp: \t\t幸運を呼ぶ魚を抱えたエヘカトル…という世にも珍しいシーンを目撃した、無名の画家の作品。興奮した画家は借金してまで大量の版画を作ったが、全く評価されず無名のまま死んでいった。彼の死後、この絵を家に飾っておくと嫌な客が招かれなくなるという事実が明らかになり、再評価の流れがきている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t幸運を呼ぶ魚を抱えたエヘカトル…という世にも珍しいシーンを目撃した、無名の画家の作品。興奮した画家は借金してまで大量の版画を作ったが、全く評価されず無名のまま死んでいった。彼の死後、この絵を家に飾っておくと嫌な客が招かれなくなるという事実が明らかになり、再評価の流れがきている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Ehekatl holding a lucky fish...an unknown painter who witnessed an unusual scene in the world. The artist was so excited that he borrowed money to make a large number of prints, but they were not appreciated at all and he died in obscurity. After his death, it was revealed that if this painting was hung in the house, unwanted guests would no longer be invited, and there has been a trend toward reevaluation of the work. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Ehekatl holding a lucky fish...an unknown painter who witnessed an unusual scene in the world. The artist was so excited that he borrowed money to make a large number of prints, but they were not appreciated at all and he died in obscurity. After his death, it was revealed that if this painting was hung in the house, unwanted guests would no longer be invited, and there has been a trend toward reevaluation of the work. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Opera di un pittore ignoto che assistette a una scena rarissima al mondo: Ehekatl che stringe fra le braccia il pesce che porta fortuna. Entusiasta, l'artista si indebitò per stamparne una gran quantità, ma nessuno le apprezzò e lui morì sconosciuto. Dopo la sua morte si scoprì che questo quadro, appeso in casa, tiene lontani gli ospiti sgraditi, e ora c'è chi lo rivaluta. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t幸運の女神を描いた絵だ。家に置いておくと効果がある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t幸運の女神を描いた絵だ。家に置いておくと効果がある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a painting of Goddess of Luck. Effective when placed in the house.
en_grezzo: "It is a painting of Goddess of Luck. Effective when placed in the house."
it: Un dipinto della dea della fortuna. Fa effetto se sta in casa.

jp: \t\t眠ってから８時間経過すると無理やり起こしてくれる時計。頭を小突くと止まる。かつては秘宝の代わりに信者へ配られていたらしいが、過激なルルウィ信者に奪われて破壊される事件が多発し、生産中止になった。マニアの間ではプレミアがついているが一般人にその価値はわからない。\n#～発見！世界の珍品～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t眠ってから８時間経過すると無理やり起こしてくれる時計。頭を小突くと止まる。かつては秘宝の代わりに信者へ配られていたらしいが、過激なルルウィ信者に奪われて破壊される事件が多発し、生産中止になった。マニアの間ではプレミアがついているが一般人にその価値はわからない。\n#～発見！世界の珍品～\n"
en: A clock that forces you to wake up after 8 hours of sleep. A poke to the head will stop it. It is said that it used to be distributed to believers in place of the hidden treasure, but production was discontinued after many incidents of it being stolen and destroyed by militant Lulwy believers. It has a premium among enthusiasts, but the general public has no idea of its value. \n# ~Discovery! Curiosities of the World~
en_grezzo: "A clock that forces you to wake up after 8 hours of sleep. A poke to the head will stop it. It is said that it used to be distributed to believers in place of the hidden treasure, but production was discontinued after many incidents of it being stolen and destroyed by militant Lulwy believers. It has a premium among enthusiasts, but the general public has no idea of its value. \n# ~Discovery! Curiosities of the World~"
it: Un orologio che, passate otto ore di sonno, sveglia per forza. Si ferma dandogli un colpetto in testa. Pare che un tempo lo distribuissero ai fedeli al posto del tesoro sacro, ma i seguaci più accesi di Lulwy lo rubavano e lo distruggevano di continuo, e la produzione fu sospesa. Fra gli appassionati vale un premio; la gente comune non ne capisce il valore. \n# ~Scoperta! Le Rarità del Mondo~

jp: \t\t機械の神を模した目覚まし時計だ。所持していると自動で使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t機械の神を模した目覚まし時計だ。所持していると自動で使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) alarm clock in the shape of the God of Machine.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) alarm clock in the shape of the God of Machine."
it: Una sveglia del dio delle macchine. Si usa da sé se lo porti.

jp: \t\tスキルを教わる際にプラチナの代わりに使える紙だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tスキルを教わる際にプラチナの代わりに使える紙だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a ticket that can be used instead of platinum when teaching skills.
en_grezzo: "It is a ticket that can be used instead of platinum when teaching skills."
it: Un foglio che sostituisce il platino quando impari un'abilità.

jp: \t\t身に着けると変形して手枷になる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身に着けると変形して手枷になる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a godly gift that when worn, transforms into manacles.
en_grezzo: "It is a godly gift that when worn, transforms into manacles."
it: Se lo indossi, si trasforma in manette.

jp: \t\t鋭い中間素材だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜素材＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鋭い中間素材だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜素材＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a sharp interim material.

jp: \t\t頑丈な中間素材だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜素材＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t頑丈な中間素材だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜素材＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a hard interim material.

jp: \t\t柔らかい中間素材だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜素材＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t柔らかい中間素材だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜素材＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a soft interim material.

jp: \t\t税金を先払いできる紙だ。納税箱に入れて使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t税金を先払いできる紙だ。納税箱に入れて使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Certificate that allows tax to be paid in advance. Pay them at tax boxes.
en_grezzo: "Certificate that allows tax to be paid in advance. Pay them at tax boxes."
it: Paga le tasse in anticipo. Si mette nella cassetta delle tasse.

jp: \t\t血ぬられた小太刀。切腹して詫びながら果てた武士の思念が残っており、握っていると自然と腹に刃が向かう。謝罪する際に使うと相手に本気が伝わると評判。土下座よりもはるかに謝罪力が高く、敵対している相手にもしばらく見逃してもらえる。すぐ手当すれば死にはしない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t血ぬられた小太刀。切腹して詫びながら果てた武士の思念が残っており、握っていると自然と腹に刃が向かう。謝罪する際に使うと相手に本気が伝わると評判。土下座よりもはるかに謝罪力が高く、敵対している相手にもしばらく見逃してもらえる。すぐ手当すれば死にはしない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Bloodstained kodachi, a small dagger. It contains the thoughts of warriors who committed seppuku (ritual suicide) and died with an apology, and when held, the blade will naturally aim at your stomach. When used to apologize, it is reputed to convey one's true intentions to the other party. It has much more apologetic power than the \"Kneeling on the Ground\" method, and even enemies will let you off the hook for a while. If treated immediately, it will not kill you. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Bloodstained kodachi, a small dagger. It contains the thoughts of warriors who committed seppuku (ritual suicide) and died with an apology, and when held, the blade will naturally aim at your stomach. When used to apologize, it is reputed to convey one's true intentions to the other party. It has much more apologetic power than the \"Kneeling on the Ground\" method, and even enemies will let you off the hook for a while. If treated immediately, it will not kill you. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una spada corta insanguinata. Ci resta addosso il pensiero dei guerrieri che se ne sono andati col seppuku, chiedendo scusa, e a tenerla in mano la lama va da sola verso la pancia. Dicono che usarla per scusarsi faccia arrivare all'altro quanto sei serio. Come forza di scusa vale molto più di un inchino a terra, e perfino chi ti è nemico ti lascia in pace per un po'. Se ci si medica subito non si muore. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t切腹用の刀だ。装備できないが何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t切腹用の刀だ。装備できないが何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a sword made for Seppuku. (Reusable) tool that can't be equipped.
en_grezzo: "It is a sword made for Seppuku. (Reusable) tool that can't be equipped."
it: Una spada per il seppuku. Non si equipaggia, ma si usa sempre.

jp: \t\t大豆から作られた加工食品。薄切りのとうふを揚げたもの。超古代からきつねの好物であったがその理由は長らく不明であり、ねずみ肉の代用食という説が一般的であった。近年の研究によって、スポンジ状の内部に魔力の素が含まれていること、きつねが本能的にそれを嗅ぎ付けていることが明らかになった。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大豆から作られた加工食品。薄切りのとうふを揚げたもの。超古代からきつねの好物であったがその理由は長らく不明であり、ねずみ肉の代用食という説が一般的であった。近年の研究によって、スポンジ状の内部に魔力の素が含まれていること、きつねが本能的にそれを嗅ぎ付けていることが明らかになった。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Processed food made from soybeans. It is made by frying thin slices of tofu. It has been a favorite food of foxes since very ancient times, but for a long time the reason for this was unknown, and it was generally believed that it was a substitute for rat meat. Recent research has revealed that the spongy interior contains magical elements and that foxes instinctively sense them.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Processed food made from soybeans. It is made by frying thin slices of tofu. It has been a favorite food of foxes since very ancient times, but for a long time the reason for this was unknown, and it was generally believed that it was a substitute for rat meat. Recent research has revealed that the spongy interior contains magical elements and that foxes instinctively sense them.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un alimento ricavato dalla soia: fette sottili di tofu fritte. Fin dall'antichità remota è il cibo preferito delle volpi, e per molto tempo nessuno seppe perché; si diceva che facesse le veci della carne di topo. Ricerche recenti hanno mostrato che dentro quella pasta spugnosa c'è materia magica, e che le volpi la fiutano d'istinto.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety."

jp: \t\t大豆から作られた加工食品。納豆菌で発酵させたもの。やたらネバネバしており綺麗に食べるにはコツがいる。粘りのほかに独特な臭みもあるので、人にぶっかけるととても怒られる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大豆から作られた加工食品。納豆菌で発酵させたもの。やたらネバネバしており綺麗に食べるにはコツがいる。粘りのほかに独特な臭みもあるので、人にぶっかけるととても怒られる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Processed food made from soybeans. Fermented with natto bacteria. It is very sticky and requires some skill to eat it neatly. In addition to its stickiness, it also has a distinctive smell, and people get very angry if you pour it on them.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Processed food made from soybeans. Fermented with natto bacteria. It is very sticky and requires some skill to eat it neatly. In addition to its stickiness, it also has a distinctive smell, and people get very angry if you pour it on them.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un alimento ricavato dalla soia, fatto fermentare con il bacillo del natto. È di una viscosità tremenda, e mangiarlo con garbo richiede pratica. Oltre a filare ha un odore tutto suo, e a rovesciarlo addosso a qualcuno ci si prende una sfuriata.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t大豆から作られた加工食品。搾り汁を固めたもの。健康な身体を作るのに役立つほか、投げれば角が相手の頭に刺さる。味が既についているタイプなので、醤油をかける必要はない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大豆から作られた加工食品。搾り汁を固めたもの。健康な身体を作るのに役立つほか、投げれば角が相手の頭に刺さる。味が既についているタイプなので、醤油をかける必要はない。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Processed food made from soybeans. Solidified squeezed juice. Besides useful for maintaining a healthy body, the corners will stick into the opponent's head if thrown. It is already flavored, so there is no need to put soy sauce on it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Processed food made from soybeans. Solidified squeezed juice. Besides useful for maintaining a healthy body, the corners will stick into the opponent's head if thrown. It is already flavored, so there is no need to put soy sauce on it.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un alimento ricavato dalla soia, ottenuto rassodandone il latte. Aiuta a farsi un corpo sano e, se lo si tira, lo spigolo si conficca nella testa dell'avversario. È di quelli già conditi: non serve versarci sopra la salsa di soia.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t植物の中では唯一肉に匹敵するだけのタンパク質を含有する存在。そのため畑の肉の異名を持つ。食べてよし、投げてよし。鬼退治にも使えるとかなんとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t植物の中では唯一肉に匹敵するだけのタンパク質を含有する存在。そのため畑の肉の異名を持つ。食べてよし、投げてよし。鬼退治にも使えるとかなんとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: It is the only plant that contains enough protein to rival meat. For this reason, it is nicknamed the meat of the field. It can be eaten or thrown. It is also used to dispel demons and other things.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "It is the only plant that contains enough protein to rival meat. For this reason, it is nicknamed the meat of the field. It can be eaten or thrown. It is also used to dispel demons and other things.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: L'unica pianta che contenga tanta proteina quanta la carne: per questo la chiamano la carne dei campi. Buona da mangiare, buona da tirare. Dicono che serva anche a scacciare i demoni.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t様々な能力を向上させるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t様々な能力を向上させるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that boosts all sorts of abilities.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that boosts all sorts of abilities."
it: Una pozione che migliora attributi di ogni genere.

jp: \t\t耐久と魅力の向上と、麻痺と盲目に耐性を得ることができるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t耐久と魅力の向上と、麻痺と盲目に耐性を得ることができるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that boosts CON & CHA and resists paralysis & blindness.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that boosts CON & CHA and resists paralysis & blindness."
it: Alza costituzione e carisma, e resiste a paralisi e cecità.

jp: \t\t耐久と魅力の向上と、麻痺と盲目に耐性を得る呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t耐久と魅力の向上と、麻痺と盲目に耐性を得る呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 1 Magic. Increases CON/CHR, give resist to Paralysis/Blind.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 1 Magic. Increases CON/CHR, give resist to Paralysis/Blind."
it: Un libro per alzare Cos e Car e resistere a paralisi e cecità.

jp: \t\t敵へひとりでに突撃する翼だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t敵へひとりでに突撃する翼だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are wings that automatically assault the enemy.
en_grezzo: "These are wings that automatically assault the enemy."
it: Delle ali che caricano il nemico da sole.

jp: \t\t乳から作られた加工食品。固形分を取り出して固めてある。保存性が高く、酪農が盛んな地域でよく作られている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t乳から作られた加工食品。固形分を取り出して固めてある。保存性が高く、酪農が盛んな地域でよく作られている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Processed food made from milk. The solids are extracted and hardened. It has a high shelf life and is often produced in areas where dairy farming is popular.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Processed food made from milk. The solids are extracted and hardened. It has a high shelf life and is often produced in areas where dairy farming is popular.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un alimento ricavato dal latte: se ne estrae la parte solida e la si fa rapprendere. Si conserva a lungo, e lo si produce soprattutto dove l'allevamento da latte è fiorente.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t乳から作られた加工食品。分離した脂肪を凝固させたものだが、常温だとべちゃべちゃになる。油の塊みたいなものであり燃えやすいので人にかける時は注意しよう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t乳から作られた加工食品。分離した脂肪を凝固させたものだが、常温だとべちゃべちゃになる。油の塊みたいなものであり燃えやすいので人にかける時は注意しよう。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Processed food made from milk. It is made by coagulating separated fat, but it becomes sticky at room temperature. It is like a lump of oil and is flammable, so be careful when pouring it on people.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Processed food made from milk. It is made by coagulating separated fat, but it becomes sticky at room temperature. It is like a lump of oil and is flammable, so be careful when pouring it on people.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un alimento ricavato dal latte: il grasso separato e fatto rapprendere. A temperatura ambiente si spappola. È in pratica un blocco di unto e prende fuoco con niente, quindi meglio badarci quando lo si rovescia addosso a qualcuno.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t乳から作られた加工食品。特殊な菌で発酵させており、弱い雑菌の繁殖を防ぐため見た目によらず保存性が高い。健康な身体を作るのに役立つが、人にぶっかけるととても怒られる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t乳から作られた加工食品。特殊な菌で発酵させており、弱い雑菌の繁殖を防ぐため見た目によらず保存性が高い。健康な身体を作るのに役立つが、人にぶっかけるととても怒られる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Processed food made from milk. It is fermented with special bacteria, which prevents the growth of weak germs and thus has a high shelf life despite its appearance. It helps to build a healthy body, but people get very angry if you pour it on them.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Processed food made from milk. It is fermented with special bacteria, which prevents the growth of weak germs and thus has a high shelf life despite its appearance. It helps to build a healthy body, but people get very angry if you pour it on them.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un alimento ricavato dal latte, fatto fermentare con fermenti particolari che tengono a bada i germi più deboli: per questo, contro ogni apparenza, si conserva bene. Aiuta a farsi un corpo sano, ma a rovesciarlo addosso a qualcuno ci si prende una sfuriata.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t食品などを砕いて粉粒状にしたもの。カロリーが凝縮されており、少しの満腹感でより太らせる工夫がされている。しかし味や食感は考慮されていない。腹を空かせた家畜にも渡せる。\n#～牧畜と暮らす生活～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食品などを砕いて粉粒状にしたもの。カロリーが凝縮されており、少しの満腹感でより太らせる工夫がされている。しかし味や食感は考慮されていない。腹を空かせた家畜にも渡せる。\n#～牧畜と暮らす生活～\n"
en: Foods and other ingredients are crushed into a powdered granular form. They are concentrated in calories and are designed to make you feel a little fuller and fatter. However, taste and texture are not considered. It can be given to hungry livestock. \n# ~Living with Livestock~
en_grezzo: "Foods and other ingredients are crushed into a powdered granular form. They are concentrated in calories and are designed to make you feel a little fuller and fatter. However, taste and texture are not considered. It can be given to hungry livestock. \n# ~Living with Livestock~"
it: Alimenti e altro tritati fino a ridurli in granuli. Le calorie sono concentrate: sazia poco e fa ingrassare molto, ed è fatto apposta. Al gusto e alla consistenza però non ha pensato nessuno. Si può dare anche al bestiame affamato. \n# ~Vivere Insieme al Bestiame~

jp: \t\t回復効果のあるお茶だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t回復効果のあるお茶だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a tea beverage with health benefits.
en_grezzo: "It is a tea beverage with health benefits."
it: Un tè che ha effetti curativi.

jp: \t\tネフィアへと繋がる龍脈を操作し、ネフィアの難度を変化させる宝玉。決戦因子候補の成長に合わせて調整するためのもの。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tネフィアへと繋がる龍脈を操作し、ネフィアの難度を変化させる宝玉。決戦因子候補の成長に合わせて調整するためのもの。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Treasure that manipulates the dragon vein leading to Nefia and changes the difficulty level of Nefia. Designed to adjust to the growth of the decisive factor candidate. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Treasure that manipulates the dragon vein leading to Nefia and changes the difficulty level of Nefia. Designed to adjust to the growth of the decisive factor candidate. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una gemma che manovra la vena del drago che porta alle Nefia e ne cambia la difficoltà. Serve a regolarla man mano che cresce chi è candidato a Fattore Decisivo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t四角い小盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t四角い小盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a squared small shield.

jp: \t\t存在に耐え切れず砕けた星の欠片。不思議な深い青色の光を放つ。屑扱いされたりもするが、やがて巡り巡って別の星の礎になる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t存在に耐え切れず砕けた星の欠片。不思議な深い青色の光を放つ。屑扱いされたりもするが、やがて巡り巡って別の星の礎になる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A piece of shattered star. They emit a mysterious deep blue light. They are just dust at the beginning, and eventually they will become the foundation of another star. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A piece of shattered star. They emit a mysterious deep blue light. They are just dust at the beginning, and eventually they will become the foundation of another star. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una scheggia di stella che si è spezzata non reggendo più a esistere. Manda una luce azzurra e cupa, misteriosa. C'è chi la tratta da scarto, ma prima o poi, girando di mano in mano, diventa la base di un'altra stella. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tアーティファクトを強化できる星屑だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tアーティファクトを強化できる星屑だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool stardust that enhances an artifact.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool stardust that enhances an artifact."
it: Polvere di stelle che potenzia un artefatto (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t束ねられた生花だ。想いを伝えるために使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t束ねられた生花だ。想いを伝えるために使う。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a bunch of fresh flowers. Used to convey feelings.
en_grezzo: "It is a bunch of fresh flowers. Used to convey feelings."
it: Un mazzo di fiori freschi. Si usa per dire quel che si prova.

jp: \t\tバフを消去する御札だ。投げることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tバフを消去する御札だ。投げることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a thrown talisman that erases buffs.
en_grezzo: "It is a thrown talisman that erases buffs."
it: Un talismano che cancella un potenziamento. Si può lanciare.

jp: \t\t黒曜石を磨いて作られた鏡の盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t黒曜石を磨いて作られた鏡の盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a mirror shield made of polished obsidian.
en_grezzo: "It is a mirror shield made of polished obsidian."
it: Uno scudo a specchio, fatto di ossidiana levigata.

jp: \t\t生化学文明時代の禁忌の装置。構成材料を対象から無理矢理採取して高速培養、三次元スキャンデータを元に複製人間を作り出す。現代では専用の材料転送設備が残存していないため、命が宿らずガワだけの肉塊になってしまうし、装置自体も実質使い捨て。それでも一部のマニアの間ではく製メーカーとして使われている。本人に無断で使うと怒られるので気をつけよう。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t生化学文明時代の禁忌の装置。構成材料を対象から無理矢理採取して高速培養、三次元スキャンデータを元に複製人間を作り出す。現代では専用の材料転送設備が残存していないため、命が宿らずガワだけの肉塊になってしまうし、装置自体も実質使い捨て。それでも一部のマニアの間ではく製メーカーとして使われている。本人に無断で使うと怒られるので気をつけよう。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"
en: Forbidden device in the era of biochemical civilization. It forcibly extracts the constituent materials from the subject, cultivates them at high speed, and creates a duplicate human being based on the scan data. Since there are no dedicated material transfer facilities left today, the human is reduced to a lump of flesh with no life in it, and the device itself is practically disposable. It is still used by some enthusiasts as a fabricator. Be careful not to use it without the person's permission, as it will make them angry. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~
en_grezzo: "Forbidden device in the era of biochemical civilization. It forcibly extracts the constituent materials from the subject, cultivates them at high speed, and creates a duplicate human being based on the scan data. Since there are no dedicated material transfer facilities left today, the human is reduced to a lump of flesh with no life in it, and the device itself is practically disposable. It is still used by some enthusiasts as a fabricator. Be careful not to use it without the person's permission, as it will make them angry. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: L'apparecchio proibito dell'età della civiltà biochimica. Strappa a forza dal soggetto la materia che lo compone, la fa crescere in fretta e, sui dati di una scansione in tre dimensioni, ne cava una copia umana. Oggi gli impianti che trasferivano la materia non ci sono più, quindi ne esce solo un pezzo di carne senza vita dentro, e l'apparecchio stesso è di fatto usa e getta. Con tutto ciò, fra certi appassionati va come macchina per statuette. Attenzione: se lo usi su qualcuno senza il suo permesso, si arrabbia. \n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\tはく製を作り出す装置だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tはく製を作り出す装置だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that 3d-prints target with biological materials.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that 3d-prints target with biological materials."
it: Un apparecchio che fa statuette. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t環境に負けず咲き続けるすごい花。生化学文明の技術で枯れないように改良されたものが野生化したらしい。観賞用以外に学術的にもある程度の価値がある。元は古代の植物だったらしいが、生命力が強くなりすぎてしまった感がある。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t環境に負けず咲き続けるすごい花。生化学文明の技術で枯れないように改良されたものが野生化したらしい。観賞用以外に学術的にもある程度の価値がある。元は古代の植物だったらしいが、生命力が強くなりすぎてしまった感がある。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Impressive flower that continues to bloom regardless of its environment. It is said that it was improved by the technology of biochemical civilization so that it would not wither, and then it spread into the wild. Besides being ornamental, it has a certain amount of academic value. Although it is an ancient plant, it seems to have developed strong vitality. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Impressive flower that continues to bloom regardless of its environment. It is said that it was improved by the technology of biochemical civilization so that it would not wither, and then it spread into the wild. Besides being ornamental, it has a certain amount of academic value. Although it is an ancient plant, it seems to have developed strong vitality. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Un fiore straordinario, che continua a fiorire qualunque cosa gli capiti intorno. Pare che la tecnica della civiltà biochimica lo avesse migliorato perché non appassisse, e che poi sia tornato allo stato selvatico. Oltre che ornamentale ha un certo valore per gli studiosi. All'origine era una pianta antica, ma la forza vitale gli è cresciuta troppo. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t観賞用の植物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜植物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t観賞用の植物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜植物＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t使い捨ての研磨剤や補修材、細工道具をまとめたもの。説明書付き。少数の丘の民が細々と販売している。目に見えないほどの細かい破損やズレを修復し、武具の性能を最大限に引き出す。さすがに激しい錆などはお手上げなので別の方法を考えよう。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使い捨ての研磨剤や補修材、細工道具をまとめたもの。説明書付き。少数の丘の民が細々と販売している。目に見えないほどの細かい破損やズレを修復し、武具の性能を最大限に引き出す。さすがに激しい錆などはお手上げなので別の方法を考えよう。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n"
en: A collection of disposable abrasives, repair materials, and crafting tools. Comes with instructions. Sold in small quantities by a small number of hill people. Repairing invisible minor damages and misalignments to maximize the performance of the armor. As expected, heavy rust and the like cannot be helped, and we will need some other method. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~
en_grezzo: "A collection of disposable abrasives, repair materials, and crafting tools. Comes with instructions. Sold in small quantities by a small number of hill people. Repairing invisible minor damages and misalignments to maximize the performance of the armor. As expected, heavy rust and the like cannot be helped, and we will need some other method. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~"
it: Un insieme di paste abrasive usa e getta, materiali da riparo e attrezzi da lavoro fine. Con le istruzioni. Lo vende in piccola quantità un pugno di gente delle colline. Ripara le rotture e gli scarti minimi, quelli che l'occhio non vede, e tira fuori il meglio da armi e armature. Contro una ruggine forte non c'è niente da fare: meglio cercare un'altra strada. \n# ~Scegliere Bene gli Attrezzi da Artigiano~

jp: \t\t装備の本来の能力を引き出す道具だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t装備の本来の能力を引き出す道具だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that brings out the true potential of t equipment.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that brings out the true potential of t equipment."
it: Tira fuori le vere doti dell'equipaggiamento (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t開けることができない箱だ。投げることはできる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t開けることができない箱だ。投げることはできる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a box that can't be opened. But it can be thrown.
en_grezzo: "It is a box that can't be opened. But it can be thrown."
it: Una scatola che non si può aprire. Ma si può lanciare.

jp: \t\t軽量な青い戦斧だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t軽量な青い戦斧だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a lightweight blue battle axe.
en_grezzo: "It is a lightweight blue battle axe."
it: Un'ascia da battaglia azzurra e leggera.

jp: \t\t摘み取った葉っぱ。発酵のさせ方によって異なる色や風味が表れる。茶の材料として世界中で重宝されている。一応そのまま食べることもできるが…。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t摘み取った葉っぱ。発酵のさせ方によって異なる色や風味が表れる。茶の材料として世界中で重宝されている。一応そのまま食べることもできるが…。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: Plucked leaves. Different colors and flavors appear depending on how they are fermented. They are used worldwide as an ingredient in tea. It can also be eaten as is... \n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "Plucked leaves. Different colors and flavors appear depending on how they are fermented. They are used worldwide as an ingredient in tea. It can also be eaten as is... \n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: Foglie appena colte. A seconda di come le si fa fermentare cambiano colore e profumo. In tutto il mondo sono preziose come materia prima del tè. Mangiarle così come sono si può, volendo... \n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\tコーヒーの原料。元々は加熱しなければ化学変化が起きず、まともな香りや味が出なかったらしい。しかし現在栽培されている品種は、いずれも改良によって収穫段階から化学変化を起こしているため、加熱処理が不要となっている。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tコーヒーの原料。元々は加熱しなければ化学変化が起きず、まともな香りや味が出なかったらしい。しかし現在栽培されている品種は、いずれも改良によって収穫段階から化学変化を起こしているため、加熱処理が不要となっている。\n#～飲めるのみもの、飲めないのみもの～\n"
en: The raw material for coffee. Originally, it was said that it had to be heated to undergo chemical changes and produce a proper aroma and taste. However, the varieties grown today all undergo chemical changes from the harvest stage due to improvements, so heat treatment is no longer necessary. \n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~
en_grezzo: "The raw material for coffee. Originally, it was said that it had to be heated to undergo chemical changes and produce a proper aroma and taste. However, the varieties grown today all undergo chemical changes from the harvest stage due to improvements, so heat treatment is no longer necessary. \n# ~Drinks to Drink, Drinks Not to Drink~"
it: La materia prima del caffè. In origine, pare, senza cottura non avveniva nessuna trasformazione chimica e non ne uscivano né aroma né sapore decenti. Le varietà coltivate oggi però sono tutte migliorate, e la trasformazione comincia già alla raccolta: tostarle non serve più. \n# ~Bevande da Bere e Bevande da Non Bere~

jp: \t\t本来は湿った土地向きの穀物なのだが、乾燥耐性を強化されており畑地で放置していてもよく育つ。むしろ、過剰な水分を与えると栽培の手間と難度が増すのだとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t本来は湿った土地向きの穀物なのだが、乾燥耐性を強化されており畑地で放置していてもよく育つ。むしろ、過剰な水分を与えると栽培の手間と難度が増すのだとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Although it is originally suited for wet areas, it has been enhanced for drought tolerance and grows well even when left in the field. In fact, excessive moisture increases the time and difficulty of cultivation.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Although it is originally suited for wet areas, it has been enhanced for drought tolerance and grows well even when left in the field. In fact, excessive moisture increases the time and difficulty of cultivation.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Di suo è un cereale da terreni umidi, ma è stato reso resistente alla siccità e cresce bene anche lasciato in un campo qualunque. Anzi, dargli troppa acqua non fa che aumentare la fatica e la difficoltà della coltivazione.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t品種改良によって小麦と大麦の特性を併せ持った穀物。現代で流通している小麦粉の８０％は、純粋な小麦ではなくこちらから製粉されている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t品種改良によって小麦と大麦の特性を併せ持った穀物。現代で流通している小麦粉の８０％は、純粋な小麦ではなくこちらから製粉されている。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: This grain combines the characteristics of wheat and barley through breeding. 80% of the flour distributed today is milled from here, instead of pure wheat.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "This grain combines the characteristics of wheat and barley through breeding. 80% of the flour distributed today is milled from here, instead of pure wheat.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un cereale che, per selezione, unisce le qualità del frumento e dell'orzo. L'80% della farina che oggi circola non viene dal frumento puro, ma da lui.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける基本的調味料の一つ。独特の香りのある、赤褐色の液体。塩辛さの中に濃厚な旨味と甘味を持つ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける基本的調味料の一つ。独特の香りのある、赤褐色の液体。塩辛さの中に濃厚な旨味と甘味を持つ。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: One of the basic seasonings that can make or break a dish. This reddish-brown liquid has a distinct aroma. Its salty flavor carries undertones of rich umami and sweetness.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris～\n
en_grezzo: "One of the basic seasonings that can make or break a dish. This reddish-brown liquid has a distinct aroma. Its salty flavor carries undertones of rich umami and sweetness.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris～\n"
it: Uno dei condimenti di base, di quelli che decidono se un piatto riesce o no. Un liquido rosso-bruno dall'odore inconfondibile. Sotto il salato ha un sapore pieno e dolce.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t調味料だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜調味料＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t調味料だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜調味料＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) Seasoning. Some pour these on livestocks before slaughter.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) Seasoning. Some pour these on livestocks before slaughter."
it: Un condimento. Si può usare (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける調味料の一つであり、代表的なスパイス。かつては食料の長期保存に重宝され、高額で取引されていた時代もあった。肉との相性がよい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理の善し悪しを決定づける調味料の一つであり、代表的なスパイス。かつては食料の長期保存に重宝され、高額で取引されていた時代もあった。肉との相性がよい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A typical example of a spice, it's one of the seasonings that can make or break a dish. It was once treasured for its preservative properties and fetched a high price at market. Goes well on meat.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~\n
en_grezzo: "A typical example of a spice, it's one of the seasonings that can make or break a dish. It was once treasured for its preservative properties and fetched a high price at market. Goes well on meat.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~\n"
it: Uno dei condimenti che decidono se un piatto riesce o no, e la spezia per eccellenza. Un tempo era preziosa per conservare a lungo il cibo, e c'è stata un'epoca in cui si vendeva a caro prezzo. Sta bene con la carne.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\tたまに遺跡から専用の火薬玉と一緒に見つかる筒。殺傷力を重視していないこと、真上にしか撃てないことから、専門家は当時における信号弾ではないかと考えている。爆発がなかなか綺麗なため、近年では祭りの際に観賞用として使われることがある。\n#～古代道具の謎に迫る！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tたまに遺跡から専用の火薬玉と一緒に見つかる筒。殺傷力を重視していないこと、真上にしか撃てないことから、専門家は当時における信号弾ではないかと考えている。爆発がなかなか綺麗なため、近年では祭りの際に観賞用として使われることがある。\n#～古代道具の謎に迫る！～\n"
en: A cylinder that is sometimes found in archaeological sites along with a special gunpowder ball. Because it does not emphasize killing power, and it can only be shot straight up, experts believe that it may have been a signal bullet in those days. Because the explosion is quite beautiful, it is sometimes used as an ornamental object during festivals in recent years. \n# ~Mystery of the Ancient Tools!~
en_grezzo: "A cylinder that is sometimes found in archaeological sites along with a special gunpowder ball. Because it does not emphasize killing power, and it can only be shot straight up, experts believe that it may have been a signal bullet in those days. Because the explosion is quite beautiful, it is sometimes used as an ornamental object during festivals in recent years. \n# ~Mystery of the Ancient Tools!~"
it: Un tubo che ogni tanto si trova nelle rovine insieme alle sue palle di polvere. Visto che non punta a ferire e che spara solo dritto in alto, gli esperti pensano fosse un razzo di segnale dell'epoca. Lo scoppio è piuttosto bello, e negli ultimi anni lo si usa alle feste per far spettacolo. \n# ~All'Inseguimento del Mistero degli Arnesi Antichi!~

jp: \t\t火薬の玉を打ち上げる筒だ。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t火薬の玉を打ち上げる筒だ。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that launches a ball of gunpowder.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that launches a ball of gunpowder."
it: Spara in aria palle di polvere. Si può usare più volte.

jp: \t\t黄衣の王に仕える飛行生物の成れの果て。主のために運び屋をやったり演奏したり蜂蜜酒を造ったり…とご奉仕大好き生物だったが、それでも飽き足らず自らおつまみの干し肉になった。お酒によく合う。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t黄衣の王に仕える飛行生物の成れの果て。主のために運び屋をやったり演奏したり蜂蜜酒を造ったり…とご奉仕大好き生物だったが、それでも飽き足らず自らおつまみの干し肉になった。お酒によく合う。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: The final form of a flying creature serving the King in Yellow. It was working as a courier, playing music, making honey wine, etc., but it was not satisfied with that and became dried meat on it's own will. It goes well with alcohol.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "The final form of a flying creature serving the King in Yellow. It was working as a courier, playing music, making honey wine, etc., but it was not satisfied with that and became dried meat on it's own will. It goes well with alcohol.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Quel che resta di una creatura alata al servizio del Re in Giallo. Per il suo signore faceva il corriere, suonava, produceva idromele... amava servire più di ogni altra cosa, e non contenta si è fatta carne secca da accompagnare al bere. Va benissimo con l'alcol.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t邪悪な鎌だ。使うことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t邪悪な鎌だ。使うことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Una falce malvagia. Si può usare.

jp: \t\tタバコの吸い殻だ。投げると発火する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜廃品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tタバコの吸い殻だ。投げると発火する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜廃品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are cigarette butts that ignites when thrown.
en_grezzo: "These are cigarette butts that ignites when thrown."
it: Un mozzicone di sigaretta. Lanciato, prende fuoco.

jp: \t\t喫煙用パイプの亜種。パイプとは対照的に、香料を用いずに一息で煙を吸い切る。魅力を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t喫煙用パイプの亜種。パイプとは対照的に、香料を用いずに一息で煙を吸い切る。魅力を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n"
en: A variant of the smoking pipe. In contrast to the pipe, the smoke is inhaled in a single breath without the use of flavoring. It contains ingredients thats beneficial to the skin, and activate brain cells, and make it possible to tolerate light sleepiness. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~
en_grezzo: "A variant of the smoking pipe. In contrast to the pipe, the smoke is inhaled in a single breath without the use of flavoring. It contains ingredients thats beneficial to the skin, and activate brain cells, and make it possible to tolerate light sleepiness. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~"
it: Una variante della pipa da fumo. Al contrario della pipa, il fumo si tira tutto in un fiato, senza aromi. Contiene sostanze che fanno crescere l'attributo Carisma, e in più risveglia le cellule del cervello, così si regge un po' di sonnolenza. Attento però: c'è il rischio di prenderci il vizio, quindi con moderazione. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~

jp: \t\t喫煙道具だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜嗜好品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t喫煙道具だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜嗜好品＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un attrezzo per fumare. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t木製の喫煙具。タバコの葉を刻んで詰めるのだが、そこに薬草等の香料をブレンドして楽しむ。紙巻に比べるとゆっくりとタバコを味わうのに向いている。習得を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t木製の喫煙具。タバコの葉を刻んで詰めるのだが、そこに薬草等の香料をブレンドして楽しむ。紙巻に比べるとゆっくりとタバコを味わうのに向いている。習得を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n"
en: Wooden smoking utensil. Tobacco leaves are chopped and packed, and then blended with herbs and other flavoring agents. Compared to paper cigars, it is better suited for slowing down and savoring tobacco. It contains ingredients that help grow mastery, activates brain cells, and makes light drowsiness tolerable. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~
en_grezzo: "Wooden smoking utensil. Tobacco leaves are chopped and packed, and then blended with herbs and other flavoring agents. Compared to paper cigars, it is better suited for slowing down and savoring tobacco. It contains ingredients that help grow mastery, activates brain cells, and makes light drowsiness tolerable. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~"
it: Un attrezzo da fumo di legno. Ci si trita e ci si pigia dentro la foglia di tabacco, e ci si mescola per gusto un aroma di erbe. Rispetto alla sigaretta è fatta per gustare il tabacco con calma. Contiene sostanze che fanno crescere l'attributo Apprendimento, e in più risveglia le cellule del cervello, così si regge un po' di sonnolenza. Attento però: c'è il rischio di prenderci il vizio, quindi con moderazione. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~

jp: \t\tタバコの葉を筒状に巻いたもの。本来は刃物で先端を切って使うのだが、面倒くさがりな人用に手でも切れるように加工されている。器用を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tタバコの葉を筒状に巻いたもの。本来は刃物で先端を切って使うのだが、面倒くさがりな人用に手でも切れるように加工されている。器用を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n"
en: Tobacco leaf rolled into a cylindrical shape. Originally, the tip is cut off with a knife, but for those who are lazy, it has been processed so that it can be cut by hand. In addition to containing ingredients that help develop dexterity, it also activates brain cells and makes it possible to tolerate light sleepiness. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~
en_grezzo: "Tobacco leaf rolled into a cylindrical shape. Originally, the tip is cut off with a knife, but for those who are lazy, it has been processed so that it can be cut by hand. In addition to containing ingredients that help develop dexterity, it also activates brain cells and makes it possible to tolerate light sleepiness. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~"
it: Foglia di tabacco arrotolata a tubo. In origine la punta si taglia con una lama, ma per chi ha poca voglia l'hanno lavorata in modo da poterla staccare a mano. Contiene sostanze che fanno crescere l'attributo Destrezza, e in più risveglia le cellule del cervello, così si regge un po' di sonnolenza. Attento però: c'è il rischio di prenderci il vizio, quindi con moderazione. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~

jp: \t\tタバコの葉を刻んで紙で巻いたもの。着火剤がついており、特に着火装置なしでも発火させることができる。感覚を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tタバコの葉を刻んで紙で巻いたもの。着火剤がついており、特に着火装置なしでも発火させることができる。感覚を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n"
en: A tobacco leaf is chopped and rolled up in paper. It has an igniter and can be ignited without any particular ignition device. It contains ingredients that grow the senses, activate brain cells, and make it possible to tolerate light drowsiness. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~
en_grezzo: "A tobacco leaf is chopped and rolled up in paper. It has an igniter and can be ignited without any particular ignition device. It contains ingredients that grow the senses, activate brain cells, and make it possible to tolerate light drowsiness. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~"
it: Foglia di tabacco tritata e arrotolata nella carta. Ha già l'innesco, e si accende anche senza un accendino. Contiene sostanze che fanno crescere l'attributo Percezione, e in più risveglia le cellule del cervello, così si regge un po' di sonnolenza. Attento però: c'è il rischio di prenderci il vizio, quindi con moderazione. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~

jp: \t\t依存性のある植物の葉だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜嗜好品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t依存性のある植物の葉だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜嗜好品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) medicinal tool that is highly addictive.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) medicinal tool that is highly addictive."
it: Foglie di una pianta che dà dipendenza. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t杖に偽装した戦槌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t杖に偽装した戦槌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a war hammer disguised as a staff.
en_grezzo: "It is a war hammer disguised as a staff."
it: Un martello da guerra travestito da bastone.

jp: \t\t赤みのかかった硬貨だ。特定のサービスを受けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜貨幣＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t赤みのかかった硬貨だ。特定のサービスを受けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜貨幣＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are red coins used for special services.
en_grezzo: "These are red coins used for special services."
it: Una moneta rossastra. Dà diritto a certi servizi.

jp: \t\t白昼夢から覚めた少女がいつの間にか握っていたとかいう、不思議なキノコを使用したスープ。絶妙な割合でブレンドされており、食べると体が大きくなったり小さくなったりする。妙な色をしているが味はそこそこ。食べ続けた者はその少女と同じ体格に近づいていくとされる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t白昼夢から覚めた少女がいつの間にか握っていたとかいう、不思議なキノコを使用したスープ。絶妙な割合でブレンドされており、食べると体が大きくなったり小さくなったりする。妙な色をしているが味はそこそこ。食べ続けた者はその少女と同じ体格に近づいていくとされる。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: This soup is made from a mysterious mushroom held by a girl who woke up from a daydream. It is blended in a perfect ratio, and when eaten, your body grows larger or smaller. It has a strange color, but the taste is good. It is said that those who continue to eat it will grow to the same size as the girl.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "This soup is made from a mysterious mushroom held by a girl who woke up from a daydream. It is blended in a perfect ratio, and when eaten, your body grows larger or smaller. It has a strange color, but the taste is good. It is said that those who continue to eat it will grow to the same size as the girl.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una zuppa fatta con i funghi misteriosi che una bambina, svegliandosi da un sogno a occhi aperti, si ritrovò in mano senza sapere come. Il dosaggio è perfetto: a mangiarla il corpo si fa più grande o più piccolo. Ha un colore strano, ma il sapore non è male. Si dice che chi continua a mangiarne finisca per avvicinarsi alla corporatura di quella bambina.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「昨日になんて戻れない。だって昨日の私は別人だもの」\n#～少女の寝言～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「昨日になんて戻れない。だって昨日の私は別人だもの」\n#～少女の寝言～\n"
en: \"I can't go back to yesterday. Because I'm not the same person I was yesterday.\" \n# ~a Little Girl's Bedtime Story~
en_grezzo: "\"I can't go back to yesterday. Because I'm not the same person I was yesterday.\" \n# ~a Little Girl's Bedtime Story~"
it: \"A ieri non posso tornare. La me di ieri era un'altra persona\" \n# ~Le Parole nel Sonno di una Bambina~

jp: \t\tおぞましい骨弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tおぞましい骨弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a terrifying bone bow.
it: Un arco d'ossa che fa ribrezzo.

jp: \t\t電撃も放てる斬弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t電撃も放てる斬弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a slashing bow that can also release electric shocks.
en_grezzo: "It is a slashing bow that can also release electric shocks."
it: Un arco tagliente che scaglia anche fulmini.

jp: \t\t一部技能の参照属性を変える道具だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一部技能の参照属性を変える道具だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) belt buckle that changes one's attribute of some skills.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) belt buckle that changes one's attribute of some skills."
it: Cambia l'attributo di certe abilità. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t臭気を放つ揮発性の油だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t臭気を放つ揮発性の油だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is volatile oil that gives off an odor.
en_grezzo: "It is volatile oil that gives off an odor."
it: Un olio volatile che manda cattivo odore.

jp: \t\t植物産の揮発性の油だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t植物産の揮発性の油だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is some plant-based volatile oil.
it: Un olio volatile di origine vegetale.

jp: \t\t渦を発生させる鎖鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t渦を発生させる鎖鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a vortex-generating chain scythe.
it: Una falce a catena che leva vortici.

jp: \t\tＰＶＤＶ属性のボルトを唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tＰＶＤＶ属性のボルトを唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 5 Magic. Bolt type spell that does physical damage.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 5 Magic. Bolt type spell that does physical damage."
it: Un libro per una saetta di tipo PV/DV. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\t振ることでＰＶＤＶ属性の範囲攻撃を発動する魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t振ることでＰＶＤＶ属性の範囲攻撃を発動する魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a rod that, when zapped, unleash an area-of-effect physical attack.
en_grezzo: "It is a rod that, when zapped, unleash an area-of-effect physical attack."
it: Una bacchetta che, agitata, fa un attacco ad area di tipo PV/DV.

jp: \t\t核ロケット弾を発射する兵器。前線での使用・ピンポイントな対象の破壊を想定しており、射程距離と爆破範囲はかなり控えめ。しかし範囲当たりの威力はむしろ高められているので、巻き込まれないよう注意する必要がある。再装填できず砲身強度的にも使い捨て。重量的に個人携行は大変なので、普通は車両などに積む。\n#～君にも使える！発掘兵器～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t核ロケット弾を発射する兵器。前線での使用・ピンポイントな対象の破壊を想定しており、射程距離と爆破範囲はかなり控えめ。しかし範囲当たりの威力はむしろ高められているので、巻き込まれないよう注意する必要がある。再装填できず砲身強度的にも使い捨て。重量的に個人携行は大変なので、普通は車両などに積む。\n#～君にも使える！発掘兵器～\n"
en: A weapon that fires nuclear rockets. Intended for front-line use and pinpoint target destruction, the range and blast radius are quite modest. However, the power per range is rather enhanced, so care must be taken not to get caught in the middle. It cannot be reloaded and is disposable in terms of barrel strength. Since it is too heavy to be carried individually, it is usually carried in a vehicle. \n# ~You Can Use it too! Excavated Weapons~
en_grezzo: "A weapon that fires nuclear rockets. Intended for front-line use and pinpoint target destruction, the range and blast radius are quite modest. However, the power per range is rather enhanced, so care must be taken not to get caught in the middle. It cannot be reloaded and is disposable in terms of barrel strength. Since it is too heavy to be carried individually, it is usually carried in a vehicle. \n# ~You Can Use it too! Excavated Weapons~"
it: Un'arma che spara razzi nucleari. È pensata per la prima linea e per distruggere un bersaglio preciso, quindi la gittata e il raggio dello scoppio sono piuttosto contenuti. La forza per area però è alzata, e bisogna stare attenti a non restarci dentro. Non si ricarica, e per come regge la canna è comunque usa e getta. Col peso che ha, portarla addosso è dura: di solito la si carica su un veicolo. \n# ~Puoi Usarle Anche Tu! Le Armi Riesumate~

jp: \t\t戦術核兵器だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜特殊兵器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t戦術核兵器だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜特殊兵器＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un'arma nucleare tattica. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t４つの砲身から焼夷ロケット弾を一発ずつ発射する携行兵器。大幅に改良されており短距離での命中精度が高い。混合された特殊な燃焼剤は発熱が凄まじく、飛び散った飛沫を直接浴びると大火傷を引き起こす。一面を焼き払える火力を持つが、かさばるのでイェルスではほとんど使用されていない。その形状のせいでどっちから弾が出るのか、たまに間違えられることがある。\n#～君にも使える！発掘兵器～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t４つの砲身から焼夷ロケット弾を一発ずつ発射する携行兵器。大幅に改良されており短距離での命中精度が高い。混合された特殊な燃焼剤は発熱が凄まじく、飛び散った飛沫を直接浴びると大火傷を引き起こす。一面を焼き払える火力を持つが、かさばるのでイェルスではほとんど使用されていない。その形状のせいでどっちから弾が出るのか、たまに間違えられることがある。\n#～君にも使える！発掘兵器～\n"
en: This is a portable weapon that fires incendiary rockets from four barrels, one at a time. It has been greatly improved and has high accuracy at short distances. The special combustion agent mixed with the rockets generates a tremendous amount of heat, and direct exposure to the flying droplets can cause severe burns. Although it has the firepower to burn an entire area, it is bulky and is rarely used in the Yerles military. Because of its shape, it is sometimes mistaken as to which side the shell comes out from. \n# ~You Can Use it too! Excavated Weapons~
en_grezzo: "This is a portable weapon that fires incendiary rockets from four barrels, one at a time. It has been greatly improved and has high accuracy at short distances. The special combustion agent mixed with the rockets generates a tremendous amount of heat, and direct exposure to the flying droplets can cause severe burns. Although it has the firepower to burn an entire area, it is bulky and is rarely used in the Yerles military. Because of its shape, it is sometimes mistaken as to which side the shell comes out from. \n# ~You Can Use it too! Excavated Weapons~"
it: Un'arma portatile che spara razzi incendiari uno alla volta da quattro canne. È molto migliorata, e sulla distanza corta è precisa. La miscela speciale che ci bruciano dentro scalda in modo tremendo, e gli schizzi addosso danno ustioni gravi. Ha fuoco da bruciare un'intera area, ma è ingombrante e fra gli Yerles non la usa quasi nessuno. Per la forma che ha, ogni tanto ci si sbaglia su da che parte esca il colpo. \n# ~Puoi Usarle Anche Tu! Le Armi Riesumate~

jp: \t\t「敵に向けて撃ってください」\n#～添えられた説明書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「敵に向けて撃ってください」\n#～添えられた説明書～\n"
it: \"Sparare in direzione del nemico.\" \n# ~Il Foglietto delle Istruzioni Allegato~

jp: \t\t狙った対象の周囲を焼き尽くす兵器だ。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜特殊兵器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t狙った対象の周囲を焼き尽くす兵器だ。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜特殊兵器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that burns down the area around the target it's aimed at.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that burns down the area around the target it's aimed at."
it: Incendia tutto intorno al bersaglio. Si può usare più volte.

jp: \t\t過去の文明で使われていたとされる対戦車ロケット砲。横風に強い特殊ロケット推進により、命中精度は高い。成型炸薬弾頭が装甲や金属製の鎧に穴を開けて爆風を流し込み、ダメージを与える。装弾数の割に重いのが難点。\n#～君にも使える！発掘兵器～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t過去の文明で使われていたとされる対戦車ロケット砲。横風に強い特殊ロケット推進により、命中精度は高い。成型炸薬弾頭が装甲や金属製の鎧に穴を開けて爆風を流し込み、ダメージを与える。装弾数の割に重いのが難点。\n#～君にも使える！発掘兵器～\n"
en: An anti-tank rocket launcher believed to have been used by past civilizations. Its special rocket propulsion, which is resistant to crosswinds, provides high accuracy. Molded explosive warheads penetrate armor and metal armor to channel the blast and inflict damage. Its disadvantage is that it is heavy for the number of rounds it can carry. \n# ~You Can Use it too! Excavated Weapons~
en_grezzo: "An anti-tank rocket launcher believed to have been used by past civilizations. Its special rocket propulsion, which is resistant to crosswinds, provides high accuracy. Molded explosive warheads penetrate armor and metal armor to channel the blast and inflict damage. Its disadvantage is that it is heavy for the number of rounds it can carry. \n# ~You Can Use it too! Excavated Weapons~"
it: Un lanciarazzi anticarro che, dicono, si usava nelle civiltà passate. La spinta speciale del razzo tiene bene il vento di lato, e il tiro è preciso. La testata a carica cava buca la corazza e le armature di metallo, ci infila dentro lo scoppio e fa danno. Il difetto è che pesa molto per quanti colpi porta. \n# ~Puoi Usarle Anche Tu! Le Armi Riesumate~

jp: \t\t狙った対象のＰＶを一時的に下げる兵器だ。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜特殊兵器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t狙った対象のＰＶを一時的に下げる兵器だ。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜特殊兵器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) weapon that temporarily lowers the PV of a target.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) weapon that temporarily lowers the PV of a target."
it: Abbassa per un po' il PV del bersaglio. Si usa più volte.

jp: \t\t薄手ながらもフワフワの毛布。心地よい眠りを提供するが、朝起きるのがつらくなる。非常につらくなる。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t薄手ながらもフワフワの毛布。心地よい眠りを提供するが、朝起きるのがつらくなる。非常につらくなる。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n"
en: A thin but fluffy blanket. Provides a comfortable sleep, but makes it hard to get up in the morning. VERY hard. \n# ~Palmian Winter Fashion~
en_grezzo: "A thin but fluffy blanket. Provides a comfortable sleep, but makes it hard to get up in the morning. VERY hard. \n# ~Palmian Winter Fashion~"
it: Una coperta sottile e però soffice. Fa dormire bene, ma alzarsi la mattina diventa dura. Molto dura. \n# ~Palmia: Collezione Autunno-Inverno~

jp: \t\t「そろそろ起きて朝ごはん作らなきゃ…それに昨夜作った手袋の仕上げも…。ダメ…眠い…もうちょっと…もうちょっとだけ寝よう」\n#～ブランケットにくるまった少女の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「そろそろ起きて朝ごはん作らなきゃ…それに昨夜作った手袋の仕上げも…。ダメ…眠い…もうちょっと…もうちょっとだけ寝よう」\n#～ブランケットにくるまった少女の言葉～\n"
en: \"I have to get up and make breakfast soon...and finish the gloves I made last night... No... I'm sleepy...I'll sleep a little longer...... just a little more.\" \n# ~words of a girl wrapped in a blanket~
en_grezzo: "\"I have to get up and make breakfast soon...and finish the gloves I made last night... No... I'm sleepy...I'll sleep a little longer...... just a little more.\" \n# ~words of a girl wrapped in a blanket~"
it: \"Ora devo alzarmi e fare colazione... e finire i guanti di ieri sera... No... ho sonno... ancora un po'... solo un altro pochino.\" \n# ~Parole di una Bambina Avvolta in una Coperta~

jp: \t\t持たせた仲間が早起きできなくなるブランケットだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t持たせた仲間が早起きできなくなるブランケットだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a blanket that prevents allies from getting up early.
en_grezzo: "It is a blanket that prevents allies from getting up early."
it: Il compagno che la porta non riesce più ad alzarsi presto.

jp: \t\t振ることで対象に魔法属性のボルトを放つ魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t振ることで対象に魔法属性のボルトを放つ魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a rod that, when zapped, unleashes a beam of magical torrent.
en_grezzo: "It is a rod that, when zapped, unleashes a beam of magical torrent."
it: Una bacchetta che, agitata, tira una saetta arcana.

jp: \t\t振ることで毒属性の範囲攻撃を発動する魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t振ることで毒属性の範囲攻撃を発動する魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a rod that, when zapped, unleashes an area-of-effect poison attack.
en_grezzo: "It is a rod that, when zapped, unleashes an area-of-effect poison attack."
it: Una bacchetta che, agitata, fa un attacco ad area di veleno.

jp: \t\t精神面を強化する球体だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t精神面を強化する球体だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a sphere that strengthen the spiritual aspect of the body.
en_grezzo: "It is a sphere that strengthen the spiritual aspect of the body."
it: Una sfera che rinforza lo spirito.

jp: \t\t何度でも読むことができる。読んでも研究員はペットにならない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何度でも読むことができる。読んでも研究員はペットにならない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Readable) report, it won't make you a real researcher.
en_grezzo: "(Readable) report, it won't make you a real researcher."
it: Si può rileggere sempre. Il ricercatore non diventa un compagno.

jp: \t\t使い捨ての薬品や医療器具を収納した道具箱。使用者の器用さと生化学の知識に応じて傷を回復することができる。また、麻痺、盲目、毒、出血の症状を大幅に軽減する。\n#～家庭でできる応急処置～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使い捨ての薬品や医療器具を収納した道具箱。使用者の器用さと生化学の知識に応じて傷を回復することができる。また、麻痺、盲目、毒、出血の症状を大幅に軽減する。\n#～家庭でできる応急処置～\n"
en: Toolbox containing disposable medicines and medical instruments. It can heal wounds according to the user's dexterity and knowledge of biochemistry. It also greatly reduces the symptoms of paralysis, blindness, poisoning, and bleeding. \n#~First aid at home~
en_grezzo: "Toolbox containing disposable medicines and medical instruments. It can heal wounds according to the user's dexterity and knowledge of biochemistry. It also greatly reduces the symptoms of paralysis, blindness, poisoning, and bleeding. \n#~First aid at home~"
it: Una cassetta con dentro medicine e attrezzi da medico usa e getta. Cura le ferite secondo la destrezza di chi la usa e quanta biochimica sa. E riduce di molto i sintomi di paralisi, cecità, veleno e sanguinamento. \n#~Primo Soccorso in Casa~

jp: \t\t応急手当用の箱だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t応急手当用の箱だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool box of first aid supplies.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool box of first aid supplies."
it: Una scatola per il primo soccorso. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t矢弾の入った箱。時止弾以外の矢弾を最大まで補充できるのだが、結構重い。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t矢弾の入った箱。時止弾以外の矢弾を最大まで補充できるのだが、結構重い。\n#～明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～\n"
en: A box of bullet and arrows. It can replenish arrow ammunition to the maximum except for time-stopping ammunition, but it is quite heavy. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~
en_grezzo: "A box of bullet and arrows. It can replenish arrow ammunition to the maximum except for time-stopping ammunition, but it is quite heavy. \n# ~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow~"
it: Una cassa con dentro frecce e munizioni. Ricarica al massimo tutto tranne le munizioni fermatempo, ma pesa parecchio. \n# ~Raccolta di Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: \t\t使うことで特殊矢弾を補充できる箱だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使うことで特殊矢弾を補充できる箱だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Una cassa che ricarica le munizioni speciali (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t味方の士気を上げつつ攻撃対象を自動で指定する棒だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t味方の士気を上げつつ攻撃対象を自動で指定する棒だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that designates the target and raises the morale.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that designates the target and raises the morale."
it: Un bastone che alza il morale dei compagni e sceglie il bersaglio.

jp: \t\t流星群を思わせる連続攻撃を可能とする腕装備だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t流星群を思わせる連続攻撃を可能とする腕装備だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an armguard that allow combo-attacks like a meteor shower.
en_grezzo: "It is an armguard that allow combo-attacks like a meteor shower."
it: Un bracciale che dà raffiche di colpi come uno sciame di meteore.

jp: \t\tトレーニングの時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tトレーニングの時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un oggetto che si usa da sé quando ti alleni.

jp: \t\t病気にかかった時に自動発動するアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t病気にかかった時に自動発動するアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un oggetto che scatta da sé quando ti ammali.

jp: \t\t調教の時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t調教の時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) tool that helps with special training.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) tool that helps with special training."
it: Un oggetto che si usa da sé quando addestri.

jp: \t\t戦術指示の時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t戦術指示の時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) tool that helps with tactical instruction.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) tool that helps with tactical instruction."
it: Un oggetto che si usa da sé quando dai ordini tattici.

jp: \t\tキャラ情報を見る時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tキャラ情報を見る時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) tool that reveals extra character information.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) tool that reveals extra character information."
it: Un oggetto che si usa da sé quando guardi una scheda.

jp: \t\t学習書を読む時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t学習書を読む時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un oggetto che si usa da sé quando leggi un libro di studio.

jp: \t\tポーション類を飲む時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tポーション類を飲む時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un oggetto che si usa da sé quando bevi una pozione.

jp: \t\t収穫の時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t収穫の時に自動で使うアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un oggetto che si usa da sé quando raccogli.

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復できる飲み物だ。全回復するが気絶する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復できる飲み物だ。全回復するが気絶する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that fully restore satiety. Some faint due to its strong kick.
en_grezzo: "It is food that fully restore satiety. Some faint due to its strong kick."
it: Una bevanda che sazia. Rimette in sesto, ma fa svenire.

jp: \t\tＭＰを攻撃力に変える杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tＭＰを攻撃力に変える杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a staff that converts MP into offensive power.
en_grezzo: "It is a staff that converts MP into offensive power."
it: Un bastone che muta gli MP in forza d'attacco.

jp: \t\t使用するとカウント後に核爆発を起こすライオン。ライオンは死んでいますが、原子爆弾として使えるので問題ありません。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用するとカウント後に核爆発を起こすライオン。ライオンは死んでいますが、原子爆弾として使えるので問題ありません。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: When used, the lion causes a nuclear explosion after the count. Although the lion is dead, it does not matter because it can be used as an atomic bomb. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "When used, the lion causes a nuclear explosion after the count. Although the lion is dead, it does not matter because it can be used as an atomic bomb. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un leone che, se lo si usa, dopo un conto alla rovescia fa un'esplosione nucleare. Il leone è morto, ma siccome funziona da bomba atomica non è un problema. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t「死んだライオンは、生きている犬に勝る」\n#～不思議なノートの走り書き～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「死んだライオンは、生きている犬に勝る」\n#～不思議なノートの走り書き～\n"
en: \"A dead lion beats a live dog.\" \n# ~scribbling in a mysterious notebook~
en_grezzo: "\"A dead lion beats a live dog.\" \n# ~scribbling in a mysterious notebook~"
it: \"Un leone morto val più di un cane vivo.\" \n# ~Scarabocchi su un Quaderno Misterioso~

jp: \t\t一定時間後広範囲に壊滅的な破壊を加える爆弾だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜爆弾＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一定時間後広範囲に壊滅的な破壊を加える爆弾だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜爆弾＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) horrifying weapon of destruction from ancient times.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) horrifying weapon of destruction from ancient times."
it: Dopo un po' esplode e devasta un'area vasta (usa e getta).

jp: \t\tぶつけることでダメージを与えつつ相手の態勢を崩すアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tぶつけることでダメージを与えつつ相手の態勢を崩すアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a throwable item that inflicts damage and disorientates opponent.
en_grezzo: "It is a throwable item that inflicts damage and disorientates opponent."
it: Un oggetto che all'urto ferisce e rompe la guardia.

jp: \t\t機械仕掛けの副腕だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t機械仕掛けの副腕だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a pair of mechanical side arms.
en_grezzo: "It is a pair of mechanical side arms."

jp: \t\t真っ白な長剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t真っ白な長剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a pure white long sword.
en_grezzo: "It is a pure white long sword."

jp: \t\t食材を細かく粉砕し絞る調理器具。料理の技術が無くても、放り込んでスイッチを押せば勝手に圧汁してくれる。手軽にジュースが作れる優れもの。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食材を細かく粉砕し絞る調理器具。料理の技術が無くても、放り込んでスイッチを押せば勝手に圧汁してくれる。手軽にジュースが作れる優れもの。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: A cooking utensil that crushes and squeezes food into small pieces. Even if you do not have cooking skills, just throw in the ingredients and press the switch, and it will squeeze the juice on its own. It is an excellent tool for making juice easily. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "A cooking utensil that crushes and squeezes food into small pieces. Even if you do not have cooking skills, just throw in the ingredients and press the switch, and it will squeeze the juice on its own. It is an excellent tool for making juice easily. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un utensile da cucina che tritura gli ingredienti e li spreme. Anche senza saper cucinare basta buttarci dentro la roba e premere il pulsante: il succo lo tira fuori da sé. Ottimo arnese per farsi un succo senza fatica. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t果物、野菜、木の実をジュースにする家具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t果物、野菜、木の実をジュースにする家具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that juices fruits, vegetables, nuts.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that juices fruits, vegetables, nuts."
it: Un mobile che fa succo di frutta, verdura e frutti a guscio.

jp: \t\t魔石が組み込まれた魔道具。使用者とリンクして、姿と能力を変化させる。姿の変化は使用者の状態に大きく左右され、服飾が部分的に変化するだけのこともあれば、肉体が全くの別物に変化することも。一時的に使用者の筋力や感覚を引き上げる力をもつ。一度使用するとしばらく使えなくなる。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔石が組み込まれた魔道具。使用者とリンクして、姿と能力を変化させる。姿の変化は使用者の状態に大きく左右され、服飾が部分的に変化するだけのこともあれば、肉体が全くの別物に変化することも。一時的に使用者の筋力や感覚を引き上げる力をもつ。一度使用するとしばらく使えなくなる。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Magical tool with a special gemstone built into it. By linking with the user, it changes the user's appearance and abilities. The change in appearance is largely dependent on the state of the user. They have the power to temporarily increase the user's strength and perception. Once used, it becomes unusable for a while. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "Magical tool with a special gemstone built into it. By linking with the user, it changes the user's appearance and abilities. The change in appearance is largely dependent on the state of the user. They have the power to temporarily increase the user's strength and perception. Once used, it becomes unusable for a while. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Un oggetto magico con dentro una pietra magica. Si collega a chi lo usa e ne cambia aspetto e capacità. Il cambio d'aspetto dipende molto dallo stato di chi lo usa: a volte cambia solo un pezzo del vestiario, a volte il corpo diventa tutt'altra cosa. Per un poco alza la Forza e la Percezione di chi lo usa. Una volta usato, per un po' non si può riusare. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t別の姿と力を与える道具だ。ゲージ５０％以上の時に使用できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t別の姿と力を与える道具だ。ゲージ５０％以上の時に使用できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that transforms you. Can be used with 50% gauge.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that transforms you. Can be used with 50% gauge."
it: Dà un altro aspetto e altra forza. Si usa con la barra al 50%.

jp: \t\t魔石が組み込まれた魔道具。使用者とリンクして、姿と能力を変化させる。姿の変化は使用者の状態に大きく左右され、服飾が部分的に変化するだけのこともあれば、肉体が全くの別物に変化することも。一時的に使用者の魔力や器用さを引き上げる力を持つ。一度使用するとしばらく使えなくなる。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔石が組み込まれた魔道具。使用者とリンクして、姿と能力を変化させる。姿の変化は使用者の状態に大きく左右され、服飾が部分的に変化するだけのこともあれば、肉体が全くの別物に変化することも。一時的に使用者の魔力や器用さを引き上げる力を持つ。一度使用するとしばらく使えなくなる。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Magical tool with a special gemstone built into it. By linking with the user, it changes the user's appearance and abilities. The change in appearance is largely dependent on the state of the user. They have the power to temporarily increase the user's magical power and dexterity. Once used, it becomes unusable for a while. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "Magical tool with a special gemstone built into it. By linking with the user, it changes the user's appearance and abilities. The change in appearance is largely dependent on the state of the user. They have the power to temporarily increase the user's magical power and dexterity. Once used, it becomes unusable for a while. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~"

Il cambio d'aspetto dipende molto dallo stato di chi lo usa: a volte cambia solo un pezzo del vestiario, a volte il corpo diventa tutt'altra cosa. Per un poco alza la Magia e la Destrezza di chi lo usa. Una volta usato, per un po' non si può riusare. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

en_grezzo: "It is not underwear, it's hot pants."

jp: \t\t輪状の手裏剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
