en_grezzo: "It is a multipurpose shovel that can also be used as a polearm."
it: Una pala buona a tutto, anche da alabarda.

jp: \t\t充填された魔力によって四次元空間とつなげる鏡。使用回数に限りがあるが荷物の整理に便利。鏡に気に入られると鏡面から手が伸びてきて引きずり込まれるという都市伝説がある。実際、荷物整理中に袖を掴まれた少女が、その手の指を全部へし折って撃退したという報告もある。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t充填された魔力によって四次元空間とつなげる鏡。使用回数に限りがあるが荷物の整理に便利。鏡に気に入られると鏡面から手が伸びてきて引きずり込まれるという都市伝説がある。実際、荷物整理中に袖を掴まれた少女が、その手の指を全部へし折って撃退したという報告もある。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: A mirror that connects to the fourth dimensional space by means of filled magic power. It can be used only a limited number of times, but it is useful for organizing luggage. There is an urban legend that if the mirror likes you, a hand will reach out from the mirror's surface and drag you in. In fact, there is a report of a girl who was grabbed by the sleeve while organizing her belongings and fought back by breaking all the fingers of her hand. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "A mirror that connects to the fourth dimensional space by means of filled magic power. It can be used only a limited number of times, but it is useful for organizing luggage. There is an urban legend that if the mirror likes you, a hand will reach out from the mirror's surface and drag you in. In fact, there is a report of a girl who was grabbed by the sleeve while organizing her belongings and fought back by breaking all the fingers of her hand. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Uno specchio che, con la forza magica di cui è carico, si collega allo spazio a quattro dimensioni. Si usa un numero limitato di volte, ma è comodo per mettere in ordine il carico. Gira una leggenda di città: se piaci allo specchio, dalla superficie esce una mano e ti tira dentro. E infatti c'è il rapporto di una ragazza che, mentre metteva in ordine, si è vista afferrare per la manica e l'ha respinta rompendo alla mano tutte le dita. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t四次元ポケットを発動する鏡。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t四次元ポケットを発動する鏡。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that opens a pocket in another dimension to store item.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that opens a pocket in another dimension to store item."
it: Apre una tasca quadridimensionale. Si può usare più volte.

jp: \t\t中身の入っていない編みかごだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t中身の入っていない編みかごだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a woven basket with no contents.
en_grezzo: "It is a woven basket with no contents."
it: Un cesto di vimini senza niente dentro.

jp: \t\t料理がたっぷり詰め込まれた立派なバスケット。皆でお腹いっぱい食べられる。大勢でのピクニックに最適だが、料理を用意するのは大変だし量があるぶん重い。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理がたっぷり詰め込まれた立派なバスケット。皆でお腹いっぱい食べられる。大勢でのピクニックに最適だが、料理を用意するのは大変だし量があるぶん重い。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: A fine basket filled to the brim with food. Everyone can eat to their heart's content. It is ideal for a picnic with many people, but it is difficult to prepare the food and heavy because of the quantity. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "A fine basket filled to the brim with food. Everyone can eat to their heart's content. It is ideal for a picnic with many people, but it is difficult to prepare the food and heavy because of the quantity. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un bel cesto pieno zeppo di cibo. Ci si sazia tutti insieme. È l'ideale per un picnic in tanti, ma preparare tutto quel cibo è una fatica e, per la quantità, pesa. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t使うことで仲間全員で食事ができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使うことで仲間全員で食事ができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool box that allows all your friends to eat together.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool box that allows all your friends to eat together."
it: Usandolo, mangiano tutti i compagni (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t現世と冥界の狭間にあるという異界墓地の鍵。この鍵が作り出されて以降、棺だらけの不気味な世界へ迷い込んだという奇妙な話を耳にするようになった。干渉の影響で別の場所にも入口が開いてしまうのかもしれない。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t現世と冥界の狭間にあるという異界墓地の鍵。この鍵が作り出されて以降、棺だらけの不気味な世界へ迷い込んだという奇妙な話を耳にするようになった。干渉の影響で別の場所にも入口が開いてしまうのかもしれない。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: The key to the Cemetery of a Different Dimension, which is located between this world and the underworld. Since this key was produced, we have heard strange stories of people wandering into an eerie world full of coffins. It may be that the interference opens entrances to other places as well. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "The key to the Cemetery of a Different Dimension, which is located between this world and the underworld. Since this key was produced, we have heard strange stories of people wandering into an eerie world full of coffins. It may be that the interference opens entrances to other places as well. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~"
it: La chiave del cimitero DD, che starebbe fra questo mondo e l'oltretomba. Da quando è stata fatta si sentono storie strane di gente finita per sbaglio in un mondo sinistro pieno di bare. Forse l'interferenza apre un ingresso anche altrove. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t闇の棺を１５個まで保管可能。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鍵＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t闇の棺を１５個まで保管可能。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鍵＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that holds 15 coffins of necromancy.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that holds 15 coffins of necromancy."
it: Contiene fino a 15 bare della negromanzia. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t現在のテクノロジーでは解明できない謎の物質。腕なら腕、足なら足を思い浮かべれば、まるで最初からあったかのようにいつの間にかその部位が体にくっついているという。数少ない発見者たちは皆、気が付いたら足元に転がっていたとしか言わず、その出自は不明。発見者たちしかその力を使えず、使えば消えるというその特性から、研究は困難である。\n#～奇妙な噂話～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t現在のテクノロジーでは解明できない謎の物質。腕なら腕、足なら足を思い浮かべれば、まるで最初からあったかのようにいつの間にかその部位が体にくっついているという。数少ない発見者たちは皆、気が付いたら足元に転がっていたとしか言わず、その出自は不明。発見者たちしかその力を使えず、使えば消えるというその特性から、研究は困難である。\n#～奇妙な噂話～\n"
en: A mysterious substance that cannot be understood with current technology. Think of an arm for an arm or a leg for a leg, and it is said that the part is attached to the body before you know it, as if it had been there from the beginning. The few people who have discovered it all say that it was lying around their feet when they came across it. Its origin is unknown. Only the discoverers can use its power, and its characteristic of disappearing after use makes it difficult to study. \n# ~Bizarre Gossip~
en_grezzo: "A mysterious substance that cannot be understood with current technology. Think of an arm for an arm or a leg for a leg, and it is said that the part is attached to the body before you know it, as if it had been there from the beginning. The few people who have discovered it all say that it was lying around their feet when they came across it. Its origin is unknown. Only the discoverers can use its power, and its characteristic of disappearing after use makes it difficult to study. \n# ~Bizarre Gossip~"
it: Una materia misteriosa che la tecnica di oggi non sa spiegare. Basta pensare a un braccio, o a una gamba, e quel pezzo, dicono, ti si attacca addosso senza accorgersene, come se ci fosse sempre stato. I pochi che l'hanno trovata dicono tutti solo che se la sono vista rotolare ai piedi, e da dove venga non si sa. La usano soltanto loro e sparisce appena usata: per questo studiarla è difficile. \n# ~Dicerie Bizzarre~

jp: \t\t好きな部位を得られるアイテムだ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜特殊＞カテゴリ～\n

en: (Single-use) tool that grants a body part you want.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that grants a body part you want."
it: Dà la parte del corpo che si vuole. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t投げてぶつけると多段爆発する結晶だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n

en_grezzo: "Throwable magic crystal that explodes thrice upon impact."
it: Un cristallo che, lanciato, esplode più volte.

it: Un randello enorme e pieno di nodi.

jp: \t\t決闘を申し込む際に用いられる手袋。決闘によって相手が傷つこうが死亡しようがカルマに影響しない。呪いのような力を持っており、手袋を投げつけた側は決着がつくまでそのマップから逃げることができなくなる。決闘に勝利した者は、相手の所持品をより多く奪えるだろう。\n#～熱き決闘者たち～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t決闘を申し込む際に用いられる手袋。決闘によって相手が傷つこうが死亡しようがカルマに影響しない。呪いのような力を持っており、手袋を投げつけた側は決着がつくまでそのマップから逃げることができなくなる。決闘に勝利した者は、相手の所持品をより多く奪えるだろう。\n#～熱き決闘者たち～\n"
en: A glove used to challenge someone to a duel. It possesses the power of a curse, and the person who throws the glove at the opponent will not be able to escape from the map until the duel is settled. The winner of the duel will take a larger amount of his or her opponent's possessions.\n# ~Heated Duelists~
en_grezzo: "A glove used to challenge someone to a duel. It possesses the power of a curse, and the person who throws the glove at the opponent will not be able to escape from the map until the duel is settled. The winner of the duel will take a larger amount of his or her opponent's possessions.\n# ~Heated Duelists~"
it: Il guanto che si usa per sfidare a duello. Che nel duello l'altro resti ferito o ci muoia, il karma non ne risente. Ha una forza come di maledizione: chi lancia il guanto non può più fuggire da quella mappa finché la cosa non è decisa. Chi vince il duello si prende una parte più grossa delle cose dell'altro.\n# ~Duellanti Ardenti~

jp: \t\t「うそつき」\n#～呪われた者の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「うそつき」\n#～呪われた者の言葉～\n"
en: \"Scut!\" \n# ~words of the victim to the curse~
en_grezzo: "\"Scut!\" \n# ~words of the victim to the curse~"

jp: \t\t決闘用の手袋だ。相手に投げつけて使う（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t決闘用の手袋だ。相手に投げつけて使う（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) throwing tool that initializes duel with your opponent.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) throwing tool that initializes duel with your opponent."
it: Un guanto da duello: si lancia all'avversario (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t血塗れの鞭だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t血塗れの鞭だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t羊の形をしたモコモコの巨大安眠枕。「広大な草原で、心地よい風に吹かれながら寝ている羊になった夢」を見られるらしい。ただ、稀に孤独感を覚え、寂しくなってふと目が覚めることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t羊の形をしたモコモコの巨大安眠枕。「広大な草原で、心地よい風に吹かれながら寝ている羊になった夢」を見られるらしい。ただ、稀に孤独感を覚え、寂しくなってふと目が覚めることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A huge, fuzzy, restful sleep pillow in the shape of a sheep. However, on rare occasions, I feel lonely and I wake up suddenly feeling lonely. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A huge, fuzzy, restful sleep pillow in the shape of a sheep. However, on rare occasions, I feel lonely and I wake up suddenly feeling lonely. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un enorme cuscino soffice a forma di pecora, per dormire bene. Pare che faccia sognare di essere una pecora che dorme in una prateria sconfinata, con addosso un vento gradevole. Ogni tanto però prende un senso di solitudine, e ci si sveglia di soprassalto sentendosi soli.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t眠る為の家具（ランク５）。持たせると添い寝しに来ることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t眠る為の家具（ランク５）。持たせると添い寝しに来ることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) Rank 5 bed, hugging this makes you feel lonely at night.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) Rank 5 bed, hugging this makes you feel lonely at night."
it: Un letto (rango 5). Chi lo tiene a volte viene a dormirti accanto.

jp: \t\tヘルメット状の機械だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tヘルメット状の機械だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Una macchina a forma di casco.

jp: \t\t「洞察」の名を持つ魔道具。目に当てた状態で対象を覗き込むと、レンズに対象の情報を一時的に焼き付けることができる。それなりに高価なうえ使い捨てなので情報屋が使うことはない。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「洞察」の名を持つ魔道具。目に当てた状態で対象を覗き込むと、レンズに対象の情報を一時的に焼き付けることができる。それなりに高価なうえ使い捨てなので情報屋が使うことはない。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Magical tool with the name of [insight]. When you look into an object while holding it to your eyes, you can temporarily burn information about the object into the lenses. It is expensive and disposable, so it is not used by informants. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "Magical tool with the name of [insight]. When you look into an object while holding it to your eyes, you can temporarily burn information about the object into the lenses. It is expensive and disposable, so it is not used by informants. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Un oggetto magico che porta il nome di Intuito. Tenendolo all'occhio e guardandoci dentro un bersaglio, la lente ne imprime per un poco i dati. Costa il suo e si usa una volta sola, quindi gli informatori non lo adoperano. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t「そ、そんなもので人をジロジロ見るなんて失礼じゃないですか」\n#～慌てる市民の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「そ、そんなもので人をジロジロ見るなんて失礼じゃないですか」\n#～慌てる市民の言葉～\n"
en: \"Well, isn't it rude to stare at people with something like that?\" \n# ~Worried Citizen~
en_grezzo: "\"Well, isn't it rude to stare at people with something like that?\" \n# ~Worried Citizen~"
it: \"M-ma non è scortese fissare la gente con un affare simile?\" \n# ~Parole di un Cittadino in Affanno~

jp: \t\t対象の情報を確認できるレンズ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t対象の情報を確認できるレンズ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool lenses that allow you to see information of the target.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool lenses that allow you to see information of the target."
it: Una lente che mostra i dati del bersaglio. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t南瓜を繰り抜いて作られたランタン。悪霊を退けるという伝承通りの力こそないが、微量ながらも不思議な力が宿っている。一応食べることができる。\n#～古代祭事のルーツに迫る～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t南瓜を繰り抜いて作られたランタン。悪霊を退けるという伝承通りの力こそないが、微量ながらも不思議な力が宿っている。一応食べることができる。\n#～古代祭事のルーツに迫る～\n"
en: A lantern made from a hollowed-out pumpkin. Although it does not have the power to repel evil spirits, as the legend says, it does have a mysterious power, albeit in very small quantities. It can be eaten. \n# ~a Close Look at the Ancient Rituals~
en_grezzo: "A lantern made from a hollowed-out pumpkin. Although it does not have the power to repel evil spirits, as the legend says, it does have a mysterious power, albeit in very small quantities. It can be eaten. \n# ~a Close Look at the Ancient Rituals~"
it: Una lanterna ricavata svuotando una zucca. Il potere di respingere gli spiriti maligni, quello che la tradizione le attribuisce, non ce l'ha; ma un po' di forza misteriosa dentro ce l'ha davvero. Volendo, si può anche mangiare. \n# ~Alle Radici degli Antichi Riti~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる簡易照明。夜間周囲をやや明るく照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具・食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる簡易照明。夜間周囲をやや明るく照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具・食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety, illuminates surroundings brightly.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety, illuminates surroundings brightly."
it: Un cibo che sazia e che di notte illumina un po' i dintorni.

jp: \t\t感覚と意志の向上と、睡眠と混乱に耐性を得る呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t感覚と意志の向上と、睡眠と混乱に耐性を得る呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 1 Magic. Increases PER/WIL, give resist to Sleep/Confuse."
it: Un libro per alzare Per e Vol e resistere a sonno e confusione.

en: It is a potion that temporarily raises DV and floats you.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that temporarily raises DV and floats you."
it: Alza il DV per un po' e fa fluttuare.

jp: \t\t感覚と意志の向上と、睡眠と混乱に耐性を得ることができるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t感覚と意志の向上と、睡眠と混乱に耐性を得ることができるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that boosts PER & WIL and helps resist sleep & confusion.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that boosts PER & WIL and helps resist sleep & confusion."
it: Alza percezione e volontà, e resiste a sonno e confusione.

jp: \t\t寒冷地仕様の鎧だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t寒冷地仕様の鎧だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an armor for colder regions of Irva.
en_grezzo: "It is an armor for colder regions of Irva."
it: Una corazza fatta per le terre fredde.

jp_grezzo: "\t\t毒の棘を持つ鞭だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a whip with poisonous thorns.
en_grezzo: "It is a whip with poisonous thorns."
it: Una frusta con le spine avvelenate.

jp: \t\t銃と共に装備する武器（拳銃専用）だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t銃と共に装備する武器（拳銃専用）だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"

it: Un'arma da equipaggiare insieme a una pistola (solo pistole).

jp_grezzo: "\t\t所持していると濡れ状態になる勾玉だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a bead that soaks the holder in water.
en_grezzo: "It is a bead that soaks the holder in water."
it: Una perla ricurva: portandola addosso, ci si bagna.

jp: \t\t現イルヴァを統括する八柱の神々と謎のもう一柱の加護を受けたお守り。中心には目だか柱だかよくわからないマークが小さく描かれている。特に退魔の力はないが、身に着けていると神の改宗を迫る声に惑わされなくなるとか。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t現イルヴァを統括する八柱の神々と謎のもう一柱の加護を受けたお守り。中心には目だか柱だかよくわからないマークが小さく描かれている。特に退魔の力はないが、身に着けていると神の改宗を迫る声に惑わされなくなるとか。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Amulet is blessed by the eight gods and one other mysterious deity who oversees the current Irva. At the center of the amulet is a small symbol of an eye or a pillar, which is not clear. It has no particular power to repel demons, but it is said that wearing it will keep you from being deceived by the voice of the god who urges you to convert to a new religion. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "Amulet is blessed by the eight gods and one other mysterious deity who oversees the current Irva. At the center of the amulet is a small symbol of an eye or a pillar, which is not clear. It has no particular power to repel demons, but it is said that wearing it will keep you from being deceived by the voice of the god who urges you to convert to a new religion. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Un amuleto che ha la protezione delle otto divinità che reggono l'Irva di oggi e di una nona, misteriosa. Al centro c'è disegnato piccolo un segno che non si capisce se sia un occhio o un pilastro. Non ha una vera forza contro i demoni, ma pare che a portarlo addosso non ci si lasci più confondere dalla voce che spinge a cambiare dio. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t信仰を確認できる石だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n

en: (Reusable) tool stone that confirms your faith.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool stone that confirms your faith."
it: Una pietra che dice la fede. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t合成用のアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n

en_grezzo: "It is a stork E.G.G, or S.E.G.Gs."

jp: \t\t純白の天使を模した像。翼の部分は壊れやすいのでうかつに触ってはいけない。台座の上に乗るとなんだか翼が生えた気分になれるとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t純白の天使を模した像。翼の部分は壊れやすいのでうかつに触ってはいけない。台座の上に乗るとなんだか翼が生えた気分になれるとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A statue in the shape of a pure white angel. The wings are fragile and should not be touched carelessly. It is said that if you stand on the pedestal, you will feel as if you have grown wings. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A statue in the shape of a pure white angel. The wings are fragile and should not be touched carelessly. It is said that if you stand on the pedestal, you will feel as if you have grown wings. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua a forma di angelo candido. Le ali sono fragili e non vanno toccate alla leggera. Dicono che a salire sul piedistallo venga la sensazione di aver messo le ali. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t神秘的な像だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神秘的な像だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t小さいストーンゴーレム。サイズは小さくても、魔力を注げばちゃんと起動する。現在ではあまり見られない、クラシックなデザイン。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さいストーンゴーレム。サイズは小さくても、魔力を注げばちゃんと起動する。現在ではあまり見られない、クラシックなデザイン。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A small stone golem. Although small in size, it can be properly activated by pouring magic power into it. It is a classic design that is rarely seen today. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A small stone golem. Although small in size, it can be properly activated by pouring magic power into it. It is a classic design that is rarely seen today. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un piccolo golem di pietra. Piccolo sì, ma se gli si infonde il potere magico si attiva come si deve. È un disegno classico, che oggi non si vede quasi più. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t起動していないゴーレムだ。使うと仲間にできる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t起動していないゴーレムだ。使うと仲間にできる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "It is a golem that hasn't been activated. Infuse with mana to activate."
it: Un golem non attivato: usandolo diventa un compagno.

jp: \t\t苦悩の人々をその無限の大慈悲の心で包み込み、救うという石像。一般的には子供たちの守り神ともされる。雪よけの笠を被せてあげると恩返しに来るとか来ないとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t苦悩の人々をその無限の大慈悲の心で包み込み、救うという石像。一般的には子供たちの守り神ともされる。雪よけの笠を被せてあげると恩返しに来るとか来ないとか。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Stone statues that are said to save people in distress by enveloping them with their infinite great compassion. It is also generally regarded as a guardian deity for children. It is said that if you put a hat on it to protect it from the snow, it will return the favor or not. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Stone statues that are said to save people in distress by enveloping them with their infinite great compassion. It is also generally regarded as a guardian deity for children. It is said that if you put a hat on it to protect it from the snow, it will return the favor or not. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua di pietra che, si dice, avvolge chi soffre nella sua misericordia infinita e lo salva. In genere la si considera anche la divinità che protegge i bambini. Dicono che a metterle in testa un cappello di paglia contro la neve venga a sdebitarsi; o forse no. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t和風の間仕切りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t和風の間仕切りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t古代宗教の信仰対象を模した像。御神木などの神聖な木を使うこともあるが見た目上の違いは特に出ない。美術的に価値があり、コレクターもいる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n

en_grezzo: "Statues that imitate the objects of belief of ancient religions. Sacred trees such as sacred trees are sometimes used, but there is no particular difference in appearance. They have artistic value and are collected by some collectors. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"

en_grezzo: "This dish contains the flavor of shellfish and seaweed from the deep sea. No fish is used. The cooking process may or may not involve the application of advanced magic.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un piatto che racchiude il sapore dei molluschi e delle alghe raccolti negli abissi. Di pesce non ce n'è. Per prepararlo, dicono, si ricorre all'alta magia; o forse no.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t水の加護を受けたお弁当だ。体力も回復する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n

en_grezzo: "It is a bento blessed by abyssal powers, it restores your stamina."
it: Un pranzo protetto dall'acqua. Ridà anche vigore.

jp: \t\t大口径の狙撃銃だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大口径の狙撃銃だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "It is a large caliber sniper rifle."
it: Un fucile di precisione di grosso calibro.

jp: \t\t三つの都を破壊したとされる三叉槍だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t三つの都を破壊したとされる三叉槍だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "It is a trident said to have destroyed three cities."
it: Un tridente che, si dice, distrusse tre città.

jp: \t\t火を放つ大太刀だ。刀だが大剣に属する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n

en_grezzo: "It is a giant katana that discharges fire blossoms."
it: Un grande katana che sprigiona fuoco. Ma vale da spadone.

en: It is a light, sharp claws.

jp: \t\t多数の音楽ディスクを内蔵した機械。曲名とボタンがずらりと並んでおり、任意の曲を選んで流すことができる。カラフルな照明で美しく輝く。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t多数の音楽ディスクを内蔵した機械。曲名とボタンがずらりと並んでおり、任意の曲を選んで流すことができる。カラフルな照明で美しく輝く。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: Machine with many music discs built in. It has a row of song titles and buttons that allow you to select and play any song you wish. It shines beautifully with colorful lighting. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "Machine with many music discs built in. It has a row of song titles and buttons that allow you to select and play any song you wish. It shines beautifully with colorful lighting. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Una macchina con dentro tanti dischi musicali. Ha una fila di titoli e di pulsanti, e si sceglie il brano da far suonare. Brilla bella di luci colorate. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t任意の曲を流せる機械だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t任意の曲を流せる機械だ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that plays any music you want.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that plays any music you want."
it: Suona il brano che si vuole. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t四枚の葉を持つクローバー。それぞれの葉は、希望・誠実・愛情・幸運を象徴する。お守りにして持っておいてもいいが、食べるともっと幸せになれるかもしれない。\n#～食べられる草、食べられない草～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t四枚の葉を持つクローバー。それぞれの葉は、希望・誠実・愛情・幸運を象徴する。お守りにして持っておいてもいいが、食べるともっと幸せになれるかもしれない。\n#～食べられる草、食べられない草～\n"
en: A clover with four leaves. Each leaf symbolizes hope, faithfulness, love, and good luck. You can keep it as a good luck charm, but eating it may make you happier. \n# ~Weeds you can Eat and Weeds you can't Eat~
en_grezzo: "A clover with four leaves. Each leaf symbolizes hope, faithfulness, love, and good luck. You can keep it as a good luck charm, but eating it may make you happier. \n# ~Weeds you can Eat and Weeds you can't Eat~"
it: Un trifoglio con quattro foglie. Le foglie stanno per speranza, sincerità, amore e fortuna. Lo si può tenere come portafortuna, ma a mangiarlo forse si diventa più felici. \n# ~Erbe che si Mangiano ed Erbe che Non si Mangiano~

jp: \t\t花のような形状が特徴的なお菓子。薄くて食感の良いサブレと香ばしいアーモンドの組み合わせは美味。生地を絞り出す際には結構コツが必要。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t花のような形状が特徴的なお菓子。薄くて食感の良いサブレと香ばしいアーモンドの組み合わせは美味。生地を絞り出す際には結構コツが必要。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Pastry characterized by its flower-like shape. The combination of thin, textured sabl? and savory almonds is delicious. It takes a lot of skill to squeeze out the dough.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Pastry characterized by its flower-like shape. The combination of thin, textured sabl? and savory almonds is delicious. It takes a lot of skill to squeeze out the dough.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un dolce che si riconosce dalla forma di fiore. La pasta frolla, sottile e friabile, insieme al profumo tostato della mandorla è una delizia. Per far uscire l'impasto dalla sacca ci vuole una certa mano.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t「…なぜ私を見る？私の名前とは綴りが違うぞ」\n#～異形の森の使者『ロミアス』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「…なぜ私を見る？私の名前とは綴りが違うぞ」\n#～異形の森の使者『ロミアス』の言葉～\n"
en: \"..why are you looking at me? My name isn't spelled like that.\" \n# ~<Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale~
en_grezzo: "\"..why are you looking at me? My name isn't spelled like that.\" \n# ~<Lomias> The Messenger From Vindale~"
it: \"...perché guardi me? Il mio nome si scrive in un altro modo\" \n# ~Parole di <Lomias> il messaggero di Vindale~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。本当に食べてしまうのか？\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。本当に食べてしまうのか？\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety. Are you sure you want to eat it?
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety. Are you sure you want to eat it?"
it: Un cibo che sazia. Vuoi davvero mangiarlo?

jp: \t\tトマトのような横長の形状の果実。熟すと劇的に甘みが強くなる。豊富なビタミン類とミネラルを含み、「柿が赤くなると医者が青くなる」などと万能薬扱いをされていた時代もあったとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tトマトのような横長の形状の果実。熟すと劇的に甘みが強くなる。豊富なビタミン類とミネラルを含み、「柿が赤くなると医者が青くなる」などと万能薬扱いをされていた時代もあったとか。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Fruit has a horizontal tomato-like shape. When ripe, it becomes dramatically sweeter. It contains an abundance of vitamins and minerals, and there was a time when it was treated as a panacea.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Fruit has a horizontal tomato-like shape. When ripe, it becomes dramatically sweeter. It contains an abundance of vitamins and minerals, and there was a time when it was treated as a panacea.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un frutto largo e schiacciato come un pomodoro. Maturando diventa dolcissimo. È ricco di vitamine e di sali minerali, e c'è stata un'epoca in cui lo trattavano da panacea: quando il caco si fa rosso, dicevano, il medico si fa pallido.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

en: A type of fruit that restores satiety, it's used in many cooking dishes.\n#~Identification Report: <Food> Category~
en_grezzo: "A type of fruit that restores satiety, it's used in many cooking dishes.\n#~Identification Report: <Food> Category~"
it: Un frutto che sazia, e che entra in molte ricette.\n#~Rapporto di Identificazione: categoria <Cibo>~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。調理することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。調理することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is fruit that can be cooked and eaten.
en_grezzo: "It is fruit that can be cooked and eaten."
it: Un frutto che si può cucinare e mangiare.

jp: \t\t黄金に輝く幻のどんぐり。そこまで珍しいものでもないが、その発生原因は未だよくわかっておらず、学術的に非常に価値がある。それこそ普通の金塊を凌ぐくらいに。実の部分がほとんどなく料理することができないが、味自体はそこまで悪くないようだ。食べるのはあまりに勿体ないが。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t黄金に輝く幻のどんぐり。そこまで珍しいものでもないが、その発生原因は未だよくわかっておらず、学術的に非常に価値がある。それこそ普通の金塊を凌ぐくらいに。実の部分がほとんどなく料理することができないが、味自体はそこまで悪くないようだ。食べるのはあまりに勿体ないが。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: Golden acorns of miraculous color. It is not that rare, but the cause of its appearance remains unclear, and it has great academic value. Even more so than ordinary gold nuggets. It is almost impossible to cook because there is almost no fruit part, but the taste itself does not seem to be that bad. Although it is too wasteful to eat. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "Golden acorns of miraculous color. It is not that rare, but the cause of its appearance remains unclear, and it has great academic value. Even more so than ordinary gold nuggets. It is almost impossible to cook because there is almost no fruit part, but the taste itself does not seem to be that bad. Although it is too wasteful to eat. \n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Una ghianda leggendaria che brilla d'oro. Non è poi così rara, ma perché nasca non si è ancora capito, e per gli studiosi vale moltissimo: più di un lingotto d'oro vero. Di polpa non ne ha quasi, quindi cucinarla non si può; il sapore in sé non sembra male. Mangiarla resta uno spreco. \n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。調理はできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。調理はできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are nuts that can be eaten, but it cannot cooked.
en_grezzo: "These are nuts that can be eaten, but it cannot cooked."
it: Frutti a guscio che si mangiano, ma non si possono cucinare.

jp: \t\tすべすべした殻を持つ果実。大量のデンプンを蓄え生産量も多い事から、森に住む生命の重要な食料である。木の根元に埋めて保管されていることが多い。そのままだと渋みが強いが、料理すると結構いけるらしい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tすべすべした殻を持つ果実。大量のデンプンを蓄え生産量も多い事から、森に住む生命の重要な食料である。木の根元に埋めて保管されていることが多い。そのままだと渋みが強いが、料理すると結構いけるらしい。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～\n"
en: A nut with a smooth shell. Because it's abundancy and starch-rich nature, it's an important food source for those who live in the forest. They taste good when eaten raw, and tastes much better after cooking.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "A nut with a smooth shell. Because it's abundancy and starch-rich nature, it's an important food source for those who live in the forest. They taste good when eaten raw, and tastes much better after cooking.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Un frutto dal guscio liscio. Accumula molto amido e se ne produce in quantità, perciò è un cibo importante per chi vive nel bosco. Spesso lo si trova sotterrato ai piedi degli alberi, messo da parte. Crudo è molto allappante, ma cucinato pare venga discreto.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

en: A type of nut that restores satiety, it's used to make candies.\n#~Identification Report: <Food> Category~
en_grezzo: "A type of nut that restores satiety, it's used to make candies.\n#~Identification Report: <Food> Category~"
it: Un frutto a guscio che sazia, e con cui si fanno dolciumi.\n#~Rapporto di Identificazione: categoria <Cibo>~

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。調理することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n

en: These are nuts that can be cooked and eaten.
en_grezzo: "These are nuts that can be cooked and eaten."
it: Frutti a guscio che si possono cucinare e mangiare.

jp: \t\t所持していると火を放っても火事にならない勾玉だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n

en: It is a bead that prevents objects from shattering due to high-temp.
en_grezzo: "It is a bead that prevents objects from shattering due to high-temp."
it: Una perla ricurva: portandola, il fuoco non provoca incendi.

jp: \t\t防御魔力の備わったベルトだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n

jp: \t\t投擲用武器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t投擲用武器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a throwing weapon. Difficult to use. Hurt as hell when hit.
en_grezzo: "It is a throwing weapon. Difficult to use. Hurt as hell when hit."

jp: \t\tそれなりに頑丈な爪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tそれなりに頑丈な爪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are laws sturdy enough to be used like a shield.
en_grezzo: "These are laws sturdy enough to be used like a shield."

jp: \t\t毒で威力を補った小型クロスボウだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t毒で威力を補った小型クロスボウだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a small crossbow with poison to compensate for their power.
en_grezzo: "It is a small crossbow with poison to compensate for their power."
it: Una balestra piccola, che al poco potere supplisce col veleno.

jp: \t\t材料として加工された木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t材料として加工された木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a tree processed into a carpentry material.
en_grezzo: "It is a tree processed into a carpentry material."
it: Del legno lavorato per farne materiale.

jp: \t\t永遠に散り続ける桜の木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t永遠に散り続ける桜の木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a cherry tree that its blossoms is forever falling.
en_grezzo: "It is a cherry tree that its blossoms is forever falling."
it: Un ciliegio i cui fiori cadono per sempre.

jp: \t\t軽い眠気を誤魔化せるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t軽い眠気を誤魔化せるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that can trick mild sleepiness.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that can trick mild sleepiness."
it: Una pozione che inganna un po' di sonnolenza.

jp: \t\tブラックマーケット等で取り扱われている非合法の喫煙具。使用した者は罰せられる。取引時は名目上、普通のキセルに偽装されているらしい。乾燥クラムベリーから作られた麻薬が内蔵されており、使うと気分が一瞬にして高揚する。副作用で鬱になることが知られているため、服従した相手でもない限り勧めても断られるだろう。\n#～特選！裏の嗜好品～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tブラックマーケット等で取り扱われている非合法の喫煙具。使用した者は罰せられる。取引時は名目上、普通のキセルに偽装されているらしい。乾燥クラムベリーから作られた麻薬が内蔵されており、使うと気分が一瞬にして高揚する。副作用で鬱になることが知られているため、服従した相手でもない限り勧めても断られるだろう。\n#～特選！裏の嗜好品～\n"
en: Illegal smoking paraphernalia handled on the black market. Those who use it are punished. When traded, it is disguised as an ordinary pack of cigarettes. It contains a narcotic made from dried crimberries, and when used, it instantly elevates the smoker's mood. The side effect is known to be depression, so unless the recipient is a submissive, the drug is likely to be rejected. \n# ~Special Edition! Behind-the-scenes Favorites!~
en_grezzo: "Illegal smoking paraphernalia handled on the black market. Those who use it are punished. When traded, it is disguised as an ordinary pack of cigarettes. It contains a narcotic made from dried crimberries, and when used, it instantly elevates the smoker's mood. The side effect is known to be depression, so unless the recipient is a submissive, the drug is likely to be rejected. \n# ~Special Edition! Behind-the-scenes Favorites!~"
it: Un attrezzo da fumo fuorilegge, di quelli che passano dal mercato nero. Chi lo usa viene punito. Nelle trattative, di nome, lo mascherano da kiseru comune. Dentro ha una droga fatta di crimberry essiccate, e a usarlo l'umore si alza di colpo. Si sa che come effetto secondario porta malinconia, quindi offrirlo a chi non ti obbedisce non serve: rifiuterà. \n# ~Selezione! I Piaceri Clandestini~

jp: \t\t乾燥クラムベリーの煙を吸引するための器具。使用できる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t乾燥クラムベリーの煙を吸引するための器具。使用できる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that used for inhaling dried crimberry smoke.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that used for inhaling dried crimberry smoke."
it: Serve a fumare crimberry essiccate. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。有害成分を含む。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。有害成分を含む。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety. Contains harmful substances.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety. Contains harmful substances."
it: Un cibo che sazia. Contiene sostanze nocive.

jp: \t\tネフィアの核を活性化させ、真の力を目覚めさせる宝玉。その力はネフィア内部のモンスターにも作用し狂暴化を促す。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tネフィアの核を活性化させ、真の力を目覚めさせる宝玉。その力はネフィア内部のモンスターにも作用し狂暴化を促す。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Treasure that activates the core of Nefia and awakens its true power. Its power also affects the monsters inside Nefia, causing them to go berserk. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Treasure that activates the core of Nefia and awakens its true power. Its power also affects the monsters inside Nefia, causing them to go berserk. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una gemma che attiva il nucleo della Nefia e ne sveglia la vera forza. Quella forza agisce anche sui mostri dentro la Nefia, e li fa imbestialire. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t絆で結ばれた者たちの魂で紡がれる、運命の赤い糸。たとえ世界が何度変わり、時が何巡しようとも、無限の世界を越えた時の果てで二人を再び結びつけることだろう。\n#～アイオンの予言～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t絆で結ばれた者たちの魂で紡がれる、運命の赤い糸。たとえ世界が何度変わり、時が何巡しようとも、無限の世界を越えた時の果てで二人を再び結びつけることだろう。\n#～アイオンの予言～\n"
en: A red thread of destiny, spun by the souls of those bound together with a bond. No matter how the world changes, no matter how time goes, it will bring them together again at the end of time, beyond the infinite worlds. \n# ~Aion's Prophecy~
en_grezzo: "A red thread of destiny, spun by the souls of those bound together with a bond. No matter how the world changes, no matter how time goes, it will bring them together again at the end of time, beyond the infinite worlds. \n# ~Aion's Prophecy~"
it: Il filo rosso del destino, filato con le anime di chi è legato da un vincolo. Per quante volte il mondo cambi e il tempo giri, in capo al tempo, di là dai mondi infiniti, li legherà di nuovo l'uno all'altro. \n# ~La Profezia di Aion~

jp: \t\tショウルーム用。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tショウルーム用。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool to use in a Showroom.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool to use in a Showroom."
it: Serve nella sala d'esposizione. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t陶器で作られた涙滴状の楽器。形状や穴の数などは決まっていない。リコーダーとほぼ同じ構造の歌口を持ち、音を出しやすい。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t陶器で作られた涙滴状の楽器。形状や穴の数などは決まっていない。リコーダーとほぼ同じ構造の歌口を持ち、音を出しやすい。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A teardrop-shaped instrument made of ceramics. It has no fixed shape or number of holes. It has a singing mouth almost the same structure as a recorder, making it easy to produce sound. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A teardrop-shaped instrument made of ceramics. It has no fixed shape or number of holes. It has a singing mouth almost the same structure as a recorder, making it easy to produce sound. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento di ceramica a forma di goccia. La forma e il numero dei fori non sono fissi. Ha un'imboccatura quasi identica a quella del flauto dolce, e il suono viene facile. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Uno strumento per suonare. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t記録するもの、の名を持つ縦笛。フィップルという特殊構造により空気の束が安定し、容易な吹奏を可能としている。一方で音量が小さく音色にも表情がつけにくいため、初心者用の楽器として位置づけられている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t記録するもの、の名を持つ縦笛。フィップルという特殊構造により空気の束が安定し、容易な吹奏を可能としている。一方で音量が小さく音色にも表情がつけにくいため、初心者用の楽器として位置づけられている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A vertical flute with the name of 'recorder'. The special fipple structure stabilizes the air bundle and makes it easy to play. On the other hand, it is positioned as a beginner's instrument because its volume is low and its tone is difficult to express. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A vertical flute with the name of 'recorder'. The special fipple structure stabilizes the air bundle and makes it easy to play. On the other hand, it is positioned as a beginner's instrument because its volume is low and its tone is difficult to express. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Un flauto diritto: il nome che porta in un'altra lingua vuol dire chi registra. Una struttura particolare, il becco, tiene ferma la colonna d'aria e rende facile suonarlo. In compenso ha poco volume e un timbro difficile da colorare, e per questo lo si tiene per uno strumento da principianti. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Uno strumento per suonare. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\tとても太くて長くて、黒光りしている金管楽器。主に音量の補強に用いられるが、実際に使われることは少なく今や絶滅危惧楽器である。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tとても太くて長くて、黒光りしている金管楽器。主に音量の補強に用いられるが、実際に使われることは少なく今や絶滅危惧楽器である。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A very thick, long, shiny black brass instrument. It is mainly used to reinforce the volume, but is rarely used in practice and is now an endangered instrument. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A very thick, long, shiny black brass instrument. It is mainly used to reinforce the volume, but is rarely used in practice and is now an endangered instrument. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Un ottone molto grosso, molto lungo e nero lucente. Serve soprattutto a rinforzare il volume, ma in pratica lo si usa di rado ed è ormai uno strumento a rischio di estinzione. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Uno strumento per suonare. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t加工したルビナスだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t加工したルビナスだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a processed rubynus ore.

jp: \t\tエメラルドでできた板だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tエメラルドでできた板だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t加工したダイヤモンドだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t加工したダイヤモンドだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t恐ろしく鋭い爪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t恐ろしく鋭い爪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Degli artigli affilati da far paura.

jp: \t\t星の光を宿した骨鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t星の光を宿した骨鎌だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a bone scythe of the stars.
en_grezzo: "It is a bone scythe of the stars."
it: Una falce d'ossa che porta dentro la luce delle stelle.

jp: \t\t家畜を撫でる際に何度でも自動的に使用する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t家畜を撫でる際に何度でも自動的に使用する。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Si usa da sé, sempre, quando accarezzi il bestiame.

jp: \t\t植物に養分を与え、急速な成長と品質の向上をもたらすことができる。イルヴァの作物の多くは養分吸収速度が尋常でないため、即効性はあるが持続性はない。\n#～農業、その新たな可能性～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t植物に養分を与え、急速な成長と品質の向上をもたらすことができる。イルヴァの作物の多くは養分吸収速度が尋常でないため、即効性はあるが持続性はない。\n#～農業、その新たな可能性～\n"
en: It can provide nutrients to plants, resulting in rapid growth and improved quality. Because of the unusual rate of nutrient absorption in many of Irva's crops, the effect is immediate but not sustainable. \n# ~Agriculture and its New Possibilities~
en_grezzo: "It can provide nutrients to plants, resulting in rapid growth and improved quality. Because of the unusual rate of nutrient absorption in many of Irva's crops, the effect is immediate but not sustainable. \n# ~Agriculture and its New Possibilities~"
it: Dà nutrimento alle piante, e porta crescita rapida e qualità migliore. Molte colture di Irva assorbono il nutrimento a una velocità fuori dal comune, quindi l'effetto è immediato ma non dura. \n# ~L'Agricoltura e le sue Nuove Possibilità~

jp: \t\t作物用の肥料。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t作物用の肥料。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Concime per le colture. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t混ぜた食品を腐らなくするポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t混ぜた食品を腐らなくするポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that keeps food from rotting.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that keeps food from rotting."
it: Mescolata a un cibo, gli impedisce di marcire.

jp: \t\t魔法で動く飛行船を忠実に再現したノンスケールのミニチュア。残念ながら浮いたりはしない。\n#～イルヴァ航空販売カタログ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔法で動く飛行船を忠実に再現したノンスケールのミニチュア。残念ながら浮いたりはしない。\n#～イルヴァ航空販売カタログ～\n"
en: This non-scale miniature is a faithful reproduction of a magically powered airship. Unfortunately, it does not float.\n# ~Irva Airlines Sales Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "This non-scale miniature is a faithful reproduction of a magically powered airship. Unfortunately, it does not float.\n# ~Irva Airlines Sales Catalogue~"
it: Una miniatura fuori scala che riproduce fedelmente una nave magica volante. Purtroppo non sta a galla.\n# ~Catalogo di Vendita di Irva Airlines~

jp: \t\t魔導船のミニチュアだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔導船のミニチュアだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a miniature of a Eulderna Blimp.
en_grezzo: "It is a miniature of a Eulderna Blimp."
it: Una miniatura di una nave magica.

jp: \t\t読むことで物件としてのモンスター牧場を作ることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことで物件としてのモンスター牧場を作ることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) Readable deed used to build a giant ranch.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) Readable deed used to build a giant ranch."
it: Un atto: letto, fa nascere un allevamento di mostri.

jp: \t\t闇の叡智を秘めた杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t闇の叡智を秘めた杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a staff that holds dark wisdom.
en_grezzo: "It is a staff that holds dark wisdom."
it: Un bastone che cela la sapienza delle tenebre.

jp: \t\t材料から器具まで一通りセットになった使い切りの器具。料理スキルが皆無だろうと簡単に手作りチョコが完成する。ふざけたりしない限り。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t材料から器具まで一通りセットになった使い切りの器具。料理スキルが皆無だろうと簡単に手作りチョコが完成する。ふざけたりしない限り。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: A complete set of ingredients and utensils that can be used up. Even if you have no cooking skills, you can easily complete homemade chocolates. As long as you don't mess around too much. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "A complete set of ingredients and utensils that can be used up. Even if you have no cooking skills, you can easily complete homemade chocolates. As long as you don't mess around too much. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un attrezzo usa e getta con dentro tutto, dagli ingredienti agli arnesi. Anche senza una briciola di Cucina il cioccolato fatto in casa viene bene. Purché non ci si metta a fare gli scemi. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t限定的な調理器具。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t限定的な調理器具。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un attrezzo da cucina limitato. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t分子構造的にとても脆いスーツだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t分子構造的にとても脆いスーツだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a very fragile suit in terms of molecular structure.
en_grezzo: "It is a very fragile suit in terms of molecular structure."
it: Una tuta fragilissima nella struttura molecolare.

jp: \t\t高性能な特殊スーツだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高性能な特殊スーツだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a high-performance special suit.
it: Una tuta speciale ad alte prestazioni.

jp: \t\t魔力の結晶を核として、棺の中に培養した残骸で仮初の肉体を構築。完成した後は主に持ち運ぶための器として用いる。出てくるアンデッドの強さは術者の解剖学と錬金術の技術に依存する。\n#～ネクロマンサー入門～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔力の結晶を核として、棺の中に培養した残骸で仮初の肉体を構築。完成した後は主に持ち運ぶための器として用いる。出てくるアンデッドの強さは術者の解剖学と錬金術の技術に依存する。\n#～ネクロマンサー入門～\n"
en: Using the magical crystals as the nucleus, a pseudo-body is constructed with the cultured remains in a coffin. After completion, it is used mainly as a vessel for carrying around. The strength of the undead that emerges depends on the user's anatomy and alchemical skills. \n# ~Necromancy for Noobs~
en_grezzo: "Using the magical crystals as the nucleus, a pseudo-body is constructed with the cultured remains in a coffin. After completion, it is used mainly as a vessel for carrying around. The strength of the undead that emerges depends on the user's anatomy and alchemical skills. \n# ~Necromancy for Noobs~"
it: Con un cristallo di forza magica per nucleo, dentro la bara si costruisce un corpo provvisorio con i resti coltivati. Finito che è, serve soprattutto da recipiente per portarlo in giro. Quanto è forte il non morto che ne esce dipende da Anatomia e Alchimia di chi lo fa. \n# ~Negromanzia per Principianti~

jp: \t\t使用することで棺に眠る魔物を呼び覚ます。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n

en: A quill pen imbued with astral light. It interferes exclusively with the existence records of life in this world...the Akashic Records, and rewrites them so that the subject exists as another person. The resulting person is the identical person with the same memories and personality, but free from any original role or destiny. However, the user is required to have at least half the existence level of the subject. Intervention requires material \"magic ink\" according to the subject's level of existence, and will fail if the subject does not sincerely desire it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A quill pen imbued with astral light. It interferes exclusively with the existence records of life in this world...the Akashic Records, and rewrites them so that the subject exists as another person. The resulting person is the identical person with the same memories and personality, but free from any original role or destiny. However, the user is required to have at least half the existence level of the subject. Intervention requires material \"magic ink\" according to the subject's level of existence, and will fail if the subject does not sincerely desire it. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"

Quello in più è la stessa persona, con gli stessi ricordi e lo stesso carattere, ma è sciolto dal ruolo e dal destino che aveva. Chi la usa però deve avere almeno metà del grado di esistenza del soggetto. E l'intervento chiede, secondo quel grado, l'inchiostro magico come materia: se il soggetto non lo vuole con tutto il cuore, fallisce. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t（効果未実装）①ターン開始時にデッキから手札が５枚になるようカードを引く。②１ターンに１度、手札を１枚捨ててそのカードの効果を発動できる。発動したカードのランクと同じ数だけデッキからカードを捨てる。③デッキが０枚以下になったターンの終了時、このアイテムのコントローラーのＨＰは０になる。その後捨てられているカードを全てデッキに戻しシャッフルする。④３０ターン、自分の行動をスキップできる。成功した場合、捨てられているカードを全てデッキに戻しシャッフルする。その後、使用可能な任意のデッキを選択し、以降はそのデッキをゲームに使用する。\n#～熱き決闘者たち～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t（効果未実装）①ターン開始時にデッキから手札が５枚になるようカードを引く。②１ターンに１度、手札を１枚捨ててそのカードの効果を発動できる。発動したカードのランクと同じ数だけデッキからカードを捨てる。③デッキが０枚以下になったターンの終了時、このアイテムのコントローラーのＨＰは０になる。その後捨てられているカードを全てデッキに戻しシャッフルする。④３０ターン、自分の行動をスキップできる。成功した場合、捨てられているカードを全てデッキに戻しシャッフルする。その後、使用可能な任意のデッキを選択し、以降はそのデッキをゲームに使用する。\n#～熱き決闘者たち～\n"
en: ① At the start of your turn: You can draw until you had 5 card in your hand. ② Once per turn: you can discard 1 card; Send cards from the top of your Deck to the GY equal to this card's rank. ③ At the end of the turn, if you have no cards left in your Deck, you lose the Duel. And if you do, shuffle all cards in your GY into your Deck. ④ You can skip your action for 30 turns. If you do, shuffle all cards in your GY into your Deck. Then, you can select any available deck for the rest of this duel.\n# ~Heated Duelists~
en_grezzo: "① At the start of your turn: You can draw until you had 5 card in your hand. ② Once per turn: you can discard 1 card; Send cards from the top of your Deck to the GY equal to this card's rank. ③ At the end of the turn, if you have no cards left in your Deck, you lose the Duel. And if you do, shuffle all cards in your GY into your Deck. ④ You can skip your action for 30 turns. If you do, shuffle all cards in your GY into your Deck. Then, you can select any available deck for the rest of this duel.\n# ~Heated Duelists~"
it: (effetto non attivo) 1) All'inizio del turno peschi dal mazzo fino ad avere cinque carte in mano. 2) Una volta per turno puoi scartare una carta dalla mano e attivarne l'effetto; poi scarti dal mazzo tante carte quanto vale la carta attivata. 3) Alla fine del turno in cui il mazzo resta a zero carte, chi comanda questo oggetto va a 0 HP. Dopo, tutte le carte scartate tornano nel mazzo e si mescola. 4) Per 30 turni puoi saltare il tuo agire. Se riesce, tutte le carte scartate tornano nel mazzo e si mescola; poi scegli un mazzo qualunque fra quelli che puoi usare, e da lì in avanti giochi con quello.\n# ~Duellanti Ardenti~
