jp: \t\t錬金術士が合成で用いる煮釜。特殊な薬品といっしょに材料を煮込み、相互反応で物質構造を原子レベルで変化させるのだ。\n#～錬金術入門書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t錬金術士が合成で用いる煮釜。特殊な薬品といっしょに材料を煮込み、相互反応で物質構造を原子レベルで変化させるのだ。\n#～錬金術入門書～\n"
en: A boiling pot used by alchemists for item synthesis. Materials are boiled together with special chemicals to change the structure of matter at the atomic level through mutual reactions. \n# ~An Introduction to Alchemy~
en_grezzo: "A boiling pot used by alchemists for item synthesis. Materials are boiled together with special chemicals to change the structure of matter at the atomic level through mutual reactions. \n# ~An Introduction to Alchemy~"
it: Il paiolo che gli alchimisti usano per la fusione. I materiali si fanno bollire insieme a certi preparati, e la reazione fra loro cambia la struttura della materia a livello di atomi. \n# ~Manuale d'Introduzione all'Alchimia~

jp: \t\t複雑な合成用の器具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t複雑な合成用の器具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that allow using of complex fusion recipes.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that allow using of complex fusion recipes."
it: Un attrezzo per le fusioni complesse. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t特定のアイテム同士を融合させ、別の物を作りだす魔法がかけられている。芸術品として見てもいい物だ。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特定のアイテム同士を融合させ、別の物を作りだす魔法がかけられている。芸術品として見てもいい物だ。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Items placed inside are magically fused with each other to create something else. It is a state-of-art magical tool. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Items placed inside are magically fused with each other to create something else. It is a state-of-art magical tool. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Ci hanno messo sopra una magia che fonde fra loro certi oggetti e ne fa un altro. Anche a guardarlo come opera d'arte è un bel pezzo. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t骨を加工した弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t骨を加工した弓だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a bow made of processed bone.
en_grezzo: "It is a bow made of processed bone."

jp: \t\tランダムなカードが連番で入っている袋だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜袋＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tランダムなカードが連番で入っている袋だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜袋＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a pack of 5 cards.
it: Un pacchetto di carte a caso, numerate di seguito.

jp: \t\t複雑な料理を覚えるための紙。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t複雑な料理を覚えるための紙。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) paper that teaches you new recipes.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) paper that teaches you new recipes."
it: Un foglio per imparare un piatto difficile. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t料理を載せる為に用いる平坦な食器。ピンからキリまであり、日常的に広く使われる物から、馬が買えてしまうような驚くべき価値のものも存在するという。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理を載せる為に用いる平坦な食器。ピンからキリまであり、日常的に広く使われる物から、馬が買えてしまうような驚くべき価値のものも存在するという。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: Flatware used to place food on. They range from the most expensive to the most expensive, and some are widely used in daily life, while others are so valuable that they are equivalent to the price of a horse. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "Flatware used to place food on. They range from the most expensive to the most expensive, and some are widely used in daily life, while others are so valuable that they are equivalent to the price of a horse. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Una stoviglia piatta su cui si mette il cibo. Ce n'è di ogni sorta, dalla migliore alla peggiore: certe si usano tutti i giorni, altre valgono tanto da poterci comprare un cavallo. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t料理等を載せる平たい器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t料理等を載せる平たい器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a flat vessel on which food is placed.
en_grezzo: "It is a flat vessel on which food is placed."
it: Un recipiente piatto su cui si posa il cibo.

jp: \t\t主に調理に用いられる短剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t主に調理に用いられる短剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a shortsword mainly used for cooking.
en_grezzo: "It is a shortsword mainly used for cooking."
it: Un pugnale che serve soprattutto a cucinare.

jp: \t\t仕留めた猛獣の皮をなめして調度品としたもの。丸々一頭贅沢に使ったその佇まいは、そこに未だ野性が残っていると思わせるほどだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t仕留めた猛獣の皮をなめして調度品としたもの。丸々一頭贅沢に使ったその佇まいは、そこに未だ野性が残っていると思わせるほどだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The skins of wild beasts are tanned and used as furnishings. The appearance of the luxurious use of a whole animal is enough to make one believe that there is still some wildness left in the animal. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The skins of wild beasts are tanned and used as furnishings. The appearance of the luxurious use of a whole animal is enough to make one believe that there is still some wildness left in the animal. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: La pelle di una bestia feroce abbattuta, conciata e ridotta a suppellettile. Usarne una intera è un lusso, e l'insieme dà l'impressione che là dentro sia rimasto qualcosa di selvatico. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t獣を加工した家具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t獣を加工した家具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is furniture made from processed beasts.
en_grezzo: "It is furniture made from processed beasts."
it: Un mobile ricavato da una bestia.

jp: \t\t仕留めた獣の頭部に特殊な加工処理を施し調度品としたもの。飾るだけには飽き足らず、自ら狩ったものを加工することで所有欲を満たす貴族もいるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t仕留めた獣の頭部に特殊な加工処理を施し調度品としたもの。飾るだけには飽き足らず、自ら狩ったものを加工することで所有欲を満たす貴族もいるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The head of a hunted beast is given a special treatment and made into a furnishing. Some aristocrats are not satisfied with merely decorating, but rather satisfy their desires to possess by processing their own hunted animals. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The head of a hunted beast is given a special treatment and made into a furnishing. Some aristocrats are not satisfied with merely decorating, but rather satisfy their desires to possess by processing their own hunted animals. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: La testa di una bestia abbattuta, trattata in modo speciale e ridotta a suppellettile. C'è qualche nobile a cui non basta appenderla: si lavora da sé la preda che ha cacciato, e così si sazia la voglia di possesso. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t非常に肌触りのよい毛皮を用いた、見るからに高そうな長椅子。座り心地は抜群だが些かデリケートな家具なので、手入れには非常に神経を使うだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に肌触りのよい毛皮を用いた、見るからに高そうな長椅子。座り心地は抜群だが些かデリケートな家具なので、手入れには非常に神経を使うだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This is an expensive-looking chaise longue made of very soft fur. It is a very comfortable but rather delicate piece of furniture that requires a great deal of care. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This is an expensive-looking chaise longue made of very soft fur. It is a very comfortable but rather delicate piece of furniture that requires a great deal of care. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un divano dall'aria costosa, rivestito di una pelliccia morbidissima. Ci si sta benissimo seduti, ma è un mobile un po' delicato e tenerlo in ordine costerà parecchie attenzioni. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t座る為の家具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t座る為の家具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un mobile per sedersi. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\tさる高名な芸術家が作った、機械仕掛けの神を模った彫像。所々複雑に作られた箇所が、どことなくかっこいい。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tさる高名な芸術家が作った、機械仕掛けの神を模った彫像。所々複雑に作られた箇所が、どことなくかっこいい。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A statue in the shape of the God of Machine, created by a renowned artist. Even the intricately made complex parts are recreated. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A statue in the shape of the God of Machine, created by a renowned artist. Even the intricately made complex parts are recreated. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua che raffigura il dio delle macchine, opera di un artista famoso. I punti fatti a incastro qua e là hanno un non so che di grintoso. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t機械仕掛けの神を模った彫像。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t機械仕掛けの神を模った彫像。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a statue of God of Machine. May be used periodically.
en_grezzo: "It is a statue of God of Machine. May be used periodically."
it: Una statua del dio delle macchine. Si usa ogni tanto.

jp: \t\tさる高名な芸術家が作った、収穫の神を模った彫像。その愁いを帯びた表情は、どことなく凛々しい。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tさる高名な芸術家が作った、収穫の神を模った彫像。その愁いを帯びた表情は、どことなく凛々しい。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A statue in the shape of the God of Harvest. created by a renowned artist. The melancholy expression on his face is somehow dignified. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A statue in the shape of the God of Harvest. created by a renowned artist. The melancholy expression on his face is somehow dignified. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua che raffigura il dio del raccolto, opera di un artista famoso. L'aria mesta del volto ha un non so che di fiero. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t収穫の神を模った彫像。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t収穫の神を模った彫像。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a statue of God of Harvest. May be used periodically.
en_grezzo: "It is a statue of God of Harvest. May be used periodically."
it: Una statua del dio del raccolto. Si usa ogni tanto.

jp: \t\t非常に触り心地の良い、格調高い戸棚。どことなく大人の雰囲気を醸し出している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に触り心地の良い、格調高い戸棚。どことなく大人の雰囲気を醸し出している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A very tactile and prestigious cupboard. It has a somewhat sophisticated atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A very tactile and prestigious cupboard. It has a somewhat sophisticated atmosphere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un armadietto di gran classe, piacevolissimo al tatto. Ha un che di adulto nell'aria che si porta dietro. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t高価な戸棚だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高価な戸棚だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\tありとあらゆる種類の書物が入りそうな本棚。話によれば、去る歴史研究家が飽和した本を整理する為に理想的な家具を注文したのが発端だという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tありとあらゆる種類の書物が入りそうな本棚。話によれば、去る歴史研究家が飽和した本を整理する為に理想的な家具を注文したのが発端だという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A bookcase that could hold all kinds of books. According to the story, it all started when a retired historian ordered the ideal furniture to organize his stacks of books. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A bookcase that could hold all kinds of books. According to the story, it all started when a retired historian ordered the ideal furniture to organize his stacks of books. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una libreria in cui pare ci stiano libri di ogni sorta. A quanto si racconta, tutto cominciò quando uno storico ormai ritirato ordinò il mobile ideale per mettere in ordine i libri che gli traboccavano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t大型の本棚だ。本類を100種類まで入れることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大型の本棚だ。本類を100種類まで入れることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) large bookshelf for up to 100 different types of books.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) large bookshelf for up to 100 different types of books."
it: Una libreria grande. Ci stanno fino a 100 tipi di libri.

jp: \t\t疲れを取ることができるカプセルだ。飲むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜薬物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t疲れを取ることができるカプセルだ。飲むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜薬物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a drinkable capsule that restores your stamina.
en_grezzo: "It is a drinkable capsule that restores your stamina."
it: Una capsula che toglie la fatica. Si può bere.

jp: \t\t疲れを取ることができる飲み物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t疲れを取ることができる飲み物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a drink that can restore stamina.
en_grezzo: "It is a drink that can restore stamina."
it: Una bevanda che toglie la fatica.

jp: \t\t小型のクリスマスツリー。祭りを祝いたいが樹木を家に置くスペースが無い、といった事情にお答えした一般家庭用のツリーだ。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小型のクリスマスツリー。祭りを祝いたいが樹木を家に置くスペースが無い、といった事情にお答えした一般家庭用のツリーだ。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: Small Christmas tree. This is a tree for the average homeowner who wants to celebrate the festival but does not have space for a tree in their home. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "Small Christmas tree. This is a tree for the average homeowner who wants to celebrate the festival but does not have space for a tree in their home. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un piccolo albero di Natale. È l'albero per la famiglia comune, che vuole festeggiare ma non ha in casa lo spazio per un albero vero. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t小さなモミの木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さなモミの木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a small fir tree.

jp: \t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。異国の神が降り立つ為の目印であると考えられている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。異国の神が降り立つ為の目印であると考えられている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: An ornament made especially for celebrations. It is believed to be a marker for the descent of an exotic deity. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "An ornament made especially for celebrations. It is believed to be a marker for the descent of an exotic deity. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un ornamento fatto apposta per le feste. Si ritiene che serva da segnale perché un dio straniero possa scendere. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t新年に向けて作られた厳かな飾りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t新年に向けて作られた厳かな飾りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a solemn decoration made for the New Year.
en_grezzo: "It is a solemn decoration made for the New Year."
it: Un ornamento solenne fatto per il capodanno.

jp: \t\t癒しの女神が描かれた優しい抱き心地の枕。長い棒状のそれを抱くことで信者のみならず、使った者全てを女神自らが眠りの淵へ誘い、夢の中で心身を癒してくれるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t癒しの女神が描かれた優しい抱き心地の枕。長い棒状のそれを抱くことで信者のみならず、使った者全てを女神自らが眠りの淵へ誘い、夢の中で心身を癒してくれるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Hugpillow with a Goddess of Healing printed on it. It is said that by holding the long stick-shaped pillow, the Goddess herself lures not only believers but also all who use it into the depths of sleep and heals their body and soul in their dreams. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Hugpillow with a Goddess of Healing printed on it. It is said that by holding the long stick-shaped pillow, the Goddess herself lures not only believers but also all who use it into the depths of sleep and heals their body and soul in their dreams. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Un cuscino da abbracciare, morbido, con sopra dipinta la dea della cura. Dicono che, stringendo quel lungo cilindro, la dea in persona porti al fondo del sonno non solo i fedeli ma chiunque lo usi, e che nel sogno gli guarisca il corpo e l'animo.\n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\tいい夢を見ることができる枕（ランク０）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tいい夢を見ることができる枕（ランク０）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) Rank 0 bed that allows you to have good dreams.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) Rank 0 bed that allows you to have good dreams."
it: Un cuscino da bei sogni (rango 0). Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら涼しげな音がすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら涼しげな音がすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. You may hear some kind of refreshing sound when you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. You may hear some kind of refreshing sound when you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una bancarella tirata su alla svelta per vendere roba durante una festa. A passarci accanto, certe volte si sente un suono che dà fresco. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t祭事用の簡易的な店だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祭事用の簡易的な店だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a simple store for festivities.
en_grezzo: "It is a simple store for festivities."

jp: \t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら酸味の混じった香ばしい匂いがすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祭りの際、物を販売する為に簡易的に作られた露店。通る時に何やら酸味の混じった香ばしい匂いがすることがある。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. There is sometimes a savory smell mixed with some kind of sourness as you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A simple stall built to sell things during a festival. There is sometimes a savory smell mixed with some kind of sourness as you pass by. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una bancarella tirata su alla svelta per vendere roba durante una festa. A passarci accanto, certe volte si sente un profumo tostato con dentro una punta di acido. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t対話や会計等に用いる、仕切りを兼ねた家具。この家具越しに会話するとさながら店を開いた気分になるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t対話や会計等に用いる、仕切りを兼ねた家具。この家具越しに会話するとさながら店を開いた気分になるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Furniture that serves as a partition for dialogue and accounting. It is said that conversing through this furniture makes one feel as if one has opened a store. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Furniture that serves as a partition for dialogue and accounting. It is said that conversing through this furniture makes one feel as if one has opened a store. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile che serve a parlare e a fare i conti, e insieme fa da divisorio. Dicono che a conversare da dietro venga la sensazione di aver aperto bottega. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t店用の机だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t店用の机だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a desk for the store.
en_grezzo: "It is a desk for the store."

jp: \t\t一つ上の世界を見た気になる、ちょっとした段差。何かを主張したい時はここに立って話すといいだろう。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一つ上の世界を見た気になる、ちょっとした段差。何かを主張したい時はここに立って話すといいだろう。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A little step that makes you feel like you've seen the world one step above. If you want to make a statement, you can stand here and talk. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A little step that makes you feel like you've seen the world one step above. If you want to make a statement, you can stand here and talk. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un gradino da poco che dà l'impressione di vedere il mondo un piano più su. Quando si vuole dire la propria, conviene salirci e parlare da lì. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\tうず高く盛り上がった台だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜壇＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tうず高く盛り上がった台だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜壇＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。各々が思い思いの花で編み上げているので、その形は多様に富んでいる。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t祝い事の為に特別に作られた飾り。各々が思い思いの花で編み上げているので、その形は多様に富んでいる。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: Decorations made especially for celebratory occasions. Each person weaves them with flowers of his or her own choice, so there is a wide variety of shapes. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "Decorations made especially for celebratory occasions. Each person weaves them with flowers of his or her own choice, so there is a wide variety of shapes. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un ornamento fatto apposta per le feste. Ognuno lo intreccia con i fiori che preferisce, e così le forme sono le più varie. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t特別な日の為に作られた冠だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特別な日の為に作られた冠だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a crown made for a special occasion.
en_grezzo: "It is a crown made for a special occasion."
it: Una corona fatta per un giorno speciale.

jp: \t\t孤高の天才作曲家の愛用していたピアノ。既存の曲を独自に解釈した彼の作風をこのピアノは潜在的に受け継いでおり、演奏する際それが音色となって現れるようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t孤高の天才作曲家の愛用していたピアノ。既存の曲を独自に解釈した彼の作風をこのピアノは潜在的に受け継いでおり、演奏する際それが音色となって現れるようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This piano was the favorite of a solitary genius composer. This piano potentially inherited his unique style of interpreting existing compositions, and this style seems to appear in the tone of the piano when it is played. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This piano was the favorite of a solitary genius composer. This piano potentially inherited his unique style of interpreting existing compositions, and this style seems to appear in the tone of the piano when it is played. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il pianoforte prediletto di un compositore geniale e solitario. Pare che abbia ereditato in potenza il suo modo tutto personale di leggere i pezzi altrui, e che a suonarlo quel modo riaffiori nel timbro. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t聴衆を酔わす演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t聴衆を酔わす演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜楽器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) Rank 5 instrument that makes people drunk.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) Rank 5 instrument that makes people drunk."
it: Uno strumento che inebria il pubblico. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\tどんなガラクタだろうが、たちまち一点物に作り変えるという名工ガロクの槌。ただし、職人の気難しい気質がそのまま槌に宿っている為、こちらの希望は聞き入れてくれないようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tどんなガラクタだろうが、たちまち一点物に作り変えるという名工ガロクの槌。ただし、職人の気難しい気質がそのまま槌に宿っている為、こちらの希望は聞き入れてくれないようだ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Garok's hammer is a master craftsman's hammer that instantly transforms any piece of junk into a one-of-a-kind item. However, since the craftsman's difficult temperament is directly reflected in his hammer, he does not seem to listen to our wishes. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Garok's hammer is a master craftsman's hammer that instantly transforms any piece of junk into a one-of-a-kind item. However, since the craftsman's difficult temperament is directly reflected in his hammer, he does not seem to listen to our wishes. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il martello di Garok, maestro artigiano, che di qualunque ciarpame fa in un attimo un pezzo unico. Però l'indole difficile dell'artigiano è passata tale e quale nel martello, e a quanto pare le nostre richieste non le ascolta. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t武器防具を☆化することができる槌。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t武器防具を☆化することができる槌。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that raises the quality of the equipment.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that raises the quality of the equipment."
it: Rende eccezionale un'arma o un'armatura. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t光り輝く刀剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t光り輝く刀剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t見えない者さえ打ちぬく拳銃だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t見えない者さえ打ちぬく拳銃だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a pistol that strikes down even those it cannot see.
en_grezzo: "It is a pistol that strikes down even those it cannot see."
it: Una pistola che passa da parte a parte anche chi non si vede.

jp: \t\t攻撃的な性能を持った兜だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t攻撃的な性能を持った兜だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a helmet with offensive capabilities.
en_grezzo: "It is a helmet with offensive capabilities."

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。のどに詰まることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。のどに詰まることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety."
it: Un cibo che sazia. Certe volte va di traverso.

jp: \t\t縁起物とされる赤い色の玩具。異国では眼が書かれていない物が主流で、願いがかなう度にそこに黒い染料で目を書き入れるのだという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t縁起物とされる赤い色の玩具。異国では眼が書かれていない物が主流で、願いがかなう度にそこに黒い染料で目を書き入れるのだという。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: A red-colored toy considered a good-luck charm. In foreign countries, the most common toy has no eyes written on it, and every time a wish is granted, an eye is drawn on it with black dye. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "A red-colored toy considered a good-luck charm. In foreign countries, the most common toy has no eyes written on it, and every time a wish is granted, an eye is drawn on it with black dye. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Un balocco rosso che si tiene per portafortuna. In terra straniera vanno per lo più quelli senza occhi dipinti: ogni volta che un desiderio si avvera, gliene si disegna uno con l'inchiostro nero. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\tユニークな形の人形だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tユニークな形の人形だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an uniquely shaped doll.

jp: \t\t寒い季節に使用される暖房家具。潜り込むと気分は洞窟探検者、そんなことを言いながらそのまま中で眠りこける子供が後を絶たないという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t寒い季節に使用される暖房家具。潜り込むと気分は洞窟探検者、そんなことを言いながらそのまま中で眠りこける子供が後を絶たないという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Heating furniture used in the cold season. It is said that there is no end to the number of children who fall asleep in them, saying that they feel like cave explorers when they crawl into them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Heating furniture used in the cold season. It is said that there is no end to the number of children who fall asleep in them, saying that they feel like cave explorers when they crawl into them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile che scalda, per la stagione fredda. A infilarcisi sotto ci si sente esploratori di caverne, e pare che i bambini che lo dicono e poi si addormentano lì dentro non finiscano mai. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t寒い季節用の机。潜ることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t寒い季節用の机。潜ることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a desk for cold weather. You can hide under it.
en_grezzo: "It is a desk for cold weather. You can hide under it."
it: Un tavolo per la stagione fredda. Ci si può infilare sotto.

jp: \t\t中に様々なものが詰まった袋。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t中に様々なものが詰まった袋。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜縁起物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) container that all sorts of things.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) container that all sorts of things."
it: Un sacco pieno di cose di ogni genere. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t地下へようこそ！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして地下空間に繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t地下へようこそ！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして地下空間に繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Welcome to the underground! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to underground space. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Welcome to the underground! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to underground space. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Benvenuti nel sottosuolo! Questo attrezzo eccellente apre in un attimo una via che porta agli spazi sotterranei. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t下る為の石段。潜ることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t下る為の石段。潜ることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are stone steps to descend. You can go downstairs here.
en_grezzo: "These are stone steps to descend. You can go downstairs here."
it: Gradini di pietra per scendere. Ci si può passare.

jp: \t\t地上へおかえり！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして外界へと繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t地上へおかえり！この優れた道具は、一瞬にして外界へと繋がる道を作ってしまうのだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Welcome to the overworld! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to the outside world. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Welcome to the overworld! This excellent tool instantly creates a path that leads to the outside world. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Bentornati in superficie! Questo attrezzo eccellente apre in un attimo una via che porta al mondo di fuori. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t上る為の石段。潜ることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t上る為の石段。潜ることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are stone steps to ascend. You can go upstairs here.
en_grezzo: "These are stone steps to ascend. You can go upstairs here."
it: Gradini di pietra per salire. Ci si può passare.

jp: \t\t名も知らぬ芸術家が作った何ともいえぬ彫像。どうみても奇妙な格好をした人物像なのだが、側面に「創造主」と彫られているので恐らくこれが創造主の姿なのだろう。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t名も知らぬ芸術家が作った何ともいえぬ彫像。どうみても奇妙な格好をした人物像なのだが、側面に「創造主」と彫られているので恐らくこれが創造主の姿なのだろう。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Indescribable statue made by an unknown artist. It appears to be a strangely dressed figure, but the word 'Creator' is engraved on the side, so perhaps this is the figure of the Creator. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Indescribable statue made by an unknown artist. It appears to be a strangely dressed figure, but the word 'Creator' is engraved on the side, so perhaps this is the figure of the Creator. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua indefinibile, opera di un artista di cui non si sa il nome. Comunque la si guardi è la figura di una persona vestita in modo strano, ma sul fianco c'è inciso Creatore: forse allora è questo il suo aspetto. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\tショウルーム用。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tショウルーム用。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a statue of creator from the Moongate world. The power is lost now.
en_grezzo: "It is a statue of creator from the Moongate world. The power is lost now."
it: Serve nella sala d'esposizione. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t悠久の時が作り上げた巨大な水晶。その光は見る者の心を投影し、現世に現すという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t悠久の時が作り上げた巨大な水晶。その光は見る者の心を投影し、現世に現すという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Giant crystals created by time immemorial. It is said that its light projects the heart of the beholder and reveals it in this world. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Giant crystals created by time immemorial. It is said that its light projects the heart of the beholder and reveals it in this world. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un cristallo enorme, che un tempo lunghissimo ha messo insieme. La sua luce, dicono, riflette il cuore di chi guarda e lo porta in questo mondo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

en: \"Just summon adventurers from another world to do the chores for you, neat, right?\" \n# ~Lane, the Fairy Invoker~
en_grezzo: "\"Just summon adventurers from another world to do the chores for you, neat, right?\" \n# ~Lane, the Fairy Invoker~"
it: \"Ti basta evocare avventurieri da un altro mondo e le faccende te le sbrigano loro. Comodo, no?\" \n# ~<Lane>, evocatrice di fate~

jp: \t\tショウルーム用。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tショウルーム用。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool used in showrooms. May be used to summon CNPCs.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool used in showrooms. May be used to summon CNPCs."
it: Serve nella sala d'esposizione. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t何かがペットになる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何かがペットになる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Readable) wampeter of karass, it brings zah-mah-ki-bo to them when read.
en_grezzo: "(Readable) wampeter of karass, it brings zah-mah-ki-bo to them when read."
it: Un libro che fa di qualcosa un compagno. Si legge.

jp: \t\tサーカスの団長等が用いる革製の良くしなる鞭。一度振るえばどんな猛獣であろうと従順になるだろう。\n#～巻かれる為の長いもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tサーカスの団長等が用いる革製の良くしなる鞭。一度振るえばどんな猛獣であろうと従順になるだろう。\n#～巻かれる為の長いもの～\n"
en: Leather whip used by circus leaders and others. Once wielded, it will make any beast of prey obedient. \n# ~Battles, Dragons, Swords and Magic~
en_grezzo: "Leather whip used by circus leaders and others. Once wielded, it will make any beast of prey obedient. \n# ~Battles, Dragons, Swords and Magic~"
it: Una frusta di cuoio, che flette bene, di quelle che usano i capi del circo. Basta schioccarla una volta e qualunque belva diventa docile. \n# ~Cose Lunghe Fatte per Essere Avvolte~

jp: \t\tペットが物を拾うのを禁止できる。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tペットが物を拾うのを禁止できる。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that forbids pet from doing certain actions.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that forbids pet from doing certain actions."
it: Vieta ai compagni di raccogliere roba. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t２つの相容れない感情に苦悩する心を、特殊な素材を用いて表した芸術作品。互いに絡み合った素材達は、さながら本物の心臓の様に微動するのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t２つの相容れない感情に苦悩する心を、特殊な素材を用いて表した芸術作品。互いに絡み合った素材達は、さながら本物の心臓の様に微動するのだという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: This work of art utilizes special materials to depict anguished hearts. The intertwined materials are said to move slightly like a real heart. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "This work of art utilizes special materials to depict anguished hearts. The intertwined materials are said to move slightly like a real heart. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un'opera d'arte che, con materiali particolari, rappresenta un animo in pena fra due sentimenti che non stanno insieme. I materiali, intrecciati l'uno all'altro, si muovono appena, come farebbe un cuore vero. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t対象の心を分析するアイテムだ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t対象の心を分析するアイテムだ。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that analyzes the mind of the target.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that analyzes the mind of the target."
it: Analizza l'animo del bersaglio. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t猫が入っている箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t猫が入っている箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜入れ物＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Una scatola con dentro un gatto. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t船に使われていた木の板だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜盾＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t船に使われていた木の板だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜盾＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a wooden plank that was used on a ship.
en_grezzo: "It is a wooden plank that was used on a ship."
it: Un'asse di legno che stava su una nave.

jp: \t\t読むことですくつに入ることが許される権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことですくつに入ることが許される権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Certificate that allow one to explore the Void at South-West North Tyris.
en_grezzo: "Certificate that allow one to explore the Void at South-West North Tyris."
it: Un atto: letto, dà il permesso di entrare nel Vuoto.

jp: \t\t竜に絶大な効果を持つ刀だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t竜に絶大な効果を持つ刀だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a sword that is immensely effective against dragons.
en_grezzo: "It is a sword that is immensely effective against dragons."
it: Un katana che sui draghi fa un effetto enorme.

jp: \t\t神の発言を聞くことができる首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神の発言を聞くことができる首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a necklace that allows you to hear God's whisper.
en_grezzo: "It is a necklace that allows you to hear God's whisper."
it: Una collana che fa sentire la parola divina.

jp: \t\t強大な魔力を秘めた非常に重い杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t強大な魔力を秘めた非常に重い杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a very heavy staff with immense magical power.
en_grezzo: "It is a very heavy staff with immense magical power."
it: Un bastone pesantissimo, con dentro una magia enorme.

jp: \t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。食べた後に占いを聞くことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t満腹度を回復することができる食物。食べた後に占いを聞くことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can restore satiety, and it will tell you your fortune.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can restore satiety, and it will tell you your fortune."
it: Un cibo che sazia. Dopo averlo mangiato, predice la sorte.

jp: \t\t☆のついた武器防具の名前を変更する巻物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t☆のついた武器防具の名前を変更する巻物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scroll that when read, renames a miracle or godly equipment.
en_grezzo: "It is a scroll that when read, renames a miracle or godly equipment."
it: Cambia il nome a un'arma o armatura eccezionale o celestiale.

jp: \t\t混ぜた物を炎から守るポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t混ぜた物を炎から守るポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that protect items from fire when blended.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that protect items from fire when blended."
it: Mescolata a una cosa, la protegge dal fuoco.

jp: \t\t大きく湾曲した刃を持った刀剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大きく湾曲した刃を持った刀剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scythe with a large curved blade.
en_grezzo: "It is a scythe with a large curved blade."
it: Una lama grande e molto ricurva.

jp: \t\t中に小銭、稀に大金の入った箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t中に小銭、稀に大金の入った箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) container with coins inside and rarely ,large sums of money.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) container with coins inside and rarely ,large sums of money."
it: Una scatola con spiccioli, e di rado un tesoro. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t日々のストレスの解消や、自らを鍛える為に作られた縦長の運動器具。ノースティリスにおけるそれと一般的な物とのささやかな違いは、材質に砂ではなく弱った犠牲者を用いることであろうか。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t日々のストレスの解消や、自らを鍛える為に作られた縦長の運動器具。ノースティリスにおけるそれと一般的な物とのささやかな違いは、材質に砂ではなく弱った犠牲者を用いることであろうか。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Vertical exercise equipment designed to relieve daily stress and to train oneself. The only difference between this and the typical North Tyris sandbag is that it uses weak victims instead of sand as its material. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Vertical exercise equipment designed to relieve daily stress and to train oneself. The only difference between this and the typical North Tyris sandbag is that it uses weak victims instead of sand as its material. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un attrezzo da ginnastica alto e stretto, fatto per scaricare lo stress di ogni giorno e per allenarsi. La piccola differenza fra quello di Tyris del Nord e quello comune, forse, è che come materiale dentro non ci va la sabbia ma una vittima indebolita. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t弱ったモンスターを吊るしあげる道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t弱ったモンスターを吊るしあげる道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that can tie up a weakened monster.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that can tie up a weakened monster."
it: Ci si appende un mostro indebolito. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t空から金貨が降ってくる呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t空から金貨が降ってくる呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 4 Magic. It makes gold pieces rain from the sky.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 4 Magic. It makes gold pieces rain from the sky."
it: Un libro per far piovere monete d'oro dal cielo. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\tアイテムを保持しておく領域を召喚する呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tアイテムを保持しておく領域を召喚する呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 7 Magic. It summons a rift of pocket realm to storage items.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 7 Magic. It summons a rift of pocket realm to storage items."
it: Un libro per evocare uno spazio dove tenere gli oggetti.

jp: \t\t友達以上の相手との友好を深める紙だ。渡すことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t友達以上の相手との友好を深める紙だ。渡すことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a token for your friends, it deepens your relationship.
en_grezzo: "It is a token for your friends, it deepens your relationship."
it: Stringe il legame con chi è più di un amico. Si può dare.

jp: \t\t自らの気持ちを代わりに伝える時に用いる贈答品。無論、使用することはできない。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t自らの気持ちを代わりに伝える時に用いる贈答品。無論、使用することはできない。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: A gift used to convey one's feelings on one's own behalf. Of course, it cannot be used. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "A gift used to convey one's feelings on one's own behalf. Of course, it cannot be used. \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Un dono che si usa per dire, al posto proprio, quel che si sente. Naturalmente non si può usare. \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\t人に渡すと友好度が上がるアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜その他＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人に渡すと友好度が上がるアイテムだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜その他＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a gift given to raise affection, won't be returned.
en_grezzo: "It is a gift given to raise affection, won't be returned."
it: Dato a qualcuno, alza la simpatia.

jp: \t\t出血と炎上を防ぐ腰当だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t出血と炎上を防ぐ腰当だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a waistband that prevents bleeding and burning.
en_grezzo: "It is a waistband that prevents bleeding and burning."
it: Una cintura che ferma il sanguinamento e le fiamme.

jp: \t\t出血を促す盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t出血を促す盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a shield that induce bleeding.
en_grezzo: "It is a shield that induce bleeding."

jp: \t\t鉄壁を誇る楽器の形状の盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜盾＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鉄壁を誇る楽器の形状の盾だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜盾＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a shield in the shape of an instrument.
en_grezzo: "It is a shield in the shape of an instrument."
it: Uno scudo a forma di strumento musicale, difende come un muro.

jp: \t\t暗殺用の重いピアノだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t暗殺用の重いピアノだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a heavy piano for assassination.
en_grezzo: "It is a heavy piano for assassination."
it: Un pianoforte pesante, fatto per assassinare.

jp: \t\t特に効果の無い紙だ。収集している人を探そう。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特に効果の無い紙だ。収集している人を探そう。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are tickets given out to promising musicians. Some collect these.
en_grezzo: "These are tickets given out to promising musicians. Some collect these."
it: Un foglio senza alcun effetto. Cerca qualcuno che li collezioni.

jp: \t\t追加打撃の機会を得られる首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t追加打撃の機会を得られる首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a necklace that provides a chance for extra strikes.
en_grezzo: "It is a necklace that provides a chance for extra strikes."
it: Una collana che dà la probabilità di un attacco extra in mischia.

jp: \t\t追加射撃の機会を得られる首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t追加射撃の機会を得られる首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a necklace that gives a chance for an additional shot.
en_grezzo: "It is a necklace that gives a chance for an additional shot."
it: Una collana che dà la probabilità di un attacco extra a distanza.

jp: \t\tさる高名な芸術家が作った、幸運な女神を模った彫像。その屈託ない笑顔は、どことなく愛くるしい。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tさる高名な芸術家が作った、幸運な女神を模った彫像。その屈託ない笑顔は、どことなく愛くるしい。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A statue in the shape of the Goddess of Luck. created by a renowned artist. Her carefree smile is irresistibly endearing. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A statue in the shape of the Goddess of Luck. created by a renowned artist. Her carefree smile is irresistibly endearing. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua che raffigura la dea della fortuna, opera di un artista famoso. Il sorriso spensierato ha un non so che di tenero. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t幸運の女神を模った彫像。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t幸運の女神を模った彫像。定期的に使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a statue of Goddess of Luck. May be used periodically.
en_grezzo: "It is a statue of Goddess of Luck. May be used periodically."
it: Una statua della dea della fortuna. Si usa ogni tanto.

jp: \t\t神の落とし物とも言われる、非常に上質なベッド。その優しい肌触りは寝る者の心を豊かにするという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神の落とし物とも言われる、非常に上質なベッド。その優しい肌触りは寝る者の心を豊かにするという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A very high quality bed, said to be God's gift to the world. Its gentle touch is said to enrich the hearts of those who sleep on it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A very high quality bed, said to be God's gift to the world. Its gentle touch is said to enrich the hearts of those who sleep on it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un letto di qualità altissima, che qualcuno dice perduto da un dio. Quel tocco gentile, dicono, fa ricco il cuore di chi ci dorme.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t非常に優れた寝具（ランク９）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に優れた寝具（ランク９）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un letto eccellente (rango 9). Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t非常に大きく武骨な大剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に大きく武骨な大剣だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a very large and martial greatsword.
en_grezzo: "It is a very large and martial greatsword."

jp: \t\tシーナの使用していた下着だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tシーナの使用していた下着だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: La biancheria che Shena ha portato.

jp: \t\t見ているだけで不快な気分を感じる謎の宝石。使用することができるが、効果の程を確認した者はいないという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t見ているだけで不快な気分を感じる謎の宝石。使用することができるが、効果の程を確認した者はいないという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A mysterious gemstone that makes you feel uncomfortable just by looking at it. It can be used, but no one has confirmed its effectiveness. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A mysterious gemstone that makes you feel uncomfortable just by looking at it. It can be used, but no one has confirmed its effectiveness. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una gemma misteriosa che, solo a guardarla, mette a disagio. Si può usare, ma pare che nessuno abbia mai visto che effetto faccia. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t使用することで、今後に何か変化をもたらす宝石だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜宝珠＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用することで、今後に何か変化をもたらす宝石だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜宝珠＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable?) gem that changes the past of the future.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable?) gem that changes the past of the future."
it: Una gemma che, usata, cambierà qualcosa più avanti.

jp: \t\t重い石ころ。装備することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜廃品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t重い石ころ。装備することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜廃品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a heavy pebble. Can be equipped.
en_grezzo: "It is a heavy pebble. Can be equipped."
it: Un sasso pesante. Si può equipaggiare.

jp: \t\t収穫の神が与えたもう一度の奇跡。使用すると光を放ち、そこで得も言われぬ経験をすることができるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t収穫の神が与えたもう一度の奇跡。使用すると光を放ち、そこで得も言われぬ経験をすることができるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Another miracle given by the God of Harvest. It is said that when you use it, it emits light and you can have an unforgettable experience there. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Another miracle given by the God of Harvest. It is said that when you use it, it emits light and you can have an unforgettable experience there. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: L'altro miracolo che il dio del raccolto ha concesso. A usarla manda luce, e lì dentro, dicono, si fa un'esperienza che non si sa dire. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t使用することで、新たなフィートを得ることができる宝石だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜宝珠＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用することで、新たなフィートを得ることができる宝石だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜宝珠＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that grants you a feat.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that grants you a feat."
it: Una gemma che dà un talento nuovo (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t着弾すると周囲に爆風を起こす投擲用武器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t着弾すると周囲に爆風を起こす投擲用武器だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a throwing weapon that creates a blast around it when it lands.
en_grezzo: "It is a throwing weapon that creates a blast around it when it lands."
it: Un'arma da lancio che cadendo fa scoppiare l'aria intorno.

jp: \t\t読むことで物件としてのダンジョンを作ることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことで物件としてのダンジョンを作ることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) Readable deed used to build a dungeon.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) Readable deed used to build a dungeon."
it: Un atto: letto, fa nascere un sotterraneo.

jp: \t\t有効的な変異を得ることができるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t有効的な変異を得ることができるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that causes advantageous mutations.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that causes advantageous mutations."
it: Una pozione che porta mutazioni utili.

jp: \t\t致命傷を負った時、確率でそのダメージを０にする呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t致命傷を負った時、確率でそのダメージを０にする呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 12 Magic. The blessing negates fatal damage occasionally.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 12 Magic. The blessing negates fatal damage occasionally."
it: Un libro per azzerare, a volte, un colpo mortale.

jp: \t\t致命傷を負った時、確率でそのダメージを０にする巻物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t致命傷を負った時、確率でそのダメージを０にする巻物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scroll that when read, allow you to sometimes cheat Death.
en_grezzo: "It is a scroll that when read, allow you to sometimes cheat Death."
it: A volte azzera il colpo che sarebbe mortale.

jp: \t\t死んでいる者を復活させる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t死んでいる者を復活させる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Readable) book that can resurrect dead people.
en_grezzo: "(Readable) book that can resurrect dead people."
it: Un libro che riporta in vita i morti. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\t演奏の名手の元に訪れるという伝説のヴァイオリン。その音色は聴衆の心に大きく響き、奏者へ感謝の贈り物をする者が後を絶たないという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t演奏の名手の元に訪れるという伝説のヴァイオリン。その音色は聴衆の心に大きく響き、奏者へ感謝の贈り物をする者が後を絶たないという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The legendary violin is said to be a favorite of virtuoso performers. Its sound resonates so loudly in the hearts of its listeners that there is no end to the number of people who give the violinist a gift of appreciation. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The legendary violin is said to be a favorite of virtuoso performers. Its sound resonates so loudly in the hearts of its listeners that there is no end to the number of people who give the violinist a gift of appreciation. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il violino leggendario che, si dice, va a cercarsi i maestri dell'esecuzione. Il suo timbro risuona forte nel cuore di chi ascolta, e non finiscono mai quelli che fanno un dono di riconoscenza a chi suona. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tおひねりの質が上がる演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tおひねりの質が上がる演奏用の道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) Rank 4 instrument that increases the rewords of performing.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) Rank 4 instrument that increases the rewords of performing."
it: Suonandolo si prendono mance migliori. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\tレベルを下げるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tレベルを下げるポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that induces level-lowering effect.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that induces level-lowering effect."
it: Una pozione che abbassa il livello.

jp: \t\t不幸な出来事から身を守る首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t不幸な出来事から身を守る首輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a necklace that protects you from unfortunate events.
en_grezzo: "It is a necklace that protects you from unfortunate events."
it: Una collana che protegge dalle disgrazie.

jp: \t\t使用することで周囲に高音を響かせる笛。どんなに眠った者でもたちどころに起こすその音は、さながら終末を呼び起こす災厄の角笛の様だ。…少なくとも眠っていた者にとっては。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用することで周囲に高音を響かせる笛。どんなに眠った者でもたちどころに起こすその音は、さながら終末を呼び起こす災厄の角笛の様だ。…少なくとも眠っていた者にとっては。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A whistle that produces a high-pitched sound when used. The sound, which can wake even the most sleepy person instantly, is like a horn of calamity that evokes the apocalypse. ...at least for those who have been asleep. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A whistle that produces a high-pitched sound when used. The sound, which can wake even the most sleepy person instantly, is like a horn of calamity that evokes the apocalypse. ...at least for those who have been asleep. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Un fischietto che, a usarlo, manda intorno un suono acuto. Quel suono sveglia in un attimo chiunque, per quanto dorma sodo: pare il corno della sciagura che chiama la fine del mondo. ...Almeno per chi stava dormendo. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t周囲に高音を響かせる笛。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t周囲に高音を響かせる笛。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that creates a high pitch noise.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that creates a high pitch noise."
it: Manda un suono acuto tutt'intorno. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t運勢が上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t運勢が上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that brings luck when eaten.
en_grezzo: "It is food that brings luck when eaten."
it: Un cibo che alza la fortuna.

jp: \t\tカードを保管しておくための容れ物。貴族達の中にはコレクションに飽き足らず、これを用いた遊戯を考え出す者まで現れたという。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tカードを保管しておくための容れ物。貴族達の中にはコレクションに飽き足らず、これを用いた遊戯を考え出す者まで現れたという。\n#～打切上等！箱マニア・創刊号～\n"
en: A container for storing cards. Some aristocrats were not satisfied with the collection and even came up with the idea of using it for games. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~
en_grezzo: "A container for storing cards. Some aristocrats were not satisfied with the collection and even came up with the idea of using it for games. \n# ~Censored! Box Mania, First Issue~"
it: Un contenitore per tenerci le carte. Fra i nobili, dicono, c'è stato perfino chi, non contento di collezionarle, si è inventato un gioco da farci. \n# ~Chiudeteci Pure! Box Mania, Numero Uno~

jp: \t\tカードを収納できる箱。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tカードを収納できる箱。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Una scatola per le carte. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t町の情勢を知る本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t町の情勢を知る本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Readable) book about what's going on in town.
en_grezzo: "(Readable) book about what's going on in town."
it: Un libro che dice come va in città. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\t特別な存在を捕らえる為に作られた、怪しく光る機械仕掛けの玉。内部に快適な空間を作り出そうと、相当な機構的に無茶をしている為、投擲に失敗するだけで壊れて無くなってしまう。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特別な存在を捕らえる為に作られた、怪しく光る機械仕掛けの玉。内部に快適な空間を作り出そうと、相当な機構的に無茶をしている為、投擲に失敗するだけで壊れて無くなってしまう。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"
en: Suspiciously glowing mechanical balls made to capture special beings. The ball is so mechanically reckless in its attempt to create a comfortable space inside that it breaks and disappears when thrown unsuccessfully. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~
en_grezzo: "Suspiciously glowing mechanical balls made to capture special beings. The ball is so mechanically reckless in its attempt to create a comfortable space inside that it breaks and disappears when thrown unsuccessfully. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: Una sfera meccanica dalla luce sospetta, fatta per catturare esseri speciali. Per ricavarci dentro uno spazio comodo hanno forzato parecchio il meccanismo, e basta sbagliare il lancio perché si rompa e sparisca. \n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\tリトルシスターにぶつけて捕獲できる玉。投げることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tリトルシスターにぶつけて捕獲できる玉。投げることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a throwable tool that can be used to capture 'Little Sister'.
en_grezzo: "It is a throwable tool that can be used to capture 'Little Sister'."
it: Colpisce e cattura la <Little Sister>. Si può lanciare.

jp: \t\t塩辛いだけのポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t塩辛いだけのポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that's just salty.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that's just salty."
it: Una pozione che è soltanto salata.

jp: \t\t魔法属性のボルトを唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魔法属性のボルトを唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 2 Magic. Bolt type spell that does magic damage.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 2 Magic. Bolt type spell that does magic damage."
it: Un libro per una saetta magica. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\t範囲的な魔法属性の呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t範囲的な魔法属性の呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 5 Magic. Area of Effect spell that does magical damage.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 5 Magic. Area of Effect spell that does magical damage."
it: Un libro per una magia ad area arcana. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\tクリティカルが出やすい大斧だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tクリティカルが出やすい大斧だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a big axe that can easily deliver a critical hit.
en_grezzo: "It is a big axe that can easily deliver a critical hit."
it: Un'ascia lunga che fa spesso colpi critici.

jp: \t\t部屋の仕切りとして用いられる家具。お洒落な雰囲気を家に醸し出すことができる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t部屋の仕切りとして用いられる家具。お洒落な雰囲気を家に醸し出すことができる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Furniture used as room dividers. It can create a stylish atmosphere in a house. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Furniture used as room dividers. It can create a stylish atmosphere in a house. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile che si usa per dividere le stanze. Dà alla casa un'aria di eleganza. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t空間用の仕切りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t空間用の仕切りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un pannello che divide lo spazio.

jp: \t\t両手で持ち弦を弾いて音を出す弦楽器。持ち運びには適さないが、そのゆったりとした音は聴衆を優雅な気分にさせることだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t両手で持ち弦を弾いて音を出す弦楽器。持ち運びには適さないが、そのゆったりとした音は聴衆を優雅な気分にさせることだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A stringed instrument that is held with both hands and the strings are plucked to produce sound. It is not suitable for carrying around, but its relaxing sound will make the audience feel elegant. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A stringed instrument that is held with both hands and the strings are plucked to produce sound. It is not suitable for carrying around, but its relaxing sound will make the audience feel elegant. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a corde che si tiene con tutte e due le mani e suona a pizzico. Portarselo dietro non è comodo, ma il suo suono disteso metterà chi ascolta in uno stato d'animo elegante. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t軽い音で旋律を奏でる特殊な楽器。小さな体から発せられる楽しげな音は、聞いている方まで楽しくさせるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t軽い音で旋律を奏でる特殊な楽器。小さな体から発せられる楽しげな音は、聞いている方まで楽しくさせるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A special instrument that plays a melody with a light sound. The joyful sound emitted from its small body is said to make even the listener happy. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A special instrument that plays a melody with a light sound. The joyful sound emitted from its small body is said to make even the listener happy. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento particolare, che porta la melodia con un suono leggero. Il suono allegro che esce da quel corpo piccolo, dicono, mette allegria anche a chi ascolta. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t掻き鳴らすことで音を発す弦楽器。卵を縦半分に切ったような特異な形状は、内部に音を反響させ、音色に深みを与えることに一役買っている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t掻き鳴らすことで音を発す弦楽器。卵を縦半分に切ったような特異な形状は、内部に音を反響させ、音色に深みを与えることに一役買っている。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A stringed instrument that produces sound by scratching. Its peculiar shape, which resembles an egg cut in half lengthwise, helps to reverberate the sound inside and give depth to the tone. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A stringed instrument that produces sound by scratching. Its peculiar shape, which resembles an egg cut in half lengthwise, helps to reverberate the sound inside and give depth to the tone. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a corde che dà suono se lo si gratta. La forma singolare, come un uovo tagliato per il lungo, serve a far risuonare il suono all'interno e a dare profondità al timbro. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t幾つかの管を重ねた管楽器。音程が安定しにくく、これを扱う演奏家は絶えず調律する必要があるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t幾つかの管を重ねた管楽器。音程が安定しにくく、これを扱う演奏家は絶えず調律する必要があるという。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: A wind instrument consisting of several layered tubes. It is said to be difficult to keep the pitch stable, so players who handle it need to tune it constantly. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "A wind instrument consisting of several layered tubes. It is said to be difficult to keep the pitch stable, so players who handle it need to tune it constantly. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a fiato fatto di più canne accostate. L'intonazione fa fatica a restare ferma, e chi lo suona deve accordarlo di continuo. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\tかつて処刑用に存在した世にも恐ろしき刑具。余りにシンプルな構造なそれは犠牲者の首を落とす為だけに作られている。今は使われていないようだが決して油断する勿れ。刃は常にあなたの頭上で鈍く光っている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tかつて処刑用に存在した世にも恐ろしき刑具。余りにシンプルな構造なそれは犠牲者の首を落とす為だけに作られている。今は使われていないようだが決して油断する勿れ。刃は常にあなたの頭上で鈍く光っている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: This is a horrifying device that once existed for executions. It is so simple in structure that it was made only for the purpose of decapitating the victim's head. It may not be used anymore, but never be too careful. The blade always glints dully above your head. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "This is a horrifying device that once existed for executions. It is so simple in structure that it was made only for the purpose of decapitating the victim's head. It may not be used anymore, but never be too careful. The blade always glints dully above your head. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Uno strumento di pena orribile come pochi, che un tempo serviva alle esecuzioni. Ha una struttura così semplice perché è fatto per una cosa sola: far cadere la testa alla vittima. Pare che oggi non si usi più, ma non abbassare la guardia: la lama sopra di te manda sempre un luccichio spento. \n# ~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

en: \"You are sure to get ahead in life with one of these!\" \n# ~words of a ex-excutioner~
en_grezzo: "\"You are sure to get ahead in life with one of these!\" \n# ~words of a ex-excutioner~"
it: \"Con uno di questi, nella vita, si va avanti: gli altri restano indietro di una testa!\" \n# ~parole di un ex boia~

jp: \t\t見た目にも恐ろしい家具。触らぬ方がよいだろう。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具？＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t見た目にも恐ろしい家具。触らぬ方がよいだろう。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具？＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a horrible looking furniture. It is best not to touch it.
en_grezzo: "It is a horrible looking furniture. It is best not to touch it."
it: Un mobile orribile a vedersi. Meglio non toccarlo.

jp: \t\tかつて拷問用に存在した世にも恐ろしき刑具。前面が左右に開く構造で、その内部には血に飢えた鉄針が中心へ向かって突き出ている。話によれば動き出すものもあるらしく、興味本位で触らない方がいいだろう。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tかつて拷問用に存在した世にも恐ろしき刑具。前面が左右に開く構造で、その内部には血に飢えた鉄針が中心へ向かって突き出ている。話によれば動き出すものもあるらしく、興味本位で触らない方がいいだろう。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: This is a horrifying device that once existed for torture. The front of the structure opens to the left and right, and inside the structure are bloodthirsty iron needles protruding toward the center. According to the story, some of them start to move, so it would be better not to touch them out of curiosity. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "This is a horrifying device that once existed for torture. The front of the structure opens to the left and right, and inside the structure are bloodthirsty iron needles protruding toward the center. According to the story, some of them start to move, so it would be better not to touch them out of curiosity. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Uno strumento di pena orribile come pochi, che un tempo serviva a far parlare. Il davanti si apre in due, e dentro ci sono aghi di ferro assetati di sangue che sporgono verso il centro. Si racconta che qualcuno si metta in moto da solo: meglio non toccarlo per curiosità. \n# ~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t古代の知識が書き込まれた書。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n

it: Un libro con dentro un sapere antico. Si può leggere.

jp_grezzo: "\t\tさる高名な芸術家が作った、癒しの女神を模った彫像。その控えめな姿勢は、どことなく清楚さを感じる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A statue in the shape of the Goddess of Healing. created by a renowned artist. Its modest posture is somehow pure and innocent. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A statue in the shape of the Goddess of Healing. created by a renowned artist. Its modest posture is somehow pure and innocent. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"

jp: \t\t投げることで弱った敵を捕獲する機械仕掛けの玉。詳しい製法は不明だが、遺伝子学の隆盛がこの道具の進化に大いに関わっていると考えられている。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t投げることで弱った敵を捕獲する機械仕掛けの玉。詳しい製法は不明だが、遺伝子学の隆盛がこの道具の進化に大いに関わっていると考えられている。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"
en: A mechanical ball that is thrown to capture weakened enemies. The detailed manufacturing process is unknown, but it is believed that the rise of genetics had much to do with the evolution of this tool. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~
en_grezzo: "A mechanical ball that is thrown to capture weakened enemies. The detailed manufacturing process is unknown, but it is believed that the rise of genetics had much to do with the evolution of this tool. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: Una sfera meccanica che, lanciata, cattura i nemici indeboliti. Come sia fatta di preciso non si sa, ma si pensa che il fiorire della genetica c'entri molto con l'evoluzione di questo arnese. \n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\tモンスターにぶつけて捕獲できる玉。投げることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tモンスターにぶつけて捕獲できる玉。投げることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a throwable tool that can be used to capture monsters.
en_grezzo: "It is a throwable tool that can be used to capture monsters."
it: Colpisce e cattura un mostro. Si può lanciare.

jp: \t\t透明な円柱形をした奇妙な機械。その正体は生物を粒子状に分解して能力だけを取り出し、他の生物にその能力を付加することができるという、何とも常軌を逸する悪魔の機械なのだ。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t透明な円柱形をした奇妙な機械。その正体は生物を粒子状に分解して能力だけを取り出し、他の生物にその能力を付加することができるという、何とも常軌を逸する悪魔の機械なのだ。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"
en: A strange machine in the shape of a transparent cylinder. It is a devilish machine that deviates from the norm, capable of breaking down living organisms into particles, extracting only their abilities, and then adding those abilities to other living organisms. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~
en_grezzo: "A strange machine in the shape of a transparent cylinder. It is a devilish machine that deviates from the norm, capable of breaking down living organisms into particles, extracting only their abilities, and then adding those abilities to other living organisms. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: Una macchina strana, un cilindro trasparente. In verità è una macchina diabolica e fuori da ogni regola: scompone un essere vivente in particelle, ne cava fuori le sole doti e quelle doti le aggiunge a un altro essere. \n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\tペットを１体消去し別のペットへ能力吸収させる機械。何度でも使用できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tペットを１体消去し別のペットへ能力吸収させる機械。何度でも使用できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that erases a pet and transfers its ability to another."
it: Cancella un compagno e dà le sue doti a un altro. Si usa sempre.

jp: \t\t宇宙よりもたらされた謎の高エネルギー結晶体。中には異星の戦士たちの叡智が詰まっているとも言われているが詳細は不明。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t宇宙よりもたらされた謎の高エネルギー結晶体。中には異星の戦士たちの叡智が詰まっているとも言われているが詳細は不明。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
