en_grezzo: "It is a statue of God of Earth. May be used periodically."
it: Una statua del dio della terra. Si usa ogni tanto.

jp: \t\t速度が上昇する指輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t速度が上昇する指輪だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a rare magical ring that increases your speed.
en_grezzo: "It is a rare magical ring that increases your speed."
it: Un anello che alza la velocità.

jp: \t\t所持するだけでモンスターの支配成功率が上昇する道具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t所持するだけでモンスターの支配成功率が上昇する道具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) tool that enhances your mastery of monsters.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) tool that enhances your mastery of monsters."
it: Portato addosso, alza le probabilità di dominare i mostri.

jp: \t\tマナが上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tマナが上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a fruit increase mana when eaten.
en_grezzo: "It is a fruit increase mana when eaten."
it: Un cibo che alza il mana.

jp: \t\t旅の歩みを早める靴だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t旅の歩みを早める靴だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜防具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are shoes that speed up the journey.
en_grezzo: "These are shoes that speed up the journey."
it: Delle scarpe che fanno viaggiare più svelti.

jp: \t\t暗黒属性の矢を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t暗黒属性の矢を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 4 Magic. Arrow type spell that does darkness damage.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 4 Magic. Arrow type spell that does darkness damage."
it: Un libro per una freccia d'oscurità. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\t折りたたむことができる、雰囲気ある間仕切り。かつて異国の若い僧侶がこれの一つに封じ込まれた虎を倒そうとしたことがあるとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t折りたたむことができる、雰囲気ある間仕切り。かつて異国の若い僧侶がこれの一つに封じ込まれた虎を倒そうとしたことがあるとか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: An atmospheric partition that can be folded. A young monk from another country once tried to defeat a tiger enclosed in one of these. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "An atmospheric partition that can be folded. A young monk from another country once tried to defeat a tiger enclosed in one of these. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un paravento pieghevole, di quelli che fanno atmosfera. Pare che in terra straniera un giovane monaco abbia provato una volta ad abbattere la tigre chiusa dentro uno di questi. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t和風の間仕切りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t和風の間仕切りだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t持ち運びやすいように作られた照明器具。装飾品としても扱われる他、異国では、ガードが夜警の為に持ち歩いているという話だ。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t持ち運びやすいように作られた照明器具。装飾品としても扱われる他、異国では、ガードが夜警の為に持ち歩いているという話だ。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Lighting devices made to be easily carried around. Besides being treated as ornaments, it is said that in foreign countries, guards carry them with them for night watch. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Lighting devices made to be easily carried around. Besides being treated as ornaments, it is said that in foreign countries, guards carry them with them for night watch. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un lume fatto per portarlo in giro comodamente. Oltre a servire da ornamento, in terra straniera pare che le guardie se lo portino appresso per la ronda di notte. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t異国の簡易照明。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国の簡易照明。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an exotic lighting. Illuminates the surroundings softly at night.
en_grezzo: "It is an exotic lighting. Illuminates the surroundings softly at night."
it: Un lume semplice straniero. Di notte fa una luce fioca.

jp: \t\t異国情緒あふれる丸型の窓。取り付ければ何となく外国を訪れている気分にさせるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国情緒あふれる丸型の窓。取り付ければ何となく外国を訪れている気分にさせるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Exotic round windows. When installed, they are said to make people feel as if they are visiting a foreign country. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Exotic round windows. When installed, they are said to make people feel as if they are visiting a foreign country. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra tonda, tutta profumo di terre lontane. Montata in casa, dicono, mette addosso la sensazione di essere in viaggio all'estero. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t円形をした窓。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t円形をした窓。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a circular window. Illuminates the surroundings softly at night.
en_grezzo: "It is a circular window. Illuminates the surroundings softly at night."
it: Una finestra tonda. Di notte fa una luce fioca.

jp: \t\t照明を安置する為の石造りの構造物。これが一台あるだけで周囲が厳かな雰囲気に包まれるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t照明を安置する為の石造りの構造物。これが一台あるだけで周囲が厳かな雰囲気に包まれるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A stone structure used to enshrine lighting. It is said that the mere presence of one of these lamps creates a solemn atmosphere in the surrounding area. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A stone structure used to enshrine lighting. It is said that the mere presence of one of these lamps creates a solemn atmosphere in the surrounding area. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una costruzione di pietra fatta per posarci dentro un lume. Basta che ce ne sia una perché tutto intorno si riempia di un'aria solenne. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t異国の重い照明。常に周囲を照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国の重い照明。常に周囲を照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an exotic heavy lighting. Always illuminates the surroundings.
en_grezzo: "It is an exotic heavy lighting. Always illuminates the surroundings."
it: Un lume straniero e pesante. Illumina sempre intorno.

jp: \t\t生命力が上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t生命力が上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is food that can increase your life energy.
en_grezzo: "It is food that can increase your life energy."
it: Un cibo che alza la vita.

jp: \t\t２人用のやや幅広な寝具。想定人数は２人だが詰めれば４人までいけるので、困窮にあえぐ冒険者の一団が金額を折半して皆でこのベッドに寝ることもあるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t２人用のやや幅広な寝具。想定人数は２人だが詰めれば４人までいけるので、困窮にあえぐ冒険者の一団が金額を折半して皆でこのベッドに寝ることもあるようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A rather wide bedding for two. The beds are designed for two people, but can accommodate up to four if they are packed together, so a group of adventurers in dire straits may split the cost and sleep together on these beds. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A rather wide bedding for two. The beds are designed for two people, but can accommodate up to four if they are packed together, so a group of adventurers in dire straits may split the cost and sleep together on these beds. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un letto un po' largo, per due. Il conto è di due persone, ma stringendosi ci si sta anche in quattro, e capita che una brigata di avventurieri al verde divida la spesa e ci dorma tutta insieme.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t眠る為の家具（ランク７）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t眠る為の家具（ランク７）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un letto (rango 7). Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t不用品をかき集め、うず高く積んだとても重い物体。本来持ち運ぶようなものではないが、どうしても持ち運ばなければならない事情がある時は、廃品の一部にならないように細心の注意を払おう。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t不用品をかき集め、うず高く積んだとても重い物体。本来持ち運ぶようなものではないが、どうしても持ち運ばなければならない事情がある時は、廃品の一部にならないように細心の注意を払おう。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n"
en: Unused items are gathered up and piled up high in a very heavy pile. It is not something you would normally carry, but if you have to carry it under certain circumstances, be very careful not to become part of the waste. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~
en_grezzo: "Unused items are gathered up and piled up high in a very heavy pile. It is not something you would normally carry, but if you have to carry it under certain circumstances, be very careful not to become part of the waste. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~"
it: Roba inutile raccattata e ammucchiata fin su, pesantissima. Non è cosa che di solito si porti in giro; ma se proprio tocca farlo, conviene stare attentissimi a non finire parte del mucchio.\n#~Le Mille Cianfrusaglie che Amo~

jp: \t\t特に使い道はない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜廃品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特に使い道はない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜廃品＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Non serve a niente in particolare.

jp: \t\t水周りの仕事を一手に引き受ける流し台。非常に巨大で重量もある為持ち運びには注意が必要だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t水周りの仕事を一手に引き受ける流し台。非常に巨大で重量もある為持ち運びには注意が必要だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A sink that takes care of all water-related work. It is very huge and heavy, so care must be taken when carrying it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A sink that takes care of all water-related work. It is very huge and heavy, so care must be taken when carrying it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un lavello che si prende in carico tutto il lavoro dell'acqua. È enorme e pesa molto, quindi a portarlo in giro ci vuole attenzione. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t大きな流し台だ。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大きな流し台だ。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a large sink. Cannot be used.
en_grezzo: "It is a large sink. Cannot be used."
it: Un grande lavello. Non si può usare.

jp: \t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた食器棚。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない部分に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tその道のプロが精魂込めて作り上げた食器棚。一見シンプルに見えるが、普段見えない部分に匠の遊び心が隠れている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A cupboard created by professionals who put their hearts and souls into their work. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A cupboard created by professionals who put their hearts and souls into their work. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una credenza costruita con tutta l'anima da chi è maestro del mestiere. A prima vista sembra semplice, ma nelle parti che di solito non si vedono si nasconde l'estro dell'artigiano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t匠の作った食器用の棚だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t匠の作った食器用の棚だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a cupboard made by a master craftsman.
en_grezzo: "It is a cupboard made by a master craftsman."
it: Una credenza fatta da un maestro artigiano.

jp: \t\t水を使用する設備。何度か飲むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜設備＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t水を使用する設備。何度か飲むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜設備＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un impianto che usa l'acqua. Si può bere più volte.

jp: \t\t小さな花達を守る為、簡易な塀が取り付けられている花壇だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さな花達を守る為、簡易な塀が取り付けられている花壇だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A flower bed with a simple fence attached to protect the small flowers. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A flower bed with a simple fence attached to protect the small flowers. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un'aiuola a cui hanno montato una recinzione semplice, per proteggere i fiori piccoli. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t間仕切りのついた花壇だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜壇＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t間仕切りのついた花壇だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜壇＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a beautiful bed of flowers, with a partition.
en_grezzo: "It is a beautiful bed of flowers, with a partition."

jp: \t\tゆったりとした安定感抜群の長椅子。我が家でくつろぐには最適な家具だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tゆったりとした安定感抜群の長椅子。我が家でくつろぐには最適な家具だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A spacious and stable chaise longue. It would be the perfect furniture for relaxing in one's own home. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A spacious and stable chaise longue. It would be the perfect furniture for relaxing in one's own home. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un divano ampio, di una stabilità eccellente. È il mobile giusto per starsene in pace a casa propria. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t座る為の家具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t座る為の家具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un mobile per sedersi. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t白墨で書かれた文字を書き消しできる巨大な板。大抵の学び舎にはこの板が備え付けられているという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t白墨で書かれた文字を書き消しできる巨大な板。大抵の学び舎にはこの板が備え付けられているという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A huge board on which letters written in white ink can be written and erased. Most schools are equipped with this board. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A huge board on which letters written in white ink can be written and erased. Most schools are equipped with this board. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una tavola enorme su cui si scrive col gesso bianco e si cancella. Quasi tutte le scuole ne hanno una. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t書き消し自由な板。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t書き消し自由な板。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a board that is free to write on and erase. Cannot be used.
en_grezzo: "It is a board that is free to write on and erase. Cannot be used."
it: Una tavola su cui scrivere e cancellare. Non si può usare.

jp: \t\t品書が書かれた板。お店のオススメなる料理が書かれているが、それがどこの町のものかは定かではない。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t品書が書かれた板。お店のオススメなる料理が書かれているが、それがどこの町のものかは定かではない。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A board with a list of items. It contains the restaurant's recommended dishes, but it is not certain which town they are from. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A board with a list of items. It contains the restaurant's recommended dishes, but it is not certain which town they are from. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una tavola con scritta la lista dei piatti. Ci sono le specialità del locale, ma di che città siano non è chiaro. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\tメニューが書かれた板だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tメニューが書かれた板だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a menu for a restaurant.
en_grezzo: "It is a menu for a restaurant."
it: Una tavola con scritto il menù.

jp: \t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い箪笥。機能性を損なう程に鮮やかな装飾がなされている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い箪笥。機能性を損なう程に鮮やかな装飾がなされている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A cabinet of drawers honored by the King's warrant. It is so brilliantly decorated that its functionality is compromised. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A cabinet of drawers honored by the King's warrant. It is so brilliantly decorated that its functionality is compromised. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una cassettiera di gran fama, fornitrice del re. È decorata così vivacemente da rimetterci in funzionalità. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t王様御用達の箪笥だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t王様御用達の箪笥だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a king's royal cabinet.

jp: \t\t間仕切りが付けられた室内用窓。覗きを嫌うレイディー達がこぞって買っていくという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t間仕切りが付けられた室内用窓。覗きを嫌うレイディー達がこぞって買っていくという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: An interior window with a partition attached. It is said that ladies who don't like peeping are buying them all the time. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "An interior window with a partition attached. It is said that ladies who don't like peeping are buying them all the time. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra da interni con un divisorio montato sopra. Dicono che le dame a cui dà noia essere spiate la comprino a gara. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t間仕切りのついた窓。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t間仕切りのついた窓。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a window with partitions. illuminates the surroundings softly.
en_grezzo: "It is a window with partitions. illuminates the surroundings softly."
it: Una finestra con un divisorio. Di notte fa una luce fioca.

jp: \t\t異国から伝わりし地面に直接布を敷く寝具。布越しとはいえ堅い地面と背中合わせなので、寝心地はそれほど良くないようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国から伝わりし地面に直接布を敷く寝具。布越しとはいえ堅い地面と背中合わせなので、寝心地はそれほど良くないようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This type of bedding was introduced from a foreign land, and the mattress is laid directly on the ground. Although it is made of cloth, it is not very comfortable because it is placed on the back of the bed against the hard ground. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This type of bedding was introduced from a foreign land, and the mattress is laid directly on the ground. Although it is made of cloth, it is not very comfortable because it is placed on the back of the bed against the hard ground. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio venuto da un paese straniero, che si stende in terra e basta. Anche se in mezzo c'è la stoffa, si sta schiena contro schiena col terreno duro, e a dormirci non pare granché comodo. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t簡易的な寝具（ランク４）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t簡易的な寝具（ランク４）。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un letto semplice (rango 4). Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t穀物が詰まった藁製の袋。風通しが良く穀物が傷みにくい為、広く使われている。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t穀物が詰まった藁製の袋。風通しが良く穀物が傷みにくい為、広く使われている。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Straw bags filled with grain. Widely used because of its good ventilation and resistance to damage of grains. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Straw bags filled with grain. Widely used because of its good ventilation and resistance to damage of grains. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un sacco di paglia pieno di granaglie. Si usa molto perché lascia passare l'aria e il grano si guasta poco. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t穀物が入った袋だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t穀物が入った袋だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a barrel for holding rice.
en_grezzo: "It is a barrel for holding rice."

jp: \t\t４種の食物を腐らすことなく保持する箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t４種の食物を腐らすことなく保持する箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) container that can hold 4 types of food.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) container that can hold 4 types of food."
it: Tiene 4 cibi senza farli marcire. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t幻の一角獣の角。煎じて飲み下すことで体内の不安や狂気を取り去ってくれるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t幻の一角獣の角。煎じて飲み下すことで体内の不安や狂気を取り去ってくれるという。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The horn of the mythical unicorn. It is said to remove anxiety and madness from the body when decocted and consumed. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The horn of the mythical unicorn. It is said to remove anxiety and madness from the body when decocted and consumed. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Il corno dell'unicorno, che nessuno ha mai visto. Bollito e bevuto, dicono, porta via dal corpo l'inquietudine e la follia. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t自身と周囲の味方の狂気度を下げる道具だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t自身と周囲の味方の狂気度を下げる道具だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that reduce the insanity level.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that reduce the insanity level."
it: Abbassa la Follia tua e dei compagni intorno (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t運勢が大きく上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t運勢が大きく上昇する食物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜食物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a magical fruit that increase one's luck greatly.
en_grezzo: "It is a magical fruit that increase one's luck greatly."
it: Un cibo che alza molto la fortuna.

jp: \t\t数ターン後にダンジョンから脱出できる巻物。新たに読むと中止できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t数ターン後にダンジョンから脱出できる巻物。新たに読むと中止できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scroll that when read, opens a rift to escape after a few turns.
en_grezzo: "It is a scroll that when read, opens a rift to escape after a few turns."
it: Porta fuori dal sotterraneo dopo qualche turno. Rileggerla annulla.

jp: \t\tロックピックと併用することで解錠しやすくさせる特別な品。どんな鍵穴に差し込んでもピタリと合うことから旧時代の遺物ではないかと推測されている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tロックピックと併用することで解錠しやすくさせる特別な品。どんな鍵穴に差し込んでもピタリと合うことから旧時代の遺物ではないかと推測されている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Special item that can be used in conjunction with a lockpick to make locks easier to unlock. It is speculated that it is a relic from the old days, as it fits perfectly no matter what keyhole it is inserted into. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Special item that can be used in conjunction with a lockpick to make locks easier to unlock. It is speculated that it is a relic from the old days, as it fits perfectly no matter what keyhole it is inserted into. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un oggetto speciale che, usato insieme al grimaldello, rende più facile aprire le serrature. Siccome in qualunque toppa lo si infili entra a pennello, si pensa che sia un resto di un'altra epoca. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t所持しているだけで鍵開けの成功率を飛躍的に上昇させる道具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t所持しているだけで鍵開けの成功率を飛躍的に上昇させる道具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) tool that enhances your lockpicking capabilities.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) tool that enhances your lockpicking capabilities."
it: Basta averlo addosso: lo scasso riesce molto più spesso.

jp: \t\t鍵を開ける際に必須ともいうべき道具。時々壊れてしまうのが玉に疵だが、腕が良ければどんな宝箱だって開けることができるだろう。開ける鍵は有っても閉める鍵なんて、この世界には無いのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鍵を開ける際に必須ともいうべき道具。時々壊れてしまうのが玉に疵だが、腕が良ければどんな宝箱だって開けることができるだろう。開ける鍵は有っても閉める鍵なんて、この世界には無いのだ。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: An essential tool for opening locks. Although it may break down from time to time, if you are good at it, you can open any treasure chest. There are keys to open locks, but there are no keys to close locks in this world. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "An essential tool for opening locks. Although it may break down from time to time, if you are good at it, you can open any treasure chest. There are keys to open locks, but there are no keys to close locks in this world. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: L'arnese che, per aprire una serratura, si può dire d'obbligo. Il difetto è che ogni tanto si rompe, ma con una buona mano non c'è forziere che tenga. Chiavi per aprire ce ne sono; per chiudere, in questo mondo, nessuna. \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t鍵開けの際に必要な道具。壊れることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鍵開けの際に必要な道具。壊れることがある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Autoused) tool that is required for picking locks. It may break.
en_grezzo: "(Autoused) tool that is required for picking locks. It may break."
it: Serve per lo scasso. Certe volte si rompe.

jp: \t\t使用することで地面に埋まり、完全に見えなくなる兵器。何も知らずにその場所を踏みつけたら最後、跡形も無く消し飛ぶという。そう、それはたとえあなたが踏んだとしても…。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用することで地面に埋まり、完全に見えなくなる兵器。何も知らずにその場所を踏みつけたら最後、跡形も無く消し飛ぶという。そう、それはたとえあなたが踏んだとしても…。\n#～貰って嬉しい贈り物あれこれ～\n"
en: A weapon that, when used, buries itself in the ground and becomes completely invisible. It is said that if you step on the spot without knowing anything about it, it will be obliterated without a trace in the end. Yes, that is even if you step on it... \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~
en_grezzo: "A weapon that, when used, buries itself in the ground and becomes completely invisible. It is said that if you step on the spot without knowing anything about it, it will be obliterated without a trace in the end. Yes, that is even if you step on it... \n# ~Gifts that I am Happy to Receive~"
it: Un'arma che, a usarla, si sotterra e sparisce del tutto alla vista. Chi calpesta quel punto senza saperne niente, dicono, salta via che non ne resta traccia. Sì: anche se a calpestarla fossi tu... \n# ~Regali che Fa Piacere Ricevere~

jp: \t\t踏んだ者を爆砕する爆弾だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜爆弾＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t踏んだ者を爆砕する爆弾だ。使用することができる（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜爆弾＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that destroys the ones stepped on it when armed.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that destroys the ones stepped on it when armed."
it: Una bomba che dilania chi la calpesta. Si usa (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t使用することで対象を縛る紐。その場にいてほしい時等、寂しがり屋のあなたにお勧めだが、誰かれ構わず縛っていると怒られてしまうかもしれないぞ。\n#～巻かれる為の長いもの～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用することで対象を縛る紐。その場にいてほしい時等、寂しがり屋のあなたにお勧めだが、誰かれ構わず縛っていると怒られてしまうかもしれないぞ。\n#～巻かれる為の長いもの～\n"
en: Cord that binds the object by using it. It is recommended for lonely people who want someone to be there, but they might get angry if you tie them up without asking them to. \n# ~Battles, Dragons, Swords and Magic~
en_grezzo: "Cord that binds the object by using it. It is recommended for lonely people who want someone to be there, but they might get angry if you tie them up without asking them to. \n# ~Battles, Dragons, Swords and Magic~"
it: Una corda che, a usarla, lega il bersaglio. Se sei di quelli che si sentono soli e vogliono qualcuno lì vicino te la consigliamo, ma a legare chiunque capiti forse qualcuno si arrabbia. \n# ~Cose Lunghe Fatte per Essere Avvolte~

jp: \t\t仲間を結んで遠くに行かないようにする道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t仲間を結んで遠くに行かないようにする道具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool to tie up friends and keep them from going too far away .
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool to tie up friends and keep them from going too far away ."
it: Lega un compagno perché non si allontani. Si usa sempre.

jp: \t\t女性の着用していた下着だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t女性の着用していた下着だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜武器＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an underwear worn by a woman.
en_grezzo: "It is an underwear worn by a woman."
it: La biancheria che ha portato una donna.

jp: \t\tバックパックの中のアイテム１つの重量を軽くする巻物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tバックパックの中のアイテム１つの重量を軽くする巻物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scroll that when read, reduce weight of 1 item in your backpack.
en_grezzo: "It is a scroll that when read, reduce weight of 1 item in your backpack."

jp: \t\t何やら危険な感じのする門。怪しく揺らめく光の中から、時折異形の姿や悲鳴が聞こえることがあるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何やら危険な感じのする門。怪しく揺らめく光の中から、時折異形の姿や悲鳴が聞こえることがあるという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Gate that looks suspiciously dangerous. From the mysterious flickering light, it is said that sometimes an unusual figure or a scream can be heard. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Gate that looks suspiciously dangerous. From the mysterious flickering light, it is said that sometimes an unusual figure or a scream can be heard. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Un portale che dà una sensazione di pericolo. Dicono che dentro quella luce che ondeggia inquieta si vedano a tratti figure deformi, o si sentano delle grida.\n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t使用することでショウルームを訪れるゲートだ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用することでショウルームを訪れるゲートだ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that oepns a gateway to the showroom world.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that oepns a gateway to the showroom world."
it: Un cancello per la sala d'esposizione (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t物質の素材を全く違う特定の素材に叩き上げることができる槌。この奇跡の品は雪原にひっそりと住む兄弟の職人達による作品であり、かつ使用道具とされている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t物質の素材を全く違う特定の素材に叩き上げることができる槌。この奇跡の品は雪原にひっそりと住む兄弟の職人達による作品であり、かつ使用道具とされている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A hammer that can smash a material into a specific and completely different material. This miraculous item is the work of two brothers, artisans who live quietly in the snowfields, and is considered a tool for their use. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A hammer that can smash a material into a specific and completely different material. This miraculous item is the work of two brothers, artisans who live quietly in the snowfields, and is considered a tool for their use. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un martello che sa battere il materiale di una cosa fino a farne un altro materiale, del tutto diverso. Questo pezzo miracoloso è opera di due fratelli artigiani che vivono ritirati nelle nevi, ed è anche l'arnese che adoperano. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t指定された素材に作り直す槌だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t指定された素材に作り直す槌だ（使い捨て）。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) tool that re-forge the material of target item.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) tool that re-forge the material of target item."
it: Rifà l'oggetto nel materiale scelto (usa e getta).

jp: \t\t一瞬の早着替えで他人になり済まし、難を逃れることができる道具。喩え時間が無い場合でも、使用した際に勢いよく白い霧が吹き出し変装する時間を与えてくれるので、安心して使うことができる。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一瞬の早着替えで他人になり済まし、難を逃れることができる道具。喩え時間が無い場合でも、使用した際に勢いよく白い霧が吹き出し変装する時間を与えてくれるので、安心して使うことができる。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: Tool that allows a person to escape difficulties by disguising themselves as someone else with a quick change of clothes in an instant. Even if you are short on time, you can use this tool with peace of mind, because when you use it, a white mist blows out vigorously, giving you time to disguise yourself. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "Tool that allows a person to escape difficulties by disguising themselves as someone else with a quick change of clothes in an instant. Even if you are short on time, you can use this tool with peace of mind, because when you use it, a white mist blows out vigorously, giving you time to disguise yourself. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: Un arnese che permette di cambiarsi in un lampo, farsi passare per un altro e cavarsi dai guai. Anche senza tempo lo puoi usare tranquillo: quando lo apri sbuffa fuori di forza una nebbia bianca, e quella il tempo di travestirti te lo dà. \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t「初めて盗みをやった時、俺はまだ10にもなっていなかった。その時は生きる為に必死なだけだったが、今でもあの時と同じくらい大胆なつもりさ。ただ、ちょっと知恵はついたがね」\n#～盗賊ギルドマスター『シン』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「初めて盗みをやった時、俺はまだ10にもなっていなかった。その時は生きる為に必死なだけだったが、今でもあの時と同じくらい大胆なつもりさ。ただ、ちょっと知恵はついたがね」\n#～盗賊ギルドマスター『シン』の言葉～\n"
en: \"I wasn't even ten when I stole for the first time. I was just trying to survive back then. I'm still as bold as I was then, just a little savvier.\" \n# ~words of <Sin> the thief guildmaster~
en_grezzo: "\"I wasn't even ten when I stole for the first time. I was just trying to survive back then. I'm still as bold as I was then, just a little savvier.\" \n# ~words of <Sin> the thief guildmaster~"
it: \"La prima volta che ho rubato non avevo ancora dieci anni. Allora cercavo solo di restare vivo. Sfacciato lo sono ancora come allora: solo, un po' più furbo.\" \n# ~Parole di <Sin> il maestro della Gilda dei Ladri~

jp: \t\tモンスター以外の敵対状況をリセットする道具。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tモンスター以外の敵対状況をリセットする道具。何度か使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that reset non-monster hostile situations.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that reset non-monster hostile situations."
it: Azzera l'ostilità di chi non è un mostro. Si usa più volte.

jp: \t\tモンスター以外の敵対状況をリセットする呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tモンスター以外の敵対状況をリセットする呪文を唱える為に必要な本だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 3 Magic. It reset memories of hostile situations.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 3 Magic. It reset memories of hostile situations."
it: Un libro per far dimenticare l'ostilità a chi non è un mostro.

jp: \t\t見えない者を見ることができる兜だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t見えない者を見ることができる兜だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜秘宝＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a helmet that can see the invisible.
en_grezzo: "It is a helmet that can see the invisible."
it: Un elmo che fa vedere chi non si vede.

jp: \t\t速度が恒久的に上昇するポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t速度が恒久的に上昇するポーションだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that permanently increases speed.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that permanently increases speed."
it: Una pozione che alza la velocità per sempre.

jp: \t\t異国の神の領域を主張するという木製の門。赤色に染められたそれは、何処となく生命の躍動を感じさせる。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国の神の領域を主張するという木製の門。赤色に染められたそれは、何処となく生命の躍動を感じさせる。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Wooden gate that claims the domain of Gods of the foreign lands. Tinted red, it somehow evokes the vibrancy of life. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Wooden gate that claims the domain of Gods of the foreign lands. Tinted red, it somehow evokes the vibrancy of life. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Un portale di legno che, si dice, segna il dominio di un dio straniero. Tinto di rosso, ha in sé qualcosa che fa pensare allo slancio della vita.\n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t異国の神を迎える門だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t異国の神を迎える門だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜遺物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a gate for Gods of foreign lands.
en_grezzo: "It is a gate for Gods of foreign lands."
it: Un portale che accoglie le divinità straniere.

jp: \t\tお嬢様をペットにすることができる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tお嬢様をペットにすることができる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Readable) diary of a young lady, it befriends them when read.
en_grezzo: "(Readable) diary of a young lady, it befriends them when read."
it: Un libro che fa della signorina un compagno. Si legge.

jp: \t\t妹猫をペットにすることができる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t妹猫をペットにすることができる本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書類＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Readable) secret diary of a younger sister, it befriends them when read.
en_grezzo: "(Readable) secret diary of a younger sister, it befriends them when read."
it: Un libro che fa della sorella gatta minore un compagno. Si legge.

jp: \t\tどこかにコレクターがいると言われるメダルだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜貨幣＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tどこかにコレクターがいると言われるメダルだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜貨幣＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is currency with high collection value, rarely found.
en_grezzo: "It is currency with high collection value, rarely found."
it: Dicono che da qualche parte ci sia chi le colleziona.

jp: \t\tマップのどこかに隠された財宝の書かれた地図だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tマップのどこかに隠された財宝の書かれた地図だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Re-usable) readable map from sources unknown that lead's to treasure.
en_grezzo: "(Re-usable) readable map from sources unknown that lead's to treasure."
it: Una mappa con su un tesoro nascosto da qualche parte.

jp: \t\t人の友好度を上げるポーション。食物に混ぜることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人の友好度を上げるポーション。食物に混ぜることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion that increases impression. You can blend it in food.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion that increases impression. You can blend it in food."
it: Alza la simpatia. Si può mescolare al cibo.

en: It is bait for a fishing pole.
en_grezzo: "It is bait for a fishing pole."
it: Un'esca per la canna da pesca.

jp: \t\t請求書と付随された金額を収める為の箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t請求書と付随された金額を収める為の箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) container that hold the tax bill and the accompanying tax.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) container that hold the tax bill and the accompanying tax."
it: Una scatola per la fattura e i soldi delle tasse. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t収めるべき税金の額が書かれた紙だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t収めるべき税金の額が書かれた紙だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜紙片＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a piece of paper with the amount of tax to be collected.
en_grezzo: "It is a piece of paper with the amount of tax to be collected."
it: Un foglio con su quante tasse si devono pagare.

jp: \t\t花で飾られた弓形の建造物。潜り抜ける際に若干の気恥ずかしさを感じるのは一体何故だろうか。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t花で飾られた弓形の建造物。潜り抜ける際に若干の気恥ずかしさを感じるのは一体何故だろうか。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: An arched structure decorated with flowers. Why on earth do I feel a little embarrassed when I go through it? \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "An arched structure decorated with flowers. Why on earth do I feel a little embarrassed when I go through it? \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una costruzione ad arco ornata di fiori. Come mai, a passarci sotto, si prova un po' di imbarazzo? \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t花が飾られた半円状の建造物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t花が飾られた半円状の建造物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an arch structure decorated with flowers.
en_grezzo: "It is an arch structure decorated with flowers."
it: Una costruzione a semicerchio ornata di fiori.

jp: \t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い寝具。柔らかな眠り心地はいうまでも無く、様々な贅を凝らして作られたこのベッドは、家具を愛する者にとって最大の憧れである。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t国王御用達の誉れ高い寝具。柔らかな眠り心地はいうまでも無く、様々な贅を凝らして作られたこのベッドは、家具を愛する者にとって最大の憧れである。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Bedding acclaimed by the King's warrant. This bed, which is made with various luxuries, not to mention its soft and comfortable sleep, is the greatest dream for those who love furniture. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Bedding acclaimed by the King's warrant. This bed, which is made with various luxuries, not to mention its soft and comfortable sleep, is the greatest dream for those who love furniture. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un letto di gran fama, fornitore del re. Del sonno morbido non c'è nemmeno da dire: fatto com'è con ogni sorta di lusso, è il sogno più grande di chi ama i mobili.\n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t王様御用達の優れたベッド（ランク８）。使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t王様御用達の優れたベッド（ランク８）。使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜寝具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un letto da re, eccellente (rango 8). Si può usare.

jp: \t\tくつろげる空間を演出する窓。窓枠から差し込む暖かな光は、一時の安らぎをあなたに提供するだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tくつろげる空間を演出する窓。窓枠から差し込む暖かな光は、一時の安らぎをあなたに提供するだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Windows that create a relaxing space. The warm light shining through the window frame will provide you with temporary peace of mind. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Windows that create a relaxing space. The warm light shining through the window frame will provide you with temporary peace of mind. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra che mette in scena uno spazio in cui riposare. La luce tiepida che entra dal telaio saprà dare un momento di quiete. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t外から光を取りこむ家具。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t外から光を取りこむ家具。夜間、周囲を弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a furniture that sheds light. Illuminates surroundings softly.
en_grezzo: "It is a furniture that sheds light. Illuminates surroundings softly."
it: Fa entrare la luce da fuori. Di notte fa una luce fioca.

jp: \t\t様々な図面が詳細に書かれた板。所有する建築物で使用することで、無駄な筋力を使うことなく家の配置替えをすることができる優れものだ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t様々な図面が詳細に書かれた板。所有する建築物で使用することで、無駄な筋力を使うことなく家の配置替えをすることができる優れものだ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A board with various drawings detailed on it. It is an excellent tool to use on buildings you own to rearrange your home without wasting muscle power. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A board with various drawings detailed on it. It is an excellent tool to use on buildings you own to rearrange your home without wasting muscle power. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Una tavola con sopra disegnati per esteso vari progetti. Usata in un edificio di tua proprietà, cambia la disposizione della casa senza sprecare forza nelle braccia: un bell'arnese. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t部屋の内装を変更できる板。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t部屋の内装を変更できる板。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that allows you to change the decor of a room.
en_grezzo: "(Reusable) tool that allows you to change the decor of a room."
it: Cambia l'arredo della stanza. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t程良く人の手が入った植物。どれだけ時間がたってもその形状が崩れないのは、恐らく人知れず綺麗に刈り取っていく辻庭師がいるからなのだろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t程良く人の手が入った植物。どれだけ時間がたってもその形状が崩れないのは、恐らく人知れず綺麗に刈り取っていく辻庭師がいるからなのだろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: A plant that has been well taken care of by people. The reason why it does not lose its shape no matter how much time passes is probably due to the presence of a street gardener who neatly trims it away without people knowing about it. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "A plant that has been well taken care of by people. The reason why it does not lose its shape no matter how much time passes is probably due to the presence of a street gardener who neatly trims it away without people knowing about it. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta curata dall'uomo quanto basta. Se non perde mai la forma per quanto tempo passi, sarà perché c'è un giardiniere di strada che la pota per bene senza farsi vedere. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t角度をつけて刈り取られた木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t角度をつけて刈り取られた木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a tree was trimmed at an angle.
en_grezzo: "It is a tree was trimmed at an angle."

jp: \t\t広く見かける一般的な窓。これといって目立つ特徴はないが、比較的手に入りやすいので広く流通している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t広く見かける一般的な窓。これといって目立つ特徴はないが、比較的手に入りやすいので広く流通している。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: These are common windows that are widely found. It has no outstanding features, but is widely distributed because it is relatively easy to obtain. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "These are common windows that are widely found. It has no outstanding features, but is widely distributed because it is relatively easy to obtain. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra comune, di quelle che si vedono dappertutto. Non ha nessuna particolarità di rilievo, ma si trova facilmente e per questo circola molto. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t硬い金属の枠組みが特徴的の窓。その硬さはかつて何処かの収容所で採用されたほどだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t硬い金属の枠組みが特徴的の窓。その硬さはかつて何処かの収容所で採用されたほどだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The window is characterized by its hard metal frame. Its hardness is said to be so great that it was once used in a prison camp somewhere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The window is characterized by its hard metal frame. Its hardness is said to be so great that it was once used in a prison camp somewhere. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una finestra che si riconosce dal telaio di metallo duro. Tanto duro, dicono, che una volta lo adottarono in un campo di prigionia. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t愛嬌のある形をした植物。夜、人々が寝静まった頃、この植物はそっと鉢から抜けだし街の外を自由に駆け回っている、という作り話が近年パルミアで人々の笑いを誘っている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t愛嬌のある形をした植物。夜、人々が寝静まった頃、この植物はそっと鉢から抜けだし街の外を自由に駆け回っている、という作り話が近年パルミアで人々の笑いを誘っている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Plant with a charming shape. In recent years, there is a Palmian urban legend, involving a plant that quietly slips out of its pot at night when people are asleep and runs freely outside the city, which has drawn laughter in Palmia. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Plant with a charming shape. In recent years, there is a Palmian urban legend, involving a plant that quietly slips out of its pot at night when people are asleep and runs freely outside the city, which has drawn laughter in Palmia. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta dalla forma simpatica. Di notte, quando tutti dormono, sguscerebbe piano dal vaso e correrebbe libera fuori città: è una frottola che in questi anni a Palmia fa ridere la gente. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t観賞用の鉢植えだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉢＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t観賞用の鉢植えだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉢＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an ornamental potted plant.

jp: \t\t直火を用いる優れた調理器具。これで調理した際に広がる香ばしい匂いは、食べる者にとって最高の調味料となろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t直火を用いる優れた調理器具。これで調理した際に広がる香ばしい匂いは、食べる者にとって最高の調味料となろう。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: An excellent cooking utensil that uses an open flame. The savory smell that spreads when cooking with it will be the best seasoning for those who eat with it. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "An excellent cooking utensil that uses an open flame. The savory smell that spreads when cooking with it will be the best seasoning for those who eat with it. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un ottimo arnese da cucina che lavora a fiamma viva. Il profumo tostato che si spande cucinandoci sarà il miglior condimento per chi mangia. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t使用することでランク９までの料理を作ることができる器具。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用することでランク９までの料理を作ることができる器具。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a cooking tool allowing the preparation of dishes up to Rank 9.
en_grezzo: "It is a cooking tool allowing the preparation of dishes up to Rank 9."
it: Ci si cucinano i piatti fino al rango 9.

jp: \t\t南国気分を味わえる鉢植え。お金が無い時はこの鉢植えを買って、是非とも南国へ行った気分に浸ろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t南国気分を味わえる鉢植え。お金が無い時はこの鉢植えを買って、是非とも南国へ行った気分に浸ろう。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Tropical potted plants. If you don't have the money, buy this potted plant and enjoy the tropical atmosphere by all means. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Tropical potted plants. If you don't have the money, buy this potted plant and enjoy the tropical atmosphere by all means. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che dà un'aria da paese tropicale. Quando i soldi non ci sono, si compri questo vaso e ci si immagini di essere ai tropici. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t目の疲れを取ってくれるという鉢植え。それが対外的による物なのか体内摂取によるものなのかは、売っている人間にしか知る由はない。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t目の疲れを取ってくれるという鉢植え。それが対外的による物なのか体内摂取によるものなのかは、売っている人間にしか知る由はない。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant that is said to relieve eye fatigue. Whether this is used externally or taken internally, only the seller can know. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant that is said to relieve eye fatigue. Whether this is used externally or taken internally, only the seller can know. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che, dicono, toglie la stanchezza dagli occhi. Se sia per via esterna o perché va ingerita, lo sa solo chi la vende. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\tゆったりとした座り心地を提供する威厳ある椅子。聞くところによると左手にシルバーキャット、右手にウィスキーを持つのがこの椅子の正式な座り方らしい。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tゆったりとした座り心地を提供する威厳ある椅子。聞くところによると左手にシルバーキャット、右手にウィスキーを持つのがこの椅子の正式な座り方らしい。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A dignified chair that offers a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere. From what I hear, the official way to sit in this chair is to hold a silver cat in your left hand and a whiskey in your right. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A dignified chair that offers a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere. From what I hear, the official way to sit in this chair is to hold a silver cat in your left hand and a whiskey in your right. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una poltrona autorevole, che offre una seduta distesa. A quel che si dice, il modo ufficiale di sedercisi è con un gatto d'argento nella mano sinistra e un whisky nella destra. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t座る為の家具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t座る為の家具。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un mobile per sedersi. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t聖なる水を湛えた井戸。飲むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜設備＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t聖なる水を湛えた井戸。飲むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜設備＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un pozzo pieno d'acqua santa. Si può bere.

jp: \t\t水を汲むことができる瓶だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t水を汲むことができる瓶だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a potion bottle that is completely empty.
en_grezzo: "It is a potion bottle that is completely empty."
it: Una bottiglia in cui si può prendere l'acqua.

jp: \t\t巨人を繋ぎとめている枷。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n

en_grezzo: "It is a cargo of snow men."

jp: \t\t芸術家の粋を集めた偉大な作品。それを通して差し込む光は、人々に感動と驚きを与える。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t芸術家の粋を集めた偉大な作品。それを通して差し込む光は、人々に感動と驚きを与える。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Great works of art created by the best of artists. The light that shines through it moves and amazes people. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Great works of art created by the best of artists. The light that shines through it moves and amazes people. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una grande opera che raccoglie il fior fiore dell'arte. La luce che entra passandoci attraverso commuove e stupisce. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t外から光を取りこむ家具。夜間、周囲をやや弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t外から光を取りこむ家具。夜間、周囲をやや弱く照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a furniture that lets in light, illuminates surroundings softly.
en_grezzo: "It is a furniture that lets in light, illuminates surroundings softly."
it: Fa entrare la luce da fuori. Di notte fa una luce un po' fioca.

jp: \t\t天井を支える目的に特化した柱。その独特な形状により通常の柱よりずっと重い重量を支えることができる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t天井を支える目的に特化した柱。その独特な形状により通常の柱よりずっと重い重量を支えることができる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Pillars specialized for the purpose of supporting ceilings. Its unique shape allows it to support much heavier weights than ordinary columns. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Pillars specialized for the purpose of supporting ceilings. Its unique shape allows it to support much heavier weights than ordinary columns. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una colonna fatta apposta per sostenere il soffitto. La forma singolare le permette di reggere un peso molto maggiore di una colonna normale. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t重い柱だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t重い柱だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t尊き存在の力と権力を体現した調度品。その大きさは見る者を圧倒させ、自ずとひざまずいてしまう程だという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t尊き存在の力と権力を体現した調度品。その大きさは見る者を圧倒させ、自ずとひざまずいてしまう程だという。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: The furnishings are the embodiment of the power and authority of a divine being. Its size is said to overwhelm those who see it, so much so that they are forced to kneel down. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "The furnishings are the embodiment of the power and authority of a divine being. Its size is said to overwhelm those who see it, so much so that they are forced to kneel down. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Una suppellettile che incarna la forza e l'autorità di un essere sublime. È così grande, dicono, da schiacciare chi la guarda e fargli piegare le ginocchia da sé. \n# ~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t大きく輝く十字架だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大きく輝く十字架だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a great gleaming cross from ancient times.
en_grezzo: "It is a great gleaming cross from ancient times."

jp: \t\t雪のお陰でお洒落に磨きがかかった街灯。雪降る夜、長身の紳士が優しく照らす光は、恋する二人に火を灯すという。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雪のお陰でお洒落に磨きがかかった街灯。雪降る夜、長身の紳士が優しく照らす光は、恋する二人に火を灯すという。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A street lamp, fashionably polished thanks to the snow. It is said that the light gently illuminated by a tall gentleman on a snowy night will light a fire between two people in love. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A street lamp, fashionably polished thanks to the snow. It is said that the light gently illuminated by a tall gentleman on a snowy night will light a fire between two people in love. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un lampione che la neve ha reso ancora più elegante. Nelle notti di neve la luce che questo signore allampanato getta con dolcezza, dicono, accende il fuoco fra due innamorati. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t備え付けられた灯。夜間、周囲を明るく照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t備え付けられた灯。夜間、周囲を明るく照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is equipped with a light. Illuminates the surroundings brightly.
en_grezzo: "It is equipped with a light. Illuminates the surroundings brightly."
it: Un lume fisso. Di notte fa una luce viva.

jp: \t\t寒空に置かれ、白い化粧で身を飾ったタル。その姿はある種の芸術品と見紛う程だ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t寒空に置かれ、白い化粧で身を飾ったタル。その姿はある種の芸術品と見紛う程だ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: Placed in the cold air, and adorned with white makeup of snow, the figure of this barrel could be mistaken for some kind of work of art. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "Placed in the cold air, and adorned with white makeup of snow, the figure of this barrel could be mistaken for some kind of work of art. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un barile posato sotto il cielo freddo, che si è truccato di bianco. A vederlo, lo si scambierebbe per un'opera d'arte. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t雪の掛った液体を保持しておく容器。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雪の掛った液体を保持しておく容器。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a snow-covered container that holds liquid. Cannot be used.
en_grezzo: "It is a snow-covered container that holds liquid. Cannot be used."
it: Un recipiente per liquidi, coperto di neve. Non si può usare.

jp: \t\t身近に雪を感じたいという意見から生み出された小型の雪だるま。その愛らしい表情は小さくなっても変わることなく世界を見つめ続けている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t身近に雪を感じたいという意見から生み出された小型の雪だるま。その愛らしい表情は小さくなっても変わることなく世界を見つめ続けている。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: This small-sized snowman was created from the opinion that people want to feel snow close at hand. The adorable expression on his face remains unchanged even in his smaller size as he continues to gaze out at the world. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "This small-sized snowman was created from the opinion that people want to feel snow close at hand. The adorable expression on his face remains unchanged even in his smaller size as he continues to gaze out at the world. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Un pupazzo di neve piccolo, nato dall'idea di avere la neve a portata di mano. Quel muso adorabile non cambia nemmeno rimpicciolito, e continua a guardare il mondo. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t小さな雪だるまだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さな雪だるまだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a small snowman made of snow.
en_grezzo: "It is a small snowman made of snow."

jp: \t\t雪をかぶったかかしだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雪をかぶったかかしだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a scarecrow covered in snow.
en_grezzo: "It is a scarecrow covered in snow."

jp: \t\t常緑樹だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t常緑樹だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is evergreen with a scented wood.
en_grezzo: "It is evergreen with a scented wood."

jp: \t\t葉の無い樹木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t葉の無い樹木だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp_grezzo: "\t\t沢山集めると雪だるまを作ることができる物体だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜液体＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: These are things that, can be used to build a snowman.
en_grezzo: "These are things that, can be used to build a snowman."
it: Se se ne raccoglie tanta, ci si fa un pupazzo di neve.

jp: \t\t小洒落た装飾がなされた街灯。夜になると自らの光で淡く輝き、辺りを華やかに演出する。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小洒落た装飾がなされた街灯。夜になると自らの光で淡く輝き、辺りを華やかに演出する。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A streetlight with a stylish decoration. At night, they glow faintly with their own light, making the area look gorgeous. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A streetlight with a stylish decoration. At night, they glow faintly with their own light, making the area look gorgeous. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un lampione ornato con un tocco di eleganza. Quando viene notte brilla di luce propria, tenue, e dà a tutto quello che ha intorno un'aria sfarzosa. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\tかつて世紀の天才が作ったという照明器具。その斬新なつくりは、今でも貴族達の間で人気の一つである。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tかつて世紀の天才が作ったという照明器具。その斬新なつくりは、今でも貴族達の間で人気の一つである。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: This lighting fixture was once created by a genius of the century. Its innovative construction is still one of the most popular among aristocrats. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "This lighting fixture was once created by a genius of the century. Its innovative construction is still one of the most popular among aristocrats. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un apparecchio per fare luce che si dice costruito, un tempo, da un genio del secolo. La sua fattura ardita è ancora oggi fra le più amate dai nobili. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t高名な芸術家によって作られた簡易照明。夜間、周囲を明るく照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高名な芸術家によって作られた簡易照明。夜間、周囲を明るく照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an artisan lighting. Illuminates the surroundings brightly.
en_grezzo: "It is an artisan lighting. Illuminates the surroundings brightly."
it: Un lume d'artista famoso. Di notte fa una luce viva.

jp: \t\tロウで作られた雰囲気の出る照明。その小さな揺らめく炎は、恋する二人の距離を一層近しいものにするという。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tロウで作られた雰囲気の出る照明。その小さな揺らめく炎は、恋する二人の距離を一層近しいものにするという。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Atmospheric lighting made of wax. Its small flickering flame is said to bring two people in love even closer together. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Atmospheric lighting made of wax. Its small flickering flame is said to bring two people in love even closer together. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un lume di cera, di quelli che fanno atmosfera. Quella piccola fiamma che ondeggia, dicono, accorcia ancora di più la distanza fra due innamorati. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\tロウで作られた簡易照明。常に周囲を照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tロウで作られた簡易照明。常に周囲を照らす。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a simple lighting made of wax. Always illuminates the surroundings.
en_grezzo: "It is a simple lighting made of wax. Always illuminates the surroundings."
it: Un lume semplice di cera. Illumina sempre intorno.

jp: \t\tいつの世も人は火と共に合った。火があるから空間を温める熱を得、火があるから夜を照らす光を得た。今やあなたは文明の火種と共にあるのだ！\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tいつの世も人は火と共に合った。火があるから空間を温める熱を得、火があるから夜を照らす光を得た。今やあなたは文明の火種と共にあるのだ！\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: People have always lived with fire. With fire we got heat to warm the space, and with fire we got light to illuminate the night. Now you are holding the spark of civilization! \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "People have always lived with fire. With fire we got heat to warm the space, and with fire we got light to illuminate the night. Now you are holding the spark of civilization! \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: In ogni tempo l'uomo è stato insieme al fuoco. Dal fuoco il calore che scalda lo spazio, dal fuoco la luce che rischiara la notte. E ora la scintilla della civiltà è nelle tue mani! \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t「片手に握りしめるだけで、あなたのネフィアライフはぐっと冒険者チックになります。あなたも是非ともこの優れたライトアップツールをお試しください」\n#～ヴェルニースの雑貨店に張られた広告～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「片手に握りしめるだけで、あなたのネフィアライフはぐっと冒険者チックになります。あなたも是非ともこの優れたライトアップツールをお試しください」\n#～ヴェルニースの雑貨店に張られた広告～\n"
en: \"Just by clutching it in one hand, your Nefia life will become much more adventurous. You should definitely try this excellent light-up tool.\" \n# ~notice of good store of Vernis~
en_grezzo: "\"Just by clutching it in one hand, your Nefia life will become much more adventurous. You should definitely try this excellent light-up tool.\" \n# ~notice of good store of Vernis~"
it: \"Basta stringerla in una mano e la tua vita nelle Nefia diventa molto più da avventuriero. Prova anche tu questo ottimo arnese per far luce!\" \n# ~Reclame Affissa al Bazar di Vernis~

jp: \t\t手に持つ簡易照明。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t手に持つ簡易照明。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Una luce semplice da tenere in mano. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t対象に扉を生成する呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t対象に扉を生成する呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 3 Magic. It manifests a door on target object.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 3 Magic. It manifests a door on target object."
it: Un libro per aprire una porta dove vuoi. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\t振ることで近距離に扉を作り出す魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t振ることで近距離に扉を作り出す魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a rod that, when zapped, manifests doorways on nearby walls.
en_grezzo: "It is a rod that, when zapped, manifests doorways on nearby walls."
it: Una bacchetta che, agitata, apre porte nei muri vicini.

jp: \t\t世間一般に広く流通している棚。期待以上の事には使えないが、必要最低限の事はこなす、無難な家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t世間一般に広く流通している棚。期待以上の事には使えないが、必要最低限の事はこなす、無難な家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A shelf that is widely used by the masses. It is a safe piece of furniture that can't be used for more than you expect, but does the bare minimum of what you need it to do. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A shelf that is widely used by the masses. It is a safe piece of furniture that can't be used for more than you expect, but does the bare minimum of what you need it to do. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale di quelli che circolano dappertutto. Non serve a niente di più di quel che ci si aspetta, ma il minimo indispensabile lo fa: un mobile senza rischi. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t一般的な棚だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一般的な棚だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"

jp: \t\t１５種の食物を腐らすことなく保持する箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t１５種の食物を腐らすことなく保持する箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) container keep 15 different types of food from spoiling.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) container keep 15 different types of food from spoiling."
it: Tiene 15 cibi senza farli marcire. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t使用する度一定の金額を入れ、保管しておくことができる箱。使う度に少しずつ重くなっていくのは、きっと貯める幸せによるところなのだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使用する度一定の金額を入れ、保管しておくことができる箱。使う度に少しずつ重くなっていくのは、きっと貯める幸せによるところなのだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A box that allows you to put a certain amount of money in it every time you use it and keep it. The fact that it gets a little heavier each time it is used is surely due to the happiness of storing it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A box that allows you to put a certain amount of money in it every time you use it and keep it. The fact that it gets a little heavier each time it is used is surely due to the happiness of storing it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una cassetta dove a ogni uso si mette dentro una certa somma e la si tiene da parte. Che a ogni uso si faccia un po' più pesante sarà di sicuro merito della felicità di mettere da parte. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t指定された額ごとに貯金できる箱。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t指定された額ごとに貯金できる箱。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Reusable) tool that allows you to save money.

jp_grezzo: "\t\t映像が収められた円盤。使用することで過去の記録を映像として呼び起こすことができるが、残念ながら今日において使用法以外の全ての技術は忘れ去られてしまった。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"

en_grezzo: "Disks containing videos. The use of these disks can bring back past memories in the form of videos, but unfortunately all other techniques have been forgotten today except for their use. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"

en_grezzo: "It is a dried out meat that can restore satiety."

jp_grezzo: "\t\t振ることで対象に炎の壁を作り出す魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 6 Magic. It can generate walls of flame on targeted spot."

jp: \t\t吹きすさぶ氷刃に対して開発された毛布。氷結における水薬の破損を完全に防ぐが、ものには限界があるので過信は禁物である。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t吹きすさぶ氷刃に対して開発された毛布。氷結における水薬の破損を完全に防ぐが、ものには限界があるので過信は禁物である。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n"

en_grezzo: "Blankets developed against icy blades of wind. Although it completely prevents freezing damage to the potion, overconfidence is not advised, as there are limits to what can be achieved. \n# ~Palmian Winter Fashion~"
it: Una coperta messa a punto contro le lame di ghiaccio che sferzano. Impedisce del tutto che il gelo rovini le pozioni, ma tutto ha un limite e fidarsi troppo è vietato. \n# ~Palmia: Collezione Autunno-Inverno~

jp: \t\t氷結によるアイテムの破損を何度か防ぐブランケットだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t氷結によるアイテムの破損を何度か防ぐブランケットだ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜用具＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "It is a blanket that prevents items from being damaged by freezing."
it: Una coperta che protegge dal gelo, per qualche volta.

jp: \t\t迫りくる火炎に対して開発された毛布。燃焼状態におけるアイテムの炭化を完全に防ぐが、ものには限界があるので過信は禁物である。\n#～パルミア春夏物コレクション～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t迫りくる火炎に対して開発された毛布。燃焼状態におけるアイテムの炭化を完全に防ぐが、ものには限界があるので過信は禁物である。\n#～パルミア春夏物コレクション～\n"
en: Blankets developed against an approaching flame. It completely prevents the destruction of items due to combustion, but it has its limitations and one should not be overconfident. \n# ~Palmian Summer Fashion~
en_grezzo: "Blankets developed against an approaching flame. It completely prevents the destruction of items due to combustion, but it has its limitations and one should not be overconfident. \n# ~Palmian Summer Fashion~"

jp: \t\t金品を売買する際に不可欠な機械。防犯の為、登録した一人にしか使用できないシステムになっている。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n

en_grezzo: "An indispensable machine for buying and selling money and goods. For security purposes, the system allows only one person registered to use it. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"

jp: \t\t人を配属するにおいて必要不可欠な機械。ここで仲間の配属先が変更できる。「もし不慮の事故で無くしてもご安心あれ。経済の要、パルミア大使館ですべて揃います」\n#～ティリス武具大全、広告のページ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人を配属するにおいて必要不可欠な機械。ここで仲間の配属先が変更できる。「もし不慮の事故で無くしてもご安心あれ。経済の要、パルミア大使館ですべて揃います」\n#～ティリス武具大全、広告のページ～\n"
en: This machine is essential in assigning personnel. It is here that you can change the assignment of your fellow workers. \"If you lose it by accident, don't worry. Everything is available at the Palmia Embassy, the keystone of the economy.\" \n# ~Tyris Armor Compendium, page of advertisements~
en_grezzo: "This machine is essential in assigning personnel. It is here that you can change the assignment of your fellow workers. \"If you lose it by accident, don't worry. Everything is available at the Palmia Embassy, the keystone of the economy.\" \n# ~Tyris Armor Compendium, page of advertisements~"
it: Una macchina indispensabile per assegnare la gente. Qui si cambia l'incarico dei compagni. \"Se per un caso sfortunato la perdete, state tranquilli: all'ambasciata di Palmia, cardine dell'economia, si trova tutto.\" \n# ~Grande Compendio delle Armi di Tyris: le Reclame~

jp_grezzo: "\t\t与えられた給料を受け取る為の箱。開けることができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜箱＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Openable) box to receive the earned salary.
en_grezzo: "(Openable) box to receive the earned salary."
it: Una scatola dove arriva la paga. Si può aprire.

jp: \t\t対象に壁を生成する呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t対象に壁を生成する呪文を唱える為に必要な本。読むことができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜書物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: Book of Rank 3 Magic. It manifests a wall at target location.
en_grezzo: "Book of Rank 3 Magic. It manifests a wall at target location."
it: Un libro per alzare un muro dove vuoi. Si può leggere.

jp: \t\t振ることで対象に壁を作り出す魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t振ることで対象に壁を作り出す魔法の杖だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜魔道具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a rod that, when zapped, creates magical walls at target location.
en_grezzo: "It is a rod that, when zapped, creates magical walls at target location."
it: Una bacchetta che, agitata, alza muri magici dove vuoi.

jp: \t\t音楽が収められた円盤。使用することで封入された特定の音楽を奏でるが、残念ながら今日において使用法以外の全ての技術は忘れ去られてしまった。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t音楽が収められた円盤。使用することで封入された特定の音楽を奏でるが、残念ながら今日において使用法以外の全ての技術は忘れ去られてしまった。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"
en: A disc containing music. These discs play a specific enclosed song when used, but unfortunately, the technology to do anything but play them is lost to the present day.\n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~
en_grezzo: "A disc containing music. These discs play a specific enclosed song when used, but unfortunately, the technology to do anything but play them is lost to the present day.\n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: Un disco con dentro della musica. Usandolo suona il brano che ci hanno chiuso, ma purtroppo oggi, di tutta quella tecnica, non è rimasto che il modo di usarlo.\n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\t音楽のデータが刻まれた円盤。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t音楽のデータが刻まれた円盤。何度でも使用することができる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜器具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is an usable disc etched with music data.
en_grezzo: "It is an usable disc etched with music data."
it: Un disco con della musica incisa. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t読むことで倉庫を建てることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことで倉庫を建てることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) Readable deed used to build a warehouse.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) Readable deed used to build a warehouse."
it: Un atto: letto, fa nascere un magazzino.

jp: \t\t読むことで畑を作ることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t読むことで畑を作ることができる権利書だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜証書＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: (Single-use) Readable deed used to build a farm.
en_grezzo: "(Single-use) Readable deed used to build a farm."
it: Un atto: letto, fa nascere un campo.

jp: \t\t非常に愉快な表情をした雪像。雪が降ると子供達が集まって思い思いの雪だるまを作っては互いに見せ合うという。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に愉快な表情をした雪像。雪が降ると子供達が集まって思い思いの雪だるまを作っては互いに見せ合うという。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n"
en: Very funny looking snow sculptures. When it snows, children gather to make snowmen of their own design and show them to each other. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~
en_grezzo: "Very funny looking snow sculptures. When it snows, children gather to make snowmen of their own design and show them to each other. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~"
it: Una statua di neve dall'espressione buffissima. Quando nevica, dicono, i bambini si radunano, fanno ciascuno il pupazzo che ha in mente e poi se li mostrano a vicenda. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\t雪で作られた雪像だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雪で作られた雪像だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a snowman made of snow.
en_grezzo: "It is a snowman made of snow."

jp: \t\t邪気を祓うといわれる巨大な鉱物。日の光を乱反射し燦然と輝くそれは、古来から魔術において重要な位置を占める存在であるといわれている。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t邪気を祓うといわれる巨大な鉱物。日の光を乱反射し燦然と輝くそれは、古来から魔術において重要な位置を占める存在であるといわれている。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: Giant mineral that is said to purge evil spirits. It is said to have occupied an important position in magic since ancient times. \n#~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "Giant mineral that is said to purge evil spirits. It is said to have occupied an important position in magic since ancient times. \n#~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Un minerale enorme che, dicono, scaccia gli influssi maligni. Rifrange la luce del sole in ogni direzione e sfolgora, e fin dall'antichità occupa un posto importante nelle arti magiche. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t巨大な黒い鉱物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t巨大な黒い鉱物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜鉱物＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a giant black crystal.

jp: \t\t頂上部に可愛らしい猫が模られた石柱。その愛嬌ある後ろ姿は、猫本来の気まぐれさを芸術家が感じ取って彫ったとされている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t頂上部に可愛らしい猫が模られた石柱。その愛嬌ある後ろ姿は、猫本来の気まぐれさを芸術家が感じ取って彫ったとされている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Pillar with an adorable cat modeled at the top. It is said that the charming rear figure was carved by an artist who sensed the cat's inherent whimsy. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Pillar with an adorable cat modeled at the top. It is said that the charming rear figure was carved by an artist who sensed the cat's inherent whimsy. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una colonna di pietra con in cima un gatto grazioso. Quella schiena piena di garbo, si dice, l'artista l'ha scolpita dopo aver colto il capriccio che è proprio dei gatti. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t「以前ヴェルニースに行ったのですが、いたんですよアレが！　恐ろしい尻尾とあの耳、考えただけでも震えが止まらない…。一体誰があんな石柱を作ったのでしょう。こちらを向いていないのが唯一の救いでしたよ」\n#～猫嫌いの『タム』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「以前ヴェルニースに行ったのですが、いたんですよアレが！　恐ろしい尻尾とあの耳、考えただけでも震えが止まらない…。一体誰があんな石柱を作ったのでしょう。こちらを向いていないのが唯一の救いでしたよ」\n#～猫嫌いの『タム』の言葉～\n"
en: \"I went to Vernis before, and there it was, that thing! The horrible tail and those ears, I can't stop shaking just thinking about it.... Who in the world could have made a stone pillar like that? The only relief was that it wasn't facing me.\" \n# ~<Tam> the cat hater~
en_grezzo: "\"I went to Vernis before, and there it was, that thing! The horrible tail and those ears, I can't stop shaking just thinking about it.... Who in the world could have made a stone pillar like that? The only relief was that it wasn't facing me.\" \n# ~<Tam> the cat hater~"
it: \"Tempo fa sono stato a Vernis, e c'era quella cosa! La coda spaventosa, e quelle orecchie: solo a pensarci non smetto di tremare... Ma chi mai avrà fatto una colonna del genere? L'unica consolazione è che non era girata verso di me\" \n# ~Parole di <Tam> il nemico dei gatti~

jp: \t\t猫を模った柱だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t猫を模った柱だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜彫像＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a pillar in the shape of a cat.
en_grezzo: "It is a pillar in the shape of a cat."
it: Una colonna a forma di gatto.

jp: \t\t高名な画家が描いたとされる静物画。キャンバス一杯に描かれた幾輪ものひまわりが、見る者の目と心を引き付けて離さないという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高名な画家が描いたとされる静物画。キャンバス一杯に描かれた幾輪ものひまわりが、見る者の目と心を引き付けて離さないという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Still-life painting said to have been painted by a famous artist. The canvas is said to be filled with many sunflowers, attracting the viewer's eyes and heart. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Still-life painting said to have been painted by a famous artist. The canvas is said to be filled with many sunflowers, attracting the viewer's eyes and heart. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una natura morta che si dice dipinta da un pittore famoso. I molti girasoli che riempiono la tela, dicono, prendono l'occhio e il cuore di chi guarda e non li lasciano più. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t植物の絵が書いてある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t植物の絵が書いてある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a painting of a sunflower.
en_grezzo: "It is a painting of a sunflower."

jp: \t\t高名な画家が描いたとされる風景画。どこか懐かしい雰囲気を思い起こさせるこの絵に、人は誰しも郷里を重ねるのだという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高名な画家が描いたとされる風景画。どこか懐かしい雰囲気を思い起こさせるこの絵に、人は誰しも郷里を重ねるのだという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Landscape painting said to have been painted by a famous artist. It is said that this painting, which evokes a nostalgic atmosphere, reminds people of their hometowns. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Landscape painting said to have been painted by a famous artist. It is said that this painting, which evokes a nostalgic atmosphere, reminds people of their hometowns. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un paesaggio che si dice dipinto da un pittore famoso. In questo quadro, che desta un'aria di nostalgia venuta chissà da dove, ognuno finisce per rivedere il proprio paese. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t風景の絵が書いてある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t風景の絵が書いてある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a painting of a landscape.
en_grezzo: "It is a painting of a landscape."

jp: \t\t高名な画家が描いたとされる人物画。憂いを帯びたその表情は、見る者の心を揺り動かす何かを持っているという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t高名な画家が描いたとされる人物画。憂いを帯びたその表情は、見る者の心を揺り動かす何かを持っているという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Portrait painting said to have been painted by a famous artist. The melancholy expression on her face possesses something that moves the viewer's heart. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Portrait painting said to have been painted by a famous artist. The melancholy expression on her face possesses something that moves the viewer's heart. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un ritratto che si dice dipinto da un pittore famoso. Quella sua espressione velata di malinconia, dicono, ha in sé qualcosa che smuove il cuore di chi guarda. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t女性の絵が書いてある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t女性の絵が書いてある。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜美術品＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a painting of a lady.
en_grezzo: "It is a painting of a lady."

jp: \t\t突然の客人にも対応できる寛容なテーブル。その懐の深さは見習いたいものだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t突然の客人にも対応できる寛容なテーブル。その懐の深さは見習いたいものだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The table is big enough to accommodate unexpected guests. One should learn from the depth of this open-mindedness. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The table is big enough to accommodate unexpected guests. One should learn from the depth of this open-mindedness. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo generoso, capace di far posto anche all'ospite che arriva all'improvviso. Quella larghezza di cuore sarebbe da imparare. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tとても大きな机だ。何度でも使用できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tとても大きな机だ。何度でも使用できる。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Un tavolo molto grande. Si può usare sempre.

jp: \t\t天井に届きそうな程背の高い鉢植え。どの茎も皆一身に太陽の方へと伸びている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t天井に届きそうな程背の高い鉢植え。どの茎も皆一身に太陽の方へと伸びている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plants are so tall that they almost reach the ceiling. Every stem is growing toward the sun single-mindedly. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plants are so tall that they almost reach the ceiling. Every stem is growing toward the sun single-mindedly. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso così alta da sfiorare il soffitto. Ogni stelo, tutti quanti, si allunga verso il sole e non guarda altro. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t食材の煮炊きに使う設備。いつ見ても使われているので、料理をすることはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t食材の煮炊きに使う設備。いつ見ても使われているので、料理をすることはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Equipment used to cook food. It is not allowed to cook as it is being used anytime you see it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Equipment used to cook food. It is not allowed to cook as it is being used anytime you see it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un'attrezzatura per cuocere e bollire i cibi. Ogni volta che la si guarda è occupata, e perciò non ci si può cucinare. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t煮炊きに使う窯。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t煮炊きに使う窯。使用することはできない。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is a stove useful for cooking food. Cannot be used.
en_grezzo: "It is a stove useful for cooking food. Cannot be used."
it: Un forno per cuocere. Non si può usare.

jp: \t\t室内を暖める為に用いる暖房器具。炉の中でパチパチと音を立てて燃え盛る炎は、心底冷えた体をゆっくり溶かしてくれるだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t室内を暖める為に用いる暖房器具。炉の中でパチパチと音を立てて燃え盛る炎は、心底冷えた体をゆっくり溶かしてくれるだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A heating device used to warm a room. The crackling flames inside the furnace will slowly melt your hearty cold body. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A heating device used to warm a room. The crackling flames inside the furnace will slowly melt your hearty cold body. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un apparecchio che serve a scaldare gli ambienti. La fiamma che divampa crepitando dentro il focolare scioglierà piano il corpo intirizzito fino al midollo. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t部屋を暖める家具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t部屋を暖める家具だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜家具＞カテゴリ～\n"
en: It is furniture that warms the room.
en_grezzo: "It is furniture that warms the room."
it: Un mobile che scalda la stanza.

jp: \t\t金属を溶かす為の炉。内部は常に赤熱した木材で温められている。\n#～より良い業物を目指して～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t金属を溶かす為の炉。内部は常に赤熱した木材で温められている。\n#～より良い業物を目指して～\n"
en: Furnace for melting metals. The inside is always heated by red-hot wood. \n# ~Aiming for Better Workmanship~
en_grezzo: "Furnace for melting metals. The inside is always heated by red-hot wood. \n# ~Aiming for Better Workmanship~"
it: Un forno per fondere i metalli. Dentro è tenuto caldo di continuo da legna arroventata. \n# ~Verso una Lama Migliore~

jp: \t\t金属を暖める建造物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t金属を暖める建造物だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜建造物＞カテゴリ～\n"
it: Una costruzione che scalda il metallo.

jp_grezzo: "\t\t落葉樹だ。\n#～鑑定報告書：＜樹木＞カテゴリ～\n"

en_grezzo: "\"This is one of those things that I've witnessed and gotten. It's not just any old thing. First of all, the color is nice, and the shape. There's something fun about it. And between you and me, it has a secret...oops, you'll have to wait until after you buy it.\" \n# ~<Moyer> the crooked~"

E, detto fra noi, questo qui ha un segreto... ehi, ehi, quello ve lo godete dopo che l'avete comprato\" \n# ~La Cantilena di <Moyer> l'imbonitore~

jp: \t\t魚を釣る為に必要な道具。休日のポート・カプールの波止場には大物を釣り上げることを夢見て、幾人もの釣り人、もとい観光客がその手に握りしめ、孤軍奮闘しているという。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t魚を釣る為に必要な道具。休日のポート・カプールの波止場には大物を釣り上げることを夢見て、幾人もの釣り人、もとい観光客がその手に握りしめ、孤軍奮闘しているという。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Tool needed to catch fish. On holidays, the docks of Port Kapul are said to be filled with anglers, or even tourists, who are struggling alone, clutching their gear in their hands, dreaming of catching a big fish. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Tool needed to catch fish. On holidays, the docks of Port Kapul are said to be filled with anglers, or even tourists, who are struggling alone, clutching their gear in their hands, dreaming of catching a big fish. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"

jp: \t\t「魚を釣るには餌もそうだが何よりこいつが重要だ。後は簡単、竿を振ってじっと待つだけ。そうそう、当然ながらスキルを持っていなければただの待ちぼうけだからな」\n#～釣り自慢のフィッシャーの言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「魚を釣るには餌もそうだが何よりこいつが重要だ。後は簡単、竿を振ってじっと待つだけ。そうそう、当然ながらスキルを持っていなければただの待ちぼうけだからな」\n#～釣り自慢のフィッシャーの言葉～\n"
en: \"To catch fish, the bait is the most important. The rest is easy, just swing the rod, wait, and profit. And yes, of course, if you don't have the skill, you'd be just waiting and waiting.\" \n# ~words of a fisherman proud of his catch~
en_grezzo: "\"To catch fish, the bait is the most important. The rest is easy, just swing the rod, wait, and profit. And yes, of course, if you don't have the skill, you'd be just waiting and waiting.\" \n# ~words of a fisherman proud of his catch~"
it: \"Per pescare conta l'esca, certo, ma più di tutto conta questo. Il resto è facile: butti la lenza e stai fermo ad aspettare. Ah, e va da sé: se l'abilità non ce l'hai, aspetti e basta.\" \n# ~Parole di un Pescatore Fiero della Sua Preda~
